definition_zh: 纵向的；沿长轴方向的；长度的；纵切的；纵波的；纵贯时间的；经度的；沿链条或层级的
definition_en: of or measured along the length of something, running lengthwise from end to end, or extending across a long span of time in a study
core_image: 一把刀沿着竹竿从这一头直剖到那一头，刀口始终顺着同一根长轴
scene: The surveyor runs the tape from the trunk's base to its tip, following the tree's longitudinal axis.
sceneCN: 这里 longitudinal 是「沿长轴方向的」（第 1 个义项：沿长轴）；句意：测量员把卷尺从树干基部一直拉到树梢，顺着这棵树的长轴走。图中可辨识物件：树干、卷尺、刻度、树梢、量测标记。

pos.zh: 纵向的；沿长轴方向的；长度的；纵贯时间的；经度的

collocations.zh: 纵向研究（长期追踪同一批对象）
纵波（振动方向与传播方向一致）
纵向数据（同一对象在不同时点的记录）
纵向整合（沿产业链上下延伸）

senses.title: Running along the long axis: from one end to the other
senses.titleCN: 沿长轴：从这一头走到那一头
senses.definition: placed or measured along the longest dimension of an object, from one end to the other
senses.definitionCN: 沿物体最长的那一维、从一端到另一端放置或测量的
senses.example: The tunnel was drilled longitudinally through the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 隧道顺着山脊的走向纵向钻通。
senses.why: Latin longitudo is longus 'long' plus -tudo, the suffix that turns a quality into a measurable extent. Adding -alis makes a direction adjective: the direction that follows that extent.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 longitudo 是 longus「长的」加 -tudo，这个后缀把性质变成可度量的延展。再加 -alis 就成了方向形容词：顺着那段延展走的方向。

senses.title: Of length as a dimension, not width or height
senses.titleCN: 长度的：作为一个维度而言
senses.definition: relating to length as a measured dimension rather than to width, breadth or height
senses.definitionCN: 指长度这一可测量的维度，而不是宽、阔或高
senses.example: Longitudinal measurement showed that the beam had grown two centimetres.
senses.exampleCN: 长度测量显示这根梁长了两厘米。
senses.why: The Latin noun named plain 'length' long before it named a line on the globe. The adjective keeps that older sense of a dimension, so any measure taken along the long side is longitudinal.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词先指朴素的「长度」，很久以后才指地球上的经线。形容词保留了这一较早的维度义，因此凡是沿长边量出的尺寸都叫 longitudinal。

senses.title: Cut lengthwise: the longitudinal section
senses.titleCN: 纵切：把物体顺着长度剖开
senses.definition: made by cutting along the length of a body, so that the cut surface shows its internal parts from end to end
senses.definitionCN: 沿物体的长度剖开而制成的切面，切口从一端贯通到另一端，露出内部构造
senses.example: The anatomist drew a longitudinal section of the stem.
senses.exampleCN: 解剖学家画出了茎的纵切面。
senses.why: In anatomy and engineering a cut is named by the axis it follows. Down the long axis gives a longitudinal section; across it gives a transverse one, and the pair of words defines each other.
senses.whyCN: 在解剖学与工程里，切面按它顺着的那根轴命名。顺着长轴切就是纵切面，横着切就是横切面，这两个词互相定义。

senses.title: Longitudinal wave: vibration along the line of travel
senses.titleCN: 纵波：振动方向与传播方向在同一条线上
senses.definition: of a wave in which the particles move back and forth along the same line in which the wave itself travels
senses.definitionCN: 指波中质点沿着波传播的同一条线来回振动的
senses.example: Sound in air is a longitudinal wave; light is a transverse one.
senses.exampleCN: 空气中的声波是纵波，光是横波。
senses.why: Here the contrast is with transverse. The push travels down a row of touching balls, and each ball moves along the same line as the push, so the whole disturbance is longitudinal.
senses.whyCN: 这里与横波相对。推力沿一排相触的球传下去，每颗球都沿推力的同一条线运动，整个扰动因此是纵向的。

senses.title: Longitudinal study: following the same people through time
senses.titleCN: 纵向研究：把同一批人一路跟下去
senses.definition: of research that follows the same subjects over a long period and measures change as it happens
senses.definitionCN: 指长期追踪同一批研究对象、随时记录其变化的
senses.example: The longitudinal study tracked the children from age five to thirty.
senses.exampleCN: 这项纵向研究追踪这些孩子从五岁一直到三十岁。
senses.why: The dimension of length moved from space into time. A study that runs the full length of years is longitudinal; one that slices across the population at a single moment is cross-sectional.
senses.whyCN: 长度这一维度从空间挪到了时间上。跑满若干年长度的是纵向研究；只在一个时刻横切人群的是横向研究。

senses.title: Longitudinal data and comparison: one group against itself
senses.titleCN: 纵向数据与比较：同一群体与自己比
senses.definition: of records or comparisons that set the same group against its own earlier or later state
senses.definitionCN: 指把同一群体与其先前或后来的状态作对照的记录或比较
senses.example: Longitudinal data let researchers separate age effects from generation effects.
senses.exampleCN: 纵向数据让研究者把年龄效应与代际效应区分开。
senses.why: Once a study runs along time, its records become a line of successive points. Comparing along that line, rather than across people, is what makes the comparison longitudinal.
senses.whyCN: 研究一旦沿时间展开，记录就成了一条由连续时点连成的线。沿这条线比较，而不是在人与人之间横比，才使这种比较成为纵向的。

senses.title: Of longitude: position measured east and west
senses.titleCN: 经度的：东西方向上的位置
senses.definition: relating to longitude, the east-west position measured in degrees, or to the lines that mark it
senses.definitionCN: 指经度——以度数计的东西向位置——或指标示经度的那些线
senses.example: The ship's longitudinal position was fixed at twenty degrees west.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘船的经度位置定在西经二十度。
senses.why: Longitudo also named the 'length' of the known world measured east to west. That usage fixed longitude as the terrestrial coordinate, and the adjective followed the noun into geography.
senses.whyCN: longitudo 也曾指已知世界东西方向的「长度」。这一用法把 longitude 固定为地理坐标，形容词也随之进入地理学。

senses.title: Along the chain: levels of command or stages of supply
senses.titleCN: 沿链条：层级上下或产业链前后
senses.definition: of links that run between levels of a hierarchy or between successive stages of a supply chain
senses.definitionCN: 指贯穿等级各层之间、或产业链各连续环节之间的连接
senses.example: Analysts describe links from supplier to customer as longitudinal ties within the industry.
senses.exampleCN: 分析者把从供应商到客户的连接称为产业内的纵向联系。
senses.why: Here the length is the chain itself: the axis runs from raw material to end user, or from head office down through the levels. A link along that axis is longitudinal rather than lateral.
senses.whyCN: 这里的「长度」就是链条本身：轴从原料走到最终用户，或从总部往下穿过各层级。顺着这根轴的连接就是纵向的，而不是横向的。

intro.en: Longitudinal comes from Late Latin longitudinalis, an adjective built on Latin longitudo 'length'. Longitudo is longus 'long' plus -tudo, the suffix that turns a quality of size into a noun of extent. English borrowed the adjective in the 14th century for what runs lengthwise; its use for studies that follow people over years belongs to the 20th century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: longitudinal 出自晚期拉丁语 longitudinalis，是加在拉丁语 longitudo「长度」上的形容词。longitudo 由 longus「长的」加 -tudo 构成，这个后缀把尺寸性质变成表示延展的名词。英语在 14 世纪借入该形容词，指顺着长度方向的；用于长期追踪人的研究则是 20 世纪的事。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Longitudinal study becomes a settled term in psychology and medicine for research that follows the same subjects across years.
items.cn: longitudinal study（纵向研究）在心理学与医学中成为固定术语，指跨年份追踪同一批对象的研究。

items.en: Physics and anatomy standardise longitudinal wave and longitudinal section as the contrast pair to transverse.
items.cn: 物理学与解剖学把 longitudinal wave（纵波）与 longitudinal section（纵剖面）固定下来，作为与 transverse（横切）相对的一对术语。

items.en: English longitudinal is first recorded, borrowed from Late Latin longitudinalis, describing what lies or runs lengthwise.
items.cn: 英语 longitudinal 首次见于记载，借自晚期拉丁语 longitudinalis，描述顺着长度放置或延伸的东西。

items.en: Latin longitudo 'length' is longus 'long' plus -tudo; the same noun also names east-west distance on the globe, which gives longitude.
items.cn: 拉丁语 longitudo「长度」由 longus「长的」加 -tudo 构成；同一个名词也指地球上东西向的距离，由此产生 longitude。

items.en: longus goes back to the reconstructed root *dlonghos 'long', which also yields English long and German lang; the asterisk marks a reconstructed, unattested form.
items.cn: longus 可追溯到重构形式 *dlonghos「长的」，这一形式也产生英语 long 与德语 lang；星号表示重构而未见记载的形式。

note.en: The first group separates words that merely look similar from those that truly share the root; the second compares words that overlap only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把只是长得像的词与真正同源的词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: relating to latitude, the north-south position. It is built on latus 'side, broad', not on longus 'long', so the two look like a pair but come from different roots.
entries.definitionCN: 指纬度，即南北方向的位置。它建立在 latus「侧面、宽」上，而不是 longus「长」，因此两词看似成对，来源却不同。

entries.definition: the east-west coordinate, and the noun from which longitudinal is built. It keeps the older sense of 'length' inside a geographic term.
entries.definitionCN: 东西向坐标，也是 longitudinal 所由构成的名词。它在地理术语内部保留了较早的「长度」义。

entries.definition: a deep desire. It comes from Old English langian 'to grow long for', a native verb about the mind stretching out, and not from Latin longus.
entries.definitionCN: 深切的渴望。它出自古英语 langian「因思念而心长」，是描述心思被拉长的本族动词，并非来自拉丁语 longus。

entries.definition: describing a study that measures many different people at one moment. It contrasts with longitudinal, which measures the same people at many moments.
entries.definitionCN: 指在同一时刻测量许多不同人的研究。它与纵向研究相对：后者是在许多时刻测量同一批人。

entries.definition: following one after another in order. It names the order of events, while longitudinal names the axis along which they are followed.
entries.definitionCN: 按次序一个接一个。它说的是事件先后顺序，而 longitudinal 说的是顺着哪根轴去追踪。

entries.definition: lasting or extending over a long period. It stresses duration alone; longitudinal stresses that measurements run along that duration.
entries.definitionCN: 持续或延伸很长时间。它只强调时长，而 longitudinal 强调测量是沿着这段时间展开的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: longus 'long' plus -tudo gives longitude 'length'; add -alis and you get the adjective of direction along that length.
normal.cn: longus「长」加 -tudo 得到 longitude「长度」；再加 -alis 就得到「顺着这个长度」的方向形容词。

normal.en: The -i- before -tudinal is a linking vowel, not a plural marker; do not read longitudinal as 'longitudes'.
normal.cn: tudinal 前的那个 -i- 是连接元音，不是复数标记；不要把它读成 longitude 的复数。

normal.en: The same longus yields longevity, where long life is literally a 'long age', and oblong, where ob- 'towards' plus longus means 'longer than broad'.
normal.cn: 同一个 longus 还产生 longevity（字面「长的年岁」即长寿）和 oblong（ob-「朝向」加 longus，意为「比宽更长」）。

normal.en: Longitude and longitudinal are the same family; the noun names the coordinate, the adjective names the direction along it.
normal.cn: longitude 与 longitudinal 同属一族；名词指坐标，形容词指沿该坐标的方向。

normal.en: Transverse is the built-in opposite: transverse cuts across the axis, longitudinal runs along it.
normal.cn: transverse（横切）是它内在的对立面：横切是切过轴线，纵向是顺着轴线。

abstract.en: See one thread pulled from end to end of a spool; everything called longitudinal is measured along that thread.
abstract.cn: 想象从线轴的一端到另一端拉出一根线；所有叫 longitudinal 的东西都是沿这根线量的。

abstract.en: Let the thread turn into time: a longitudinal study is the same thread running through years rather than across people.
abstract.cn: 把这根线换成时间：纵向研究就是同一根线穿过许多年份，而不是横过许多人。

abstract.en: The word always asks one question: is the measurement along the long line, or across it?
abstract.cn: 这个词总在问同一个问题：这个测量是顺着长线，还是横穿过去？

examples.en: The engineers took longitudinal measurements before cutting the pipe.
examples.cn: 工程师在切割管道前先做了纵向测量。

examples.en: A longitudinal study can show how reading habits change with age.
examples.cn: 纵向研究能显示阅读习惯如何随年龄改变。

examples.en: The drill followed a longitudinal path through the rock.
examples.cn: 钻头沿着一条纵向路径穿过岩层。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「龙脊丢头」——顺着龙脊一路走到底，方向始终不变 → longitudinal 纵向的、沿长轴的

root: 拉丁语 longus「长的」＋-tudo（延展名词后缀）→ longitudo「长度、经度」＋-alis（形容词后缀）→ longitudinal。核心是「顺着最长的那一维走到底」，再由空间延伸到时间与链条。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a line drawn from one end of a thing to the other. What changes is what the line is drawn through: a beam, a cut surface, a sound wave, a set of years, a table of records, the globe, or a chain of command.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：从物体一端拉到另一端的一条线。变化的只是这条线穿过什么：梁、剖面、声波、一串年份、一张记录表、地球，还是一条指挥链。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one line drawn from end to end along the longest side of a thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：沿物体最长的一边，从一端到另一端画出的一条线。

branches.en: LONG AXIS: the line is spatial, and any measure taken along it is a length measure.
branches.cn: 长轴：这条线在空间里，沿它量出的任何尺寸都是长度尺寸。

branches.en: CUT LENGTHWISE: the knife follows the line, so the exposed face shows the inside from end to end.
branches.cn: 纵切：刀顺着这条线走，露出的面就从一端到另一端展示内部。

branches.en: WAVE ALONG THE LINE: in a longitudinal wave the vibration itself moves along the same line as the wave.
branches.cn: 线上之波：纵波里振动本身就沿着与波相同的那条线移动。

branches.en: TIME AS LENGTH: the line becomes a run of years, and records along it form longitudinal data.
branches.cn: 时间成线：这条线变成一串年份，沿线的记录就构成纵向数据。

branches.en: CHAIN AS LENGTH: geography uses the east-west line, organisations use the line from top level to bottom or from supplier to buyer.
branches.cn: 链条成线：地理学用东西向的线，组织则用从顶层到底层、或从供应商到买方的线。

intro.en: Longitudinal is Latin long- plus -itudo plus -alis. The suffix -tudo (English -tude) makes a noun of extent from an adjective, and -alis (English -al) makes a relating adjective from that noun.
intro.cn: longitudinal 是拉丁词干 long- 加 -itudo 再加 -alis。后缀 -tudo（英语 -tude）把形容词变成表示延展的名词，-alis（英语 -al）再把该名词变成关系形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are longus 'long' and the two suffixes -tudo and -alis. longus also underlies longitude, longevity and oblong.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁成分是 longus「长的」以及 -tudo、-alis 两个后缀。longus 还支撑着 longitude、longevity、oblong。

items.meaning: relating to length or running lengthwise
items.meaningCN: 与长度有关的；顺长度方向的
items.example: The beam was measured along its longitudinal axis.
items.exampleCN: 这根梁沿它的长轴被测量。

items.meaning: length, and later the east-west coordinate
items.example: The island lies at fifteen degrees of longitude.
items.exampleCN: 这座岛位于经度十五度。

items.meaning: in the direction of the length
items.example: The wood was cut longitudinally.
items.exampleCN: 这块木头是纵向切开的。

items.structure: longus (long), with the native English form
items.meaning: measuring a great distance from end to end
items.meaningCN: 长的；长的（英语本族同源形式）
items.example: A long table filled the room.
items.exampleCN: 一张长桌占满了房间。

items.structure: Old English lengþu, the native noun matching Latin longitudo
items.meaning: the measure of something from end to end
items.meaningCN: 长度（英语本族名词，与拉丁 longitudo 对应）
items.example: Measure the length of the wall first.
items.exampleCN: 先量这面墙的长度。

items.meaning: to stretch something out longer
items.meaningCN: 拉长；使延长（e- 表示向外）
items.example: The cells elongate as they divide.
items.exampleCN: 细胞在分裂时被拉长。

items.meaning: the act of stretching out, or the amount stretched
items.example: The test measures the elongation of the wire.
items.exampleCN: 这项测试测量金属丝的伸长量。

items.meaning: long life, great length of years
items.meaningCN: 长寿；长久的寿命（字面「长的年岁」）
items.example: Diet affects human longevity.
items.exampleCN: 饮食影响人类的寿命。

items.meaning: longer than it is broad
items.example: She placed an oblong tray on the table.
items.exampleCN: 她把一个长条形的托盘放在桌上。

items.structure: longitudo, the same noun used as a technical coordinate
items.meaning: distance east or west of a standard meridian
items.meaningCN: 相对标准子午线的东西向距离；经度
items.example: Sailors needed accurate clocks to find longitude.
items.exampleCN: 水手需要准确的钟表来确定经度。

latinEntries.meaning: forms a noun of extent or quality, as in longitude
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成表示延展或性质的名词，如 longitude
长度；也指东西向的延展

latinEntries.meaning: relating to, of the kind of

definition_zh: 维护；保养；维持；维持费；生活费；扶养费；维修作业；维持性复述；维持期；装备维修保障
definition_en: the work of keeping equipment, buildings or systems in good condition; the act of keeping something in existence; or the money that supports a person
core_image: 一人一只手扶稳竖起的梯子，另一只手不停往齿轮上滴油
scene: One hand steadies the ladder while the other keeps oiling the gears: this everyday care is maintenance.
sceneCN: 这里 maintenance 是「日常保养」（第 1 个义项：设备保养）；句意：一只手扶稳梯子，另一只手不停给齿轮上油，这种日常照料就是保养。图中可辨识物件：人字梯、油壶、齿轮、油迹、工具箱。

pos.zh: 维护；保养；维持；生活费；扶养费；维修作业

collocations.zh: 维持期（治疗或体重管理）

forms.label: 单数（不可数，指保养工作）
复数（罕用，指多笔扶养费或多类维护）

senses.title: Routine upkeep: keeping equipment in working order
senses.titleCN: 日常保养：让设备一直能转
senses.definition: the regular work of cleaning, checking, adjusting and repairing equipment so that it keeps working
senses.definitionCN: 为让设备持续运转而定期进行的清洁、检查、调整与修理工作
senses.example: The aircraft is in the hangar for routine maintenance.
senses.exampleCN: 这架飞机正在机库里做日常保养。
senses.why: Old French maintenir meant to hold with the hand, and maintenance first named the act of holding something up. Applied to machines, that holding up becomes regular servicing: the thing is held in working order.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 maintenir 意为「用手握住」，maintenance 最初指把东西撑住这一行为。用在机器上，「撑住」就变成了定期保养：让它一直保持在可用状态。

senses.title: Keeping something in existence
senses.titleCN: 维持：使某物继续存在下去
senses.definition: the act of keeping something in existence or at the same level, so that it does not decay or disappear
senses.definitionCN: 使某物继续存在或保持在同一水平、不至于衰败或消失的行为
senses.example: The maintenance of peace required constant negotiation.
senses.exampleCN: 维持和平需要不断的谈判。
senses.why: The abstract sense comes straight from the literal one: to keep a thing in the hand is to keep it from falling away. What is held up here is a state, not a machine.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义直接从字面义来：把东西握在手里，就是不让它掉下去。这里被撑住的是某种状态，而不是机器。

senses.title: Money that supports a person: living costs, alimony
senses.titleCN: 生活费、扶养费：供养一个人的钱
senses.definition: money paid regularly to support a person's living costs, especially after a separation or divorce
senses.definitionCN: 定期支付以维持某人生活开支的钱，尤指分居或离婚之后的扶养费
senses.example: He pays monthly maintenance for his two children.
senses.exampleCN: 他每月为两个孩子支付扶养费。
senses.why: In law, maintenance was the support one person owed another. The image of holding someone up turns into money: what keeps a household standing is now paid in instalments.
senses.whyCN: 在法律中，maintenance 指一方对另一方应付的供养。把人「撑住」的意象转成了钱：让一个家庭不倒下的东西，如今按月支付。

senses.title: Public upkeep: roads, bridges and structures kept in repair
senses.titleCN: 公共设施养护：道路桥梁的修补
senses.definition: the work of keeping roads, bridges, railways and public structures in good repair
senses.definitionCN: 使道路、桥梁、铁路与公共建筑保持良好状态的养护工作
senses.example: Highway maintenance closes one lane every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 每年春天公路养护都会封闭一条车道。
senses.why: The thing held up is now a public structure rather than a private machine. English uses maintenance for the state's duty to keep shared surfaces usable.
senses.whyCN: 这里被撑住的是公共建筑，而不是私人机器。英语用 maintenance 指国家维持公共设施可用的职责。

senses.title: System maintenance: keeping software and data healthy
senses.titleCN: 系统维护：让软件与数据保持正常
senses.definition: the work of keeping software, servers, networks or databases in working order, often by planned updates
senses.definitionCN: 通过计划性更新等手段让软件、服务器、网络或数据库保持正常工作
senses.example: Scheduled maintenance will take the site offline for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 计划内维护会让网站离线一小时。
senses.why: Digital systems decay in their own way: patches fall behind, disks fill, certificates expire. The old word for holding a machine up was simply carried over to the invisible machinery.
senses.whyCN: 数字系统有自己的老化方式：补丁落后、磁盘写满、证书过期。原先用于撑住机器的旧词，直接搬到了这套看不见的机器上。

senses.title: Maintenance rehearsal: holding an item in memory
senses.titleCN: 维持性复述：把信息按原样留在记忆里
senses.definition: in psychology, repetition that keeps an item in memory without connecting it to other knowledge or moving it into long-term storage
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中指一种重复：只把信息留在记忆中，不与其它知识建立联系，也不转入长时记忆
senses.example: Repeating a phone number to yourself is maintenance rehearsal.
senses.exampleCN: 把电话号码反复默念，就是维持性复述。
senses.why: Here the thing held up is a memory trace. The word keeps its plain sense of holding, and the contrast is with elaborative rehearsal, which builds links instead of merely holding.
senses.whyCN: 这里被撑住的是一段记忆痕迹。词仍保留朴素的「撑住」义，与之相对的是精细复述——后者建立联系，而不只是撑住。

senses.title: Maintenance phase: holding a state instead of changing it
senses.titleCN: 维持期：不追求改变，只求稳住
senses.definition: a stage of treatment, weight control or training in which the present state is kept rather than improved
senses.definitionCN: 治疗、体重控制或训练中的一个阶段：保持现状而不继续改善
senses.example: After the diet, she entered a six-month maintenance phase.
senses.exampleCN: 节食结束后，她进入为期六个月的维持期。
senses.why: Medical language splits a course into an active phase and a holding phase. The second phase does exactly what the word says: it holds the gain already made.
senses.whyCN: 医学语言把疗程分为主动期与维持期。第二阶段做的正是字面所说的事：把已经取得的成果撑住。

senses.title: Equipment support in the military: keeping vehicles serviceable
senses.titleCN: 装备维修保障：让车辆武器随时可用
senses.definition: in military use, the logistics of keeping weapons, vehicles and equipment serviceable and supplied
senses.definitionCN: 军事用语中指使武器、车辆与装备保持可用并获得补给的勤务保障
senses.example: The unit's maintenance company repaired the trucks overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 该部队的维修连一夜之间修好了卡车。
senses.why: Armies turned upkeep into a named branch of logistics. The word covers repair, inspection, spare parts and recovery, all of it holding the force in a usable state.
senses.whyCN: 军队把保养变成后勤的一个专设分支。这个词涵盖修理、检查、备件与救援，全是把部队撑在可用状态。

intro.en: Maintenance came into English through Old French maintenance from the verb maintenir, which continues Latin manu tenere 'to hold with the hand'. That phrase is manus 'hand' plus tenere 'to hold'. The English noun first named the act of upholding something, then the money that upholds a household, and only later the servicing of machines. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: maintenance 经古法语 maintenance 进入英语，源自动词 maintenir，后者延续拉丁语 manu tenere「用手握住」，即 manus「手」加 tenere「握持」。英语名词最初指把东西撑住的行为，随后指撑起一个家庭的钱，最后才指机器的保养。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Maintenance becomes a standard engineering and computing term for planned upkeep, and maintenance-free enters product description.
items.cn: maintenance 成为工程与计算领域表示计划性保养的标准术语，maintenance-free 也进入产品说明。

items.en: Railways and factories give the word its modern weight: maintenance of rolling stock and machinery is a budgeted activity.
items.cn: 铁路与工厂赋予这个词现代的分量：机车与机械的维护成为要编预算的活动。

items.en: The legal sense 'support owed to a dependant' is recorded, turning upkeep into a regular payment.
items.cn: 「应付给受扶养人的生活费」这一法律义见于记载，把保养变成了定期付款。

items.en: English maintenance is recorded in the sense of upholding or defending something, borrowed from Old French.
items.cn: 英语 maintenance 见于记载，义为撑住或维护某物，借自古法语。

items.en: manu tenere 'to hold with the hand' is the source phrase; tenere also gives tenant, tenable, retain, contain and sustain.
items.cn: manu tenere「用手握住」是源头词组；tenere 还给出 tenant、tenable、retain、contain、sustain。

note.en: The first group separates the real family from words that only resemble it or are misspelled; the second compares near synonyms that each cover part of maintenance.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与只是形似或拼错的词分开；第二组比较近义词，它们各自覆盖 maintenance 的一部分。

entries.definition: a person or thing that holds a group together, or the rope that supports a ship's mainmast. It is main 'chief' plus stay, a nautical term, not manus plus tenere.
entries.definitionCN: 维系一个群体的主要人物或事物，或指支撑主桅的绳索。它是 main「主要的」加航海词 stay「支索」，而不是 manus 加 tenere。

entries.definition: to keep something in good condition, to keep it in existence, or to assert something firmly. It is the verb behind maintenance and keeps all three threads.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持良好状态、使某物继续存在，或坚定主张某事。它是 maintenance 背后的动词，三条语义线都保留着。

entries.definition: A common misspelling of maintenance, which follows the French stem mainten- rather than the English verb maintain. There is no such standard spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 这是 maintenance 的常见拼错形式；正确拼写沿用法语词干 mainten-，而不是英语动词 maintain 的词形。并不存在这一标准拼法。

entries.definition: the everyday care and cost of keeping property or equipment in condition. It leans toward the money and effort spent rather than the technical work.
entries.definitionCN: 让房产或设备保持状态的日常照料及其花费。它偏向所花的钱和精力，而不是技术性的维修工作。

entries.definition: the scheduled technical attention given to a machine, such as oil changes and inspections. It is the concrete task, where maintenance is the whole programme.
entries.definitionCN: 给机器定期做的技术性照料，如换油和检查。它是具体的一项活，而 maintenance 是整套安排。

entries.definition: the court-ordered payment to a former spouse. It is the legal name for one kind of maintenance, from Latin alimonia 'nourishment', not a general term for upkeep.
entries.definitionCN: 法院判决支付给前配偶的钱。它是 maintenance 中一种的法律名称，出自拉丁语 alimonia「滋养」，不是保养的统称。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: manu tenere is 'hold with the hand'; maintenance is the act of holding something up so it does not fall.
normal.cn: manu tenere 是「用手握住」；maintenance 就是把东西撑住、不让它倒下的行为。

normal.en: The noun keeps the French stem mainten-, which is why it is spelled maintenance and not maintainance.
normal.cn: 这个名词保留了法语词干 mainten-，所以拼作 maintenance 而不是 maintainance。

normal.en: tenere, the 'hold' half, also gives tenant, tenable, retain, contain and sustain: every one of them is holding something.
normal.cn: 表示「握持」的 tenere 还给出 tenant、tenable、retain、contain、sustain，每一个都含有「握持」。

normal.en: The same noun covers a machine, a peace, a child and a data centre, because all of them can fall down if nobody holds them up.
normal.cn: 同一个名词既能指机器、和平、孩子，也能指数据中心，因为只要无人撑住，它们都会倒。

normal.en: maintenance-free is the exact negation: no holding up is needed.
normal.cn: maintenance-free 正是它的反义：不需要任何撑住。

abstract.en: Picture a hand under a leaning ladder: maintenance is that hand, whether the ladder is a bus, a marriage or a database.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手托住倾斜的梯子：maintenance 就是那只手，无论梯子是公交车、婚姻还是数据库。

abstract.en: See upkeep as a steady drip of small acts; stop dripping and the machine, the peace or the gain begins to fail.
abstract.cn: 把保养看成一滴一滴的小动作；一旦停止滴油，机器、和平或成果就开始衰败。

abstract.en: The word never means improvement: it means holding the present state, which is why a maintenance phase follows the active one.
abstract.cn: 这个词从不表示改善：它表示把现状撑住，所以主动期之后才有维持期。

examples.en: Poor maintenance is a more common cause of failure than worn parts.
examples.cn: 保养不善比零件磨损更常导致故障。

examples.en: The foundation pays maintenance to the families of injured workers.
examples.cn: 该基金会向受伤工人的家庭支付扶养费。

examples.en: Regular maintenance of the trails keeps hikers safe.
examples.cn: 定期维护步道能保障徒步者的安全。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「门特嫩死」——门轴得常抹油，不然就卡死 → maintenance 维护、保养

root: 拉丁语 manu tenere「用手握住」＝manus「手」＋tenere「握持」，经古法语 maintenir、maintenance 进入英语。核心是「一直用手撑住，不让它倒下」：撑住机器是保养，撑住生活是扶养费，撑住状态是维持。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a hand holding something up. What changes is what is held: a machine, a peace, a household, a road, a server, a memory, a treatment result, or an army's vehicles.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一只手把东西撑住。变化的只是撑住的是什么：机器、和平、家庭、道路、服务器、记忆、治疗成果，还是一支军队的车辆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand steadying a ladder while the other oils the gears.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手扶稳梯子，另一只手给齿轮上油。

branches.en: HOLDING UP: the physical hand becomes routine servicing for a machine, and simple keeping for a state of affairs.
branches.cn: 撑住：有形的手变成对机器的定期保养，对事态则变成单纯的维持。

branches.en: MONEY AS SUPPORT: what holds a household up is paid regularly, and law names it maintenance.
branches.cn: 以钱撑住：撑起一个家庭的东西按月支付，法律称之为扶养费。

branches.en: SHARED AND DIGITAL SURFACES: roads and servers are held usable for everyone who depends on them.
branches.cn: 公共与数字设施：道路与服务器为所有依赖它们的人保持在可用状态。

branches.en: HOLDING A STATE: a memory trace or a treatment gain is kept exactly as it is, without further change.
branches.cn: 撑住状态：记忆痕迹或治疗成果被原样保持，不再进一步改变。

branches.en: HOLDING A FORCE: military logistics keeps vehicles and weapons serviceable so the unit can act.
branches.cn: 撑住武力：军事后勤让车辆与武器保持可用，使部队能够行动。

intro.en: Maintenance is Latin manu tenere 'to hold with the hand' plus the French noun ending -ance, from Latin -antia. The ending turns the act of holding into the name of that act.
intro.cn: maintenance 是拉丁语 manu tenere「用手握住」加法语名词词尾 -ance（出自拉丁 -antia）。这个词尾把「握持」这一动作变成该动作的名称。

latinIntro.en: The two Latin pieces are manus 'hand' and tenere 'to hold'. tenere supplies the stems ten- and -tain, visible in tenant, tenable, retain, contain, sustain and maintain.
latinIntro.cn: 两个拉丁成分是 manus「手」与 tenere「握持」。tenere 提供 ten- 与 -tain 词干，见于 tenant、tenable、retain、contain、sustain、maintain。

items.meaning: the act of keeping something up
items.meaningCN: 维持、保养的行为（-ance 构成动作名词）
items.example: Routine maintenance keeps the pumps running.
items.exampleCN: 日常保养让水泵持续运转。

items.meaning: to keep in condition, keep in being, or assert
items.example: They maintain the bridge every summer.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年夏天维护这座桥。

items.meaning: able to be kept up or defended
items.example: The design is simple and easily maintainable.
items.exampleCN: 这个设计简单，易于维护。

items.meaning: the ease with which something can be kept in service
items.meaningCN: 可维护性；便于保养的程度
items.example: Engineers tested the maintainability of the new engine.
items.exampleCN: 工程师测试了新发动机的可维护性。

items.meaning: a person or tool that keeps something in order
items.meaningCN: 维护者；保养人员或工具
items.example: The software has only one active maintainer.
items.exampleCN: 这款软件只有一名在任维护者。

items.meaning: one who holds a rented property
items.meaningCN: 承租人；房客（字面「持有者」）
items.example: The tenant renewed the lease for a year.
items.exampleCN: 房客续签了一年租约。

items.meaning: able to be held or defended against objection
items.example: That argument is no longer tenable.
items.exampleCN: 那个论点已经站不住脚了。

items.meaning: to keep or hold on to something
items.meaningCN: 保留；保持（re- 表示向后）
items.example: The soil retains water after rain.
items.exampleCN: 雨后土壤能保住水分。

items.meaning: to hold inside, or to keep within limits
items.meaningCN: 容纳；控制住（con- 表示合在一起）
items.example: The box contains old letters.
items.exampleCN: 这个盒子里装着旧信件。

items.meaning: to hold up from beneath, and so to keep going
items.meaningCN: 支撑；使持续（sus- 表示从下方）
items.example: The soil sustains a dense forest.
items.exampleCN: 这片土壤养着茂密的森林。

latinEntries.meaning: to hold with the hand, hence to keep up
latinEntries.meaningCN: 用手握住，因而引申为维持

latinEntries.meaning: forms an abstract noun of action, French -ance
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成动作抽象名词，法语作 -ance

definition_zh: 操纵；操作；手法；数据处理；市场操纵；基因操作；手法治疗；手术操作；诡计
definition_en: the act of controlling people or situations by clever or unfair means, or of handling something skilfully with the hands or with tools
core_image: 一双手把三只倒扣的壳快速挪位，豆子仿佛在众目之下消失
scene: The dealer's hands move the shells so quickly that the pea seems to vanish: that is manipulation.
sceneCN: 这里 manipulation 是「操纵」（第 1 个义项：对人的操纵）；句意：摊主的手把三个壳挪动得太快，豆子仿佛消失了，这就是操纵。图中可辨识物件：三个倒扣的壳、豆子、摊主的手、桌面、围观者的眼睛。

pos.zh: 操纵；操作；手法；数据处理；市场操纵；基因操作

forms.label: 单数（一次操纵或一种操作）
复数（多次操纵或多道操作）

derivatives.zh: 善于操纵的；操控他人的

senses.title: Control of people by clever or unfair means
senses.titleCN: 对人的操纵：用手段把人当物件摆布
senses.definition: the act of controlling people, opinions or events by clever, indirect or unfair means
senses.definitionCN: 以巧妙、间接或不正当的手段控制人、舆论或事件的行为
senses.example: The vote was decided by manipulation rather than by argument.
senses.exampleCN: 这次表决靠的是操纵，而不是辩论。
senses.why: Latin manipulus was a handful, and manipulare meant to handle. Handling a person as one handles an object is exactly what gives the hostile sense: the other person is reduced to something in the hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 manipulus 是「一把、一束」，manipulare 意为「操作」。把一个人当作物件来操作，正是敌意义的来源：对方被降格成手里的一件东西。

senses.title: Skilful handling with the hands
senses.titleCN: 手工操作：用手熟练地摆弄物件
senses.definition: skilful handling, moving or working of an object with the hands
senses.definitionCN: 用双手熟练地拿取、移动或加工某物
senses.example: The potter's manipulation of wet clay takes years to learn.
senses.exampleCN: 陶工对湿泥的拿捏功夫要学好几年。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense and the literal one: a hand working a mass it can hold in a single grip. Every later sense is a transfer of this image.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老、也最字面的义项：一只手加工一把能握住的物料。此后所有义项都是这个意象的转移。

senses.title: Data and image processing
senses.titleCN: 数据处理：用技术手段改动数据与图像
senses.definition: the changing, rearranging or cleaning of data, images or files by technical means
senses.definitionCN: 用技术手段改动、重排或清理数据、图像与文件
senses.example: The figures had been tidied up by manipulation of the spreadsheet.
senses.exampleCN: 这些数字是靠在表格里做处理整理出来的。
senses.why: Once data replaced clay, the hand still works the material, only through a program. The word stays neutral here until readers suspect the changes were hidden.
senses.whyCN: 数据取代了泥料，手仍然在加工材料，只是改成通过程序来加工。此时词义本来中性，直到读者怀疑这些改动被藏了起来。

senses.title: Market manipulation: moving prices by hand
senses.titleCN: 市场操纵：人为把价格推动起来
senses.definition: illegal trading or spreading of false information in order to move prices or markets artificially
senses.definitionCN: 通过违规交易或散布虚假信息，人为推动价格或市场的行为
senses.example: Regulators fined the trader for manipulation of the copper market.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构因操纵铜市场对该交易员处以罚款。
senses.why: Prices are supposed to move by supply and demand, not by one pair of hands. Calling it manipulation says the movement was made, not caused.
senses.whyCN: 价格本应由供求推动，而不是由某一双手推动。称其为操纵，就是说这个变动是被人做出来的，而不是自然形成的。

senses.title: Genetic manipulation: altering the material of life
senses.titleCN: 基因操作：直接改动生命的物质
senses.definition: deliberate alteration of genetic material in an organism, whether for research, medicine or agriculture
senses.definitionCN: 为研究、医疗或农业而有意识地改动生物体的遗传物质
senses.example: Gene manipulation in crops raises questions about labelling.
senses.exampleCN: 农作物的基因操作引发了标签标示方面的疑问。
senses.why: The material handled is now a molecule. The word keeps its neutral sense of skilled working, and the moral weight comes from the context rather than from the word itself.
senses.whyCN: 此时被操作的是一段分子。词仍保持「熟练加工」的中性义，道德上的分量来自语境，而不是词本身。

senses.title: Manual therapy: treating joints by hand
senses.titleCN: 手法治疗：用手法调整关节与组织
senses.definition: in medicine, treatment of joints, muscles or soft tissue by controlled manual movement
senses.definitionCN: 医学中指用手法控制地活动关节、肌肉或软组织加以治疗
senses.example: The physiotherapist used spinal manipulation to relieve the pain.
senses.exampleCN: 理疗师用脊柱手法治疗来缓解疼痛。
senses.why: Here the hand is the instrument and the sense is entirely neutral. The same word that damns a politician describes a licensed treatment, because the handling is skilled and disclosed.
senses.whyCN: 这里手就是工具，词义完全中性。同一个词既能谴责政客，也能描述持证治疗，因为这种操作是熟练的、公开说明的。

senses.title: Surgical handling of tissue
senses.titleCN: 手术操作：术中用手牵拉与复位
senses.definition: in surgery, the controlled manual handling of tissue, such as pulling, rotating or repositioning it
senses.definitionCN: 外科手术中用手有控制地牵拉、旋转或复位组织
senses.example: Gentle manipulation of the bowel reduced the risk of damage.
senses.exampleCN: 轻柔地操作肠管降低了损伤风险。
senses.why: Surgeons name the hand-work that never appears on the instruments. The word is descriptive and carries no hint of deceit, since everything is done in view.
senses.whyCN: 外科医生用这个词指那些从不出现在器械上的手上功夫。此处纯为描述，不含欺骗意味，因为一切都在视野之内完成。

senses.title: Trickery: scheming to gain an advantage
senses.titleCN: 诡计：暗中耍手段占便宜
senses.definition: trickery, scheming or hidden dealing used to gain an advantage over others
senses.definitionCN: 为占他人便宜而使用的欺骗、算计或暗中交易
senses.example: The whole deal smelled of manipulation and hidden payments.
senses.exampleCN: 整笔交易都透着耍手段和暗中付款的味道。
senses.why: When the handling is hidden, the word drops the praise of skill and keeps only the fact of unseen control. This is the everyday negative sense, close to scheming.
senses.whyCN: 一旦操作是隐藏的，词就丢掉对技巧的赞许，只剩下「暗中控制」这一事实。这就是日常的贬义，接近「算计」。

intro.en: Manipulation comes from French manipulation, from Medieval Latin manipulare 'to handle', which rests on Latin manipulus 'a handful, a bundle'. Manipulus joins manus 'hand' with an element usually connected to plere 'to fill', though that second element is of uncertain origin. The English word first named manual handling in the 18th century and only later acquired the sense of controlling people. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: manipulation 出自法语 manipulation，源于中世纪拉丁语 manipulare「操作、拿取」，后者建立在拉丁语 manipulus「一把、一束」上。manipulus 由 manus「手」与一个通常与 plere「装满」相联系的成分构成，但后一成分来源不确定。英语词在 18 世纪先指手工操作，后来才获得「控制他人」的义项。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Image manipulation and data manipulation become fixed phrases, and gene manipulation appears with the rise of molecular biology.
items.cn: image manipulation（图像处理）与 data manipulation（数据操纵）成为固定说法，gene manipulation（基因操作）随分子生物学的兴起而出现。

items.en: The hostile sense 'control by unfair means' is established in political and commercial writing.
items.cn: 「以不正当手段控制」这一贬义在政治与商业写作中确立。

items.en: English manipulation is borrowed from French, at first naming the act of handling something by hand.
items.cn: 英语 manipulation 借自法语，最初指用手拿取、操作某物的动作。

items.en: manipulare 'to handle' is formed on manipulus, and carries the plain physical sense of working something in the hand.
items.cn: manipulare「操作、拿取」由 manipulus 构成，带有「在手中加工某物」的朴素物理义。

items.en: manipulus names a handful or bundle, as of hay or soldiers. Its first element is manus 'hand'; the second is of uncertain origin and is often linked to plere 'to fill'.
items.cn: manipulus 指一把或一束东西，如干草或士兵。其第一成分是 manus「手」；第二成分来源不确定，常被认为与 plere「装满」有关。

note.en: The first group separates genuine hand-root relatives from words built on other roots; the second compares words that cover only part of manipulation.
note.cn: 第一组把真正同「手」词根的词与建立在其它词根上的词分开；第二组比较只覆盖 manipulation 一部分的近义词。

entries.definition: done with the hands, or a handbook. It is Latin manualis from manus 'hand', the same first element as manipulation, but it never acquired the sense of deceit.
entries.definitionCN: 用手做的，或指手册。它出自拉丁语 manualis、源于 manus「手」，与 manipulation 共享第一成分，却从未获得欺骗义。

entries.definition: a text written by hand rather than printed. It is manus 'hand' plus scriptum 'written', so the hand appears twice in the history of the word.
entries.definitionCN: 手写而非印刷的文本。它是 manus「手」加 scriptum「书写」，因此「手」在这个词的历史里出现两次。

entries.definition: clear and obvious, or a list of cargo. Its Latin source manifestus is of uncertain origin and is not securely derived from manus, so it is not a true relative.
entries.definitionCN: 明显的，或指货物清单。其拉丁来源 manifestus 词源不确定，不能确证出自 manus，因此不是真正的同族词。

entries.definition: the act of touching, moving or dealing with something. It is the neutral word for what manipulation means in its literal sense, with no hint of deceit or skill.
entries.definitionCN: 接触、移动或处理某物的动作。它是 manipulation 字面义的中性说法，不含欺骗或技巧的意味。

entries.definition: the act of using a person or situation for one's own advantage, often unfairly. It names the purpose, where manipulation names the method.
entries.definitionCN: 为自身利益而利用他人或局势，常带不公。它说的是目的，而 manipulation 说的是手段。

entries.definition: the power to affect how someone thinks or acts. It can be open and legitimate, where manipulation implies hidden or unfair control.
entries.definitionCN: 影响他人想法或行动的力量。它可以是公开合法的，而 manipulation 暗含隐蔽或不正当的控制。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: manipulus is a handful; manipulation is literally 'handling', and that is why the neutral medical and technical senses exist.
normal.cn: manipulus 是「一把」；manipulation 字面就是「用手操作」，正因如此才有中性的医学与技术义项。

normal.en: manus 'hand' also gives manual, manuscript and manufacture, and through Italian mano it gives manage.
normal.cn: manus「手」还给出 manual、manuscript、manufacture，并经意大利语 mano 给出 manage。

normal.en: The hostile sense is not in the root: it comes from treating a person like an object that can be moved by hand.
normal.cn: 贬义并不在词根里：它来自把一个人当作可以随手挪动的物件。

normal.en: The -ulation ending is the same action-noun pattern as in calculation and regulation.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ulation 与 calculation、regulation 中的动作名词构词方式相同。

normal.en: manipulation of data and images is the modern form of the old clay-in-the-hand image.
normal.cn: 对数据与图像的处理，就是「手里捏着泥」这一古老意象的现代形态。

abstract.en: Picture the shell game: the hand is quicker than the eye, and that gap is the whole idea of manipulation.
abstract.cn: 想象三壳游戏：手比眼快，这个时间差就是 manipulation 的全部含义。

abstract.en: The same hand can heal a joint or rig a market; only the purpose decides which sense is meant.
abstract.cn: 同一只手既能治好关节，也能操纵市场；只有目的决定取哪个义项。

abstract.en: Whenever the work is hidden, the word turns negative; whenever it is shown, it stays neutral.
abstract.cn: 只要操作是隐藏的，词就转贬；只要操作摆在明处，词就保持中性。

examples.en: The report accused the company of manipulation of its own share price.
examples.cn: 报告指控该公司操纵自家股价。

examples.en: Careful manipulation of the sample is needed to avoid contamination.
examples.cn: 必须小心操作样品，以免受到污染。

examples.en: Her manipulation of the conversation kept the real issue off the table.
examples.cn: 她对谈话的操控让真正的问题始终没被摆上桌面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抹泥铺雷神」——手里抹着泥，悄悄把雷埋到别人脚下 → manipulation 操纵、操作

root: 拉丁语 manipulus「一把、一束」＝manus「手」＋一个来源不确定的成分（一般认为与 plere「装满」有关）；中世纪拉丁语 manipulare「操作」→ manipulation。核心是「用手握着一把东西加工」，中性时是操作，把人也当作物件时就是操纵。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a hand working something it can hold. What changes is the material — people, clay, data, prices, genes, joints, tissue, or a hidden scheme — and whether the work is shown or concealed.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一只手在加工一件能握住的东西。变化的只是材料——人、泥、数据、价格、基因、关节、组织，或一个暗中的算计；以及这活是摆在明处还是藏着做。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands moving three shells so fast that the eye cannot follow.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手把三个壳挪得太快，眼睛跟不上。

branches.en: THE HOSTILE PAIR: handling a person like an object is manipulation, and hiding the handling makes it plain trickery.
branches.cn: 贬义的两端：把人当物件操作就是操纵，把操作藏起来就成了十足的诡计。

branches.en: NEUTRAL SKILL: the potter's or the surgeon's hand works the material openly and well.
branches.cn: 中性技巧：陶工或外科医生的手公开而熟练地加工材料。

branches.en: NEW MATERIALS: data, images and genes are handled through tools and code, where the word stays technical.
branches.cn: 新素材：数据、图像与基因通过工具和代码被操作，此处词义保持技术性。

branches.en: PRICES BY HAND: market manipulation means the movement was made by a hand, not caused by supply and demand.
branches.cn: 人为推动价格：市场操纵意味着这个变动是手做出来的，不是供求造成的。

branches.en: THERAPY AND SURGERY: controlled manual movement of joints or tissue, fully disclosed and wholly neutral.
branches.cn: 治疗与手术：对关节或组织有控制的手法活动，完全公开、完全中性。

intro.en: Manipulation is Latin manipul- plus -ation. The ending -ation, from Latin -atio, names an action or its result; the stem manipul- comes from manipulus 'a handful', built on manus 'hand'.
intro.cn: manipulation 是拉丁词干 manipul- 加 -ation。词尾 -ation 出自拉丁语 -atio，表示动作或其结果；词干 manipul- 来自 manipulus「一把」，建立在 manus「手」上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are manus 'hand' and manipulus 'a handful'; the second element of manipulus is of uncertain origin. The suffix -atio also appears in calculation, regulation and estimation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁成分是 manus「手」与 manipulus「一把」；manipulus 的第二成分来源不确定。后缀 -atio 也见于 calculation、regulation、estimation。

items.meaning: the act of handling or controlling
items.meaningCN: 操作、操纵的行为（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The manipulation of the results was obvious.
items.exampleCN: 对结果的操纵是显而易见的。

items.meaning: to handle skilfully, or to control unfairly
items.meaningCN: 熟练操作；以不正当手段操纵
items.example: He manipulated the settings to hide the error.
items.exampleCN: 他动手改了设置，把错误藏了起来。

items.meaning: tending to control others for one's own ends
items.meaningCN: 善于操控他人的；有操纵倾向的
items.example: His manipulative style alienated the team.
items.exampleCN: 他那种操控作风让团队疏远了。

items.meaning: a person who manipulates, or a device that handles objects
items.example: The robot has a precise manipulator arm.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器人有一条精确的操作臂。

items.meaning: able to be handled or altered
items.example: The variables are easily manipulable in the model.
items.exampleCN: 模型中的变量很容易调整。

items.meaning: done by hand, or a hand-held guide
items.meaningCN: 用手的；手册（manu- 表示手）
items.example: Manual labour built the first roads.
items.exampleCN: 最早的公路是靠人力修成的。

items.meaning: a text written by hand
items.example: The library keeps a medieval manuscript.
items.exampleCN: 这所图书馆藏有一部中世纪手稿。

items.meaning: to make goods, originally by hand
items.example: The plant manufactures parts for engines.
items.exampleCN: 这家工厂制造发动机零件。

items.meaning: to handle affairs, and so to direct or cope
items.meaningCN: 管理；设法应付（经意大利语 mano「手」而来）
items.example: She manages a team of twelve.
items.exampleCN: 她管理着一个十二人的团队。

items.meaning: a shackle for the hands
items.example: The prisoner's manacles were removed.
items.exampleCN: 囚犯的手铐被解开了。

latinEntries.structure: manus + second element (origin uncertain, often linked to plere 'to fill')
latinEntries.meaningCN: 一把；一束（第二成分来源不确定，常与 plere「装满」相联系）

latinEntries.meaning: to handle, to work with the hands
forms a noun of action or its result
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成动作或其结果的抽象名词

definition_zh: 可测量的；可量化的；明显的；可评估的；数学可测的；有限的；可对照标准度量的；测得出的
definition_en: able to be measured, expressible as a quantity, or large enough to be noticed on an instrument or a scale
core_image: 一把钢尺平贴在桌沿，缝隙的每一毫米都能读出数字
scene: The ruler lies flat against the edge of the table, and every millimetre of the gap can be read off: the gap is measurable.
sceneCN: 这里 measurable 是「可测量的」（第 1 个义项：可被仪器测定）；句意：尺子平贴在桌沿上，缝隙的每一毫米都能读出来，所以这条缝是可测量的。图中可辨识物件：钢尺、刻度线、桌沿、缝隙、读数标记。

pos.zh: 可测量的；可量化的；明显的；可评估的

collocations.zh: 可测量的改善；明显的进步

derivatives.zh: 测量；衡量（亦作名词：措施、尺度）
不可测量的；无法估量的

senses.title: Able to be measured by an instrument
senses.titleCN: 可测量的：能被仪器读出数值
senses.definition: able to be measured, so that a device or a scale can give a value for it
senses.definitionCN: 可以被测量，从而能用仪器或刻度给出数值的
senses.example: The crack is measurable with a feeler gauge.
senses.exampleCN: 这条裂缝可以用塞尺测出来。
senses.why: Measure comes from Latin mensura and metiri 'to measure'; -able marks capability. The adjective does not say the thing has been measured, only that it allows the act.
senses.whyCN: measure 出自拉丁语 mensura 与 metiri「测量」；-able 表示「能够」。这个形容词并不说某物已被测量，只说它允许这一动作发生。

senses.title: Expressible as a quantity: quantifiable
senses.titleCN: 可量化的：能写成数字
senses.definition: able to be expressed as a number or a quantity on a defined scale
senses.definitionCN: 能在确定的尺度上表示为数字或数量的
senses.example: Turn the goal into measurable terms before you assign it.
senses.exampleCN: 在分派目标之前，先把它变成可量化的说法。
senses.why: Once a thing can be measured, its amount can be written as a number. Measurable then shifts from 'able to be measured' to 'expressible as a quantity', which is how managers and scientists use it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某物可以测量，它的大小就能写成数字。measurable 于是从「能被测量」转为「能表示为数量」，管理者与科学家正是这样用的。

senses.title: Large enough to show on the instrument: appreciable
senses.titleCN: 明显可见：大到仪表能显示出来
senses.definition: large or clear enough to be detected, so that the change is not merely imagined
senses.definitionCN: 足够大或足够清楚，能被察觉出来，而不只是想象中的变化
senses.example: There was a measurable improvement in air quality after the ban.
senses.exampleCN: 禁令之后空气质量有了可测的改善。
senses.why: A difference that can be measured is, by that fact, not imaginary. English speakers therefore use measurable to mean 'noticeable', borrowing the authority of the instrument.
senses.whyCN: 能被测出的差异，按这一事实就不是想象出来的。因此英语用 measurable 表示「明显」，借的是仪器的权威。

senses.title: Able to be assessed or checked against a standard
senses.titleCN: 可评估的：能对照标准检验
senses.definition: able to be judged or verified because a criterion and a method of checking exist
senses.definitionCN: 因为存在评判标准与核查方法而可以被判断或验证的
senses.example: Every objective in the plan is measurable and time-bound.
senses.exampleCN: 计划中的每个目标都是可衡量且有期限的。
senses.why: If an outcome can be measured, it can be judged. The word moves from the instrument to the judgement, naming what a test is able to confirm.
senses.whyCN: 结果若能测量，就能评判。这个词从仪器转到判断上，指一项检验能够确认的东西。

senses.title: Measurable in mathematics: a set that can be given a size
senses.titleCN: 数学可测：可以赋予大小的集合
senses.definition: in measure theory, describing a set to which a size can be assigned consistently under the rules of the theory
senses.definitionCN: 在测度论中，指可以按该理论的规则一致地赋予大小的集合
senses.example: Not every set of points is measurable under this definition.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个定义下并非每个点集都是可测的。
senses.why: Mathematics takes the word literally. A measurable set is one the theory allows you to measure, and the discovery that some sets are not measurable is one of the founding results of the field.
senses.whyCN: 数学把这个词按字面使用。可测集就是理论允许你去测的集合；而「有些集合不可测」这一发现，正是该领域的奠基性结果之一。

senses.title: within measurable distance: near, not endless
senses.titleCN: 有限的距离：近到可以量，而非无穷远
senses.definition: in the phrase within measurable distance, close enough that the distance could actually be measured
senses.definitionCN: 在 within measurable distance（在可量出的距离之内）这一说法中，指近到距离真的可以被量出来
senses.example: The village is within measurable distance of the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子离海岸近得可以量出距离。
senses.why: Here the word limits rather than quantifies: if a distance is measurable, it is finite and short enough to matter. The idiom turns a technical capability into a statement about nearness.
senses.whyCN: 这里词的作用是限定而非计量：距离若可测，就是有限且近到有意义。这个习语把技术上的「可测」变成了对远近的判断。

senses.title: Measurable against a standard: comparable by one scale
senses.titleCN: 可对照标准度量：能用同一把尺比较
senses.definition: able to be compared with a standard or with another case because both yield values on the same scale
senses.definitionCN: 因为能在同一尺度上取值，故可与标准或另一案例相比较的
senses.example: The two systems are measurable against the same benchmark.
senses.exampleCN: 这两套系统可以用同一基准来度量比较。
senses.why: Comparison needs a common unit. Measurable against a standard says the thing yields a number on that scale, which is what makes the comparison fair rather than impressionistic.
senses.whyCN: 比较需要共同的单位。measurable against a standard（可对照某个标准来测量）意为该物能在那个尺度上给出数字，这才使比较公平，而不是凭印象。

senses.title: Of a definite size: a length that can be stated
senses.titleCN: 有确定尺寸：长度说得出来
senses.definition: having a size or extent that can be stated in units, rather than being vague or unlimited
senses.definitionCN: 具有可以用单位说出的尺寸或延展，而不是含糊无限
senses.example: He cut a measurable length of rope and tied it to the post.
senses.exampleCN: 他剪下一段说得清长度的绳子，系在柱子上。
senses.why: Here the word simply says a length exists and can be found with a rule. It is the plainest use of all: the object has an extent, and the extent has a number.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词只是说：长度确实存在，而且能用尺子找出来。这是最朴素的用法：物体有延展，延展有数字。

intro.en: Measurable is the English adjective measure plus -able. Measure was borrowed in the 14th century from Old French mesure, from Latin mensura, a noun from metiri 'to measure'. Metiri goes back to the reconstructed root *med- 'to measure, take appropriate size', which also underlies mode, moderate, modest and medicine. The -able form is recorded in the 16th century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: measurable 是英语形容词 measure 加 -able。measure 在 14 世纪借自古法语 mesure，源自拉丁语 mensura，是 metiri「测量」的名词形式。metiri 可追溯到重构词根 *med-「测量、取适当尺寸」，mode、moderate、modest、medicine 也源于此。加 -able 的形式在 16 世纪见于记载。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Management writing makes measurable objectives a fixed phrase, and the word becomes a test of whether a goal is worth stating.
items.cn: 管理学写作把 measurable objectives（可衡量的目标）变成固定说法，这个词随之成为判断目标是否值得提出的标准。

items.en: English measurable is recorded, formed inside English from measure plus -able rather than inherited whole from Latin.
items.cn: 英语 measurable 见于记载，是在英语内部由 measure 加 -able 构成的，而不是整体继承自拉丁语。

items.en: measure enters English through Old French mesure, naming a unit, a limit and the act of measuring.
items.cn: measure 经古法语 mesure 进入英语，兼指单位、限度与测量行为。

items.en: Latin mensura is the noun of metiri 'to measure', and metiri is the source of measure, dimension and commensurate.
items.cn: 拉丁语 mensura 是 metiri「测量」的名词形式，而 metiri 是 measure、dimension、commensurate 的来源。

items.en: The reconstructed root *med- 'to measure' also yields Latin modus 'measure, manner', hence mode and moderate; the asterisk marks a form never attested in writing.
items.cn: 重构词根 *med-「测量」也给出拉丁语 modus「尺度、方式」，进而有 mode 与 moderate；星号表示从未见于书面记载的形式。

note.en: The first group separates real relatives from a word that only looks similar; the second compares words that overlap part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与只是长得像的词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the learned Latin-derived form of the same idea, used in music and philosophy for what has measurable proportion. It shares mensura with measure but never replaced the English word.
entries.definitionCN: 同义的学术拉丁式形式，在音乐与哲学中指具有可测比例的。它与 measure 共享 mensura，但从未取代英语本来的 measurable。

entries.definition: to find the size of something, or a unit, limit or step taken. It is the base that measurable is built on, so the two differ only by the ability suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 求出某物的大小，或指单位、限度、所采取的措施。它是 measurable 所依附的词基，两者只差一个表示「能够」的后缀。

entries.definition: very unhappy or very poor in quality. It comes from Latin miser 'wretched', with no connection to measuring, and only happens to share the -able ending.
entries.definitionCN: 非常痛苦或质量极差。它出自拉丁语 miser「悲惨的」，与测量毫无关系，只是碰巧共享 -able 词尾。

entries.definition: able to be counted or expressed as a number. It stresses counting, while measurable stresses that an instrument or scale can take a reading.
entries.definitionCN: 能被计数或表示为数字。它强调计数，而 measurable 强调仪器或尺度能取得读数。

entries.definition: large enough to be noticed or felt. It covers the 'noticeable' sense of measurable but makes no claim that anything can be measured.
entries.definitionCN: 大到能被察觉或感觉到。它覆盖 measurable 的「明显」义，但并不主张任何东西可以被测量。

entries.definition: real and definite enough to be touched or clearly seen. It names concrete evidence, where measurable names the availability of a value.
entries.definitionCN: 真实具体到可以触碰或清楚看见。它指的是具体证据，而 measurable 指的是能取得数值。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: measure plus -able says 'able to be measured'; the suffix adds capability, never the claim that a reading was already taken.
normal.cn: measure 加 -able 意为「能够被测量」；后缀只加「能够」，从不表示读数已经取到。

normal.en: mensura is the Latin noun, and metiri the verb; measure, dimension and commensurate all descend from metiri.
normal.cn: mensura 是拉丁名词，metiri 是动词；measure、dimension、commensurate 都出自 metiri。

normal.en: Immeasurable is the direct negative, used both for what no instrument can reach and for feelings too large to count.
normal.cn: immeasurable 是直接的反义词，既用于仪器达不到的东西，也用于大到无法计量的感情。

normal.en: measurable, quantifiable and assessable form a chain: first a reading is possible, then a number, then a judgement.
normal.cn: measurable、quantifiable、assessable 构成一条链：先有读数可能，再有数字，最后有判断。

normal.en: The physics sense is literal: a measurable set is simply one the theory permits you to measure.
normal.cn: 物理学与数学的义项最字面：可测集就是理论允许你去测的集合。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid on a crack: the crack does not become real when measured, but it becomes arguable.
abstract.cn: 想象把尺子放在裂缝上：裂缝不会因为被量而变得真实，但它变得可以争论了。

abstract.en: Every extended sense asks whether a number can be produced, and by whom, on which scale.
abstract.cn: 每个引申义都在问：能不能产生一个数字，由谁产生，用哪把尺。

abstract.en: The word is a bridge between the world and the report: without it, claims stay private impressions.
abstract.cn: 这个词是现实与报告之间的桥：没有它，主张就只是私人的印象。

examples.en: The medicine produced a measurable drop in blood pressure.
examples.cn: 这种药使血压出现了可测的下降。

examples.en: Good research turns a vague question into a measurable one.
examples.cn: 好的研究把含糊的问题变成可测量的问题。

examples.en: The gap between the two groups was measurable but small.
examples.cn: 两组之间的差距可以测出，但很小。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「没辙若薄」——没辙时，若薄得能透光，好歹能量出厚度 → measurable 可测量的

root: 拉丁语 metiri「测量」→ mensura「尺度、测量」→ 古法语 mesure → 英语 measure；再加 -able（能够）→ measurable。核心是「有一把尺能搭上去，读得出数」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a ruler laid against something. What changes is what the ruler is laid on — a crack, a goal, a change, a claim, a mathematical set, a distance, a benchmark, or a length of rope.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：把一把尺搭在某物上。变化的只是尺搭在什么上——裂缝、目标、变化、主张、数学集合、距离、基准，还是一段绳子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steel ruler laid flat on the table edge, every millimetre readable.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把钢尺平贴在桌沿，每一毫米都读得出来。

branches.en: PHYSICAL POSSIBILITY: the object and the instrument are such that a reading can be taken at all.
branches.cn: 物理上的可能：物体与仪器都具备条件，读数才取得出来。

branches.en: THE NUMBER: what has a reading can be written as a quantity on a defined scale.
branches.cn: 数字：有读数的东西就能写成确定尺度上的数量。

branches.en: THE NOTICEABLE AND THE FINITE: the reading is large enough to see, and a measurable distance is one that ends.
branches.cn: 可见与有限：读数大到看得见；可测的距离则是有尽头的距离。

branches.en: THE JUDGEMENT: criteria, benchmarks and standards let a reading become an assessment or a fair comparison.
branches.cn: 判断：标准、基准与尺度让读数变成评估或公平比较。

branches.en: THE LITERAL EDGE: mathematics measures sets, and a plain length is simply an extent that can be stated in units.
branches.cn: 字面的两端：数学测的是集合，而朴素意义上的长度就是能用单位说出的延展。

intro.en: Measurable is measure plus -able. The suffix -able, from Latin -abilis, means 'capable of being'; measure itself comes from Latin mensura, the noun of metiri 'to measure'.
intro.cn: measurable 是 measure 加 -able。后缀 -able 出自拉丁语 -abilis，意为「可以被……的」；measure 本身来自拉丁语 mensura，即 metiri「测量」的名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are metiri 'to measure' and its noun mensura. metiri also gives dimension, commensurate and immense, all of which build on the idea of a measured extent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁成分是 metiri「测量」及其名词 mensura。metiri 还给出 dimension、commensurate、immense，全都建立在「被量出的延展」这一观念上。

items.meaning: able to be measured or expressed as a quantity
items.meaningCN: 可测量的；可量化的（-able 表示「可以被」）
items.example: The effect is measurable in a simple test.
items.exampleCN: 这个效应在一个简单测试中就可以测出。

items.meaning: to find the size of something, or a unit or step
items.meaningCN: 测量；亦指单位、尺度或措施
items.example: Measure the room before ordering the carpet.
items.exampleCN: 订地毯前先量一下房间。

items.meaning: the act of measuring, or the figure obtained
items.example: The measurement was off by two millimetres.
items.exampleCN: 这个测量值差了两毫米。

items.meaning: in a way that can be measured; noticeably
items.example: Output rose measurably after the change.
items.exampleCN: 改动之后产量有了可测的提升。

items.meaning: the quality of being measurable
items.example: The measurability of happiness is disputed.
items.exampleCN: 幸福是否可测，本身就有争议。

items.meaning: too large or too vague to be measured
items.meaningCN: 不可测量的；无法估量的（im- 表示否定）
items.example: The drought caused immeasurable harm.
items.exampleCN: 这场旱灾造成了无法估量的损害。

items.meaning: having measurable proportion, used in music and philosophy
items.meaningCN: 具有可测比例的（用于音乐与哲学）
items.example: Mensurable rhythm was central to medieval music.
items.exampleCN: 可计量的节律是中世纪音乐的核心。

items.meaning: a measured extent, such as length or width
items.meaningCN: 维度；尺寸（字面「量出的延展」）
items.example: Check the dimensions of the frame.
items.exampleCN: 核对一下框架的尺寸。

items.meaning: matching in size or degree
items.example: Pay should be commensurate with skill.
items.exampleCN: 报酬应与技能相称。

items.meaning: so large that it cannot be measured
items.meaningCN: 巨大的；无法计量的（字面「未被测量的」）
items.example: An immense crowd filled the square.
items.exampleCN: 庞大的人群挤满了广场。

latinEntries.meaning: a measuring, a measure, a standard

definition_zh: 测量；测量结果；尺寸；度量单位体系；测定方法；评估；身体尺寸；测量误差；测量数据
definition_en: the act or process of measuring something, the figure or size obtained, or a system of units used for measuring
core_image: 木匠把卷尺拉过木板，把读数写进小本子
scene: The carpenter pulls the tape across the board and writes the number in his notebook: that number is one measurement.
sceneCN: 这里 measurement 是「测得的尺寸」（第 2 个义项：测量结果）；句意：木匠把卷尺拉过木板，把那个数字写进本子，这个数字就是一次测量结果。图中可辨识物件：卷尺、木板、笔记本、铅笔、刻度数字。

pos.zh: 测量；测量结果；尺寸；度量体系；测定方法

forms.label: 单数（一次测量或测量这件事）
复数（多处尺寸或多组数据）

senses.title: The act of measuring: taking a reading
senses.titleCN: 测量行为：取一个读数
senses.definition: the act or process of finding the size, amount or extent of something with an instrument
senses.definitionCN: 用仪器求出某物大小、数量或延展的过程
senses.example: Careful measurement of the sample took an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 仔细测量这个样本花了一小时。
senses.why: The suffix -ment, from Latin -mentum, names the act or its product. This first sense keeps the act: the tape is stretched and a value is sought.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ment 出自拉丁语 -mentum，表示动作或其产物。第一个义项保留动作义：卷尺被拉开，人们要找一个数值。

senses.title: The result: a figure or size obtained
senses.titleCN: 测量结果：得到的数字或尺寸
senses.definition: the figure, size or amount obtained by measuring
senses.definitionCN: 测量得到的数字、尺寸或数量
senses.example: The measurements show a room of about thirty square metres.
senses.exampleCN: 测量结果显示这个房间约三十平方米。
senses.why: The same suffix also names what the act leaves behind. Once the tape is folded away, the number remains, and that number is also called a measurement.
senses.whyCN: 同一个后缀也指动作留下的东西。卷尺收起来之后，数字仍然在，这个数字同样叫 measurement。

senses.title: A system of units used for measuring
senses.titleCN: 度量体系：用于测量的单位系统
senses.definition: a system of units and standards by which quantities are expressed, such as the metric system
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示数量的单位与标准体系，如公制
senses.example: The laboratory converted all readings to the metric system of measurement.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室把所有读数都换算成公制计量体系。
senses.why: A number means nothing without a unit. The word therefore also names the shared scale itself, the system that makes readings comparable between labs and countries.
senses.whyCN: 没有单位，数字毫无意义。因此这个词也指共享的尺度本身，即让不同实验室、不同国家的读数可以互比的那套体系。

senses.title: The method or instrument used to measure
senses.titleCN: 测定方法：用何种手段量
senses.definition: the technique or instrument by which a quantity is determined, as in a measurement technique
senses.definitionCN: 确定某一数量的技术或仪器，如某种测量技术
senses.example: They changed the measurement method to reduce noise in the data.
senses.exampleCN: 他们改换了测量方法以减少数据中的噪声。
senses.why: The word moves from the act to the means of the act. Asking about 'the measurement used' is asking which procedure produced the number.
senses.whyCN: 词从动作转到动作的手段。问「用的是什么测量」，问的就是哪个流程产出了这个数字。

senses.title: Assessment: measuring performance or quality
senses.titleCN: 评估：把表现或质量当成量来测
senses.definition: the assessment of performance, quality or progress as if it were a quantity
senses.definitionCN: 把表现、质量或进展当作数量来评估
senses.example: Measurement of teacher performance is itself controversial.
senses.exampleCN: 对教师表现的评估本身就很有争议。
senses.why: What cannot be held with a tape can still be treated as a quantity. The word extends from physical size to judgement, and keeps the authority of the instrument.
senses.whyCN: 卷尺量不了的东西仍可被当作数量来处理。这个词从物理尺寸延伸到判断，同时保留了仪器的权威感。

senses.title: Body measurements: sizes taken for clothing
senses.titleCN: 身体尺寸：做衣服时量的三围
senses.definition: the set of body sizes taken with a tape, used for making or buying clothes
senses.definitionCN: 用软尺量出的一组身体尺寸，用于做衣或买衣
senses.example: The tailor took my measurements before cutting the cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 裁缝在裁布之前先量了我的尺寸。
senses.why: Here measurements is plural because a body yields several figures. The word keeps its plain physical sense but names a set rather than a single value.
senses.whyCN: 这里用复数，因为一具身体会得到好几个数字。词仍保留朴素的物理义，只是指一组值而非单个值。

senses.title: Precision measurement: readings and their error
senses.titleCN: 精密计量：读数与它的误差
senses.definition: the technical process of obtaining precise values, considered together with instrument error and uncertainty
senses.definitionCN: 获得精确数值的技术过程，并连同仪器误差与不确定度一起考虑
senses.example: Every measurement carries an uncertainty that must be reported.
senses.exampleCN: 每次测量都带有一个必须报告的不确定度。
senses.why: In metrology the word names a physical process with limits. Since no instrument is perfect, a measurement is always a value plus an admitted range of doubt.
senses.whyCN: 在计量学中，这个词指一个有极限的物理过程。仪器都不完美，所以测量永远是数值加上一个被承认的误差范围。

senses.title: Recorded readings: the data set
senses.titleCN: 测量数据：记录下来的一整套读数
senses.definition: the recorded set of readings taken during an experiment or survey
senses.definitionCN: 在一次实验或调查中记录下来的一整套读数
senses.example: The raw measurements were stored before any analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 原始测量数据在任何分析之前先被存了下来。
senses.why: Once readings are written down they become data. The plural then names a collection, and the word sits between the act of measuring and the analysis that follows.
senses.whyCN: 读数一旦写下就成了数据。复数于是指一个集合，而这个词正处在测量动作与随后分析之间的位置上。

intro.en: Measurement is the English noun measure plus -ment, from Latin -mentum, which names an act or its result. Measure came into English in the 14th century through Old French mesure from Latin mensura, the noun of metiri 'to measure'. The compound measurement is recorded in the 18th century, when scientific instruments made repeated readings a routine matter. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: measurement 是英语名词 measure 加 -ment，后者出自拉丁语 -mentum，表示动作或其结果。measure 在 14 世纪经古法语 mesure 进入英语，源自拉丁语 mensura，即 metiri「测量」的名词。measurement 这一复合形式在 18 世纪见于记载，当时科学仪器使反复读数成为常规。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Metric conventions and national standards bureaus make measurement a public, regulated activity rather than a craftsman's habit.
items.cn: 公制惯例与各国标准局的建立，使测量从工匠的习惯变成公共的、受规范的活动。

items.en: English measurement is recorded, formed from measure plus -ment as instruments and experiments spread.
items.cn: 英语 measurement 见于记载，随仪器与实验的普及由 measure 加 -ment 构成。

items.en: measure is borrowed through Old French mesure and covers a unit, a limit and the act of measuring.
items.cn: measure 经古法语 mesure 借入，兼指单位、限度与测量行为。

items.en: mensura is the noun of metiri; the same verb gives dimension, commensurate and immense.
items.cn: mensura 是 metiri 的名词形式；同一个动词还给出 dimension、commensurate、immense。

items.en: metiri rests on the reconstructed root *med- 'to measure, take the right size', which also gives modus and hence mode and moderate.
items.cn: metiri 建立在重构词根 *med-「测量、取恰当尺寸」上，该词根也给出 modus，进而有 mode 与 moderate。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives from a word that merely looks technical; the second compares words used in neighbouring parts of the same task.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与只是看起来专业的词分开；第二组比较同一件事相邻环节上的词。

entries.definition: the verb 'to find the size of' and the noun for a unit, limit or legislative step. Measurement is only the act or result, while measure also names the standard and the policy.
entries.definitionCN: 动词「测量」，名词指单位、限度或立法措施。measurement 只指动作或结果，而 measure 还指标准与政策措施。

entries.definition: the branch of geometry dealing with lengths, areas and volumes, or the act of measuring in a formal sense. It is the learned Latin-style counterpart, confined to technical writing.
entries.definitionCN: 研究长度、面积与体积的几何分支，或正式意义上的测量行为。它是学术性的拉丁式对应词，只用于技术写作。

entries.definition: a measurable extent such as length, width or height. It comes from dis- plus metiri, so it shares the measuring verb but names an extent rather than the act of measuring it.
entries.definitionCN: 可测量的延展，如长、宽、高。它由 dis- 加 metiri 构成，共享「测量」这个动词，但指延展本身，而不是测量的动作。

entries.definition: the act of judging the value or quality of something. It overlaps the figurative sense of measurement but does not require numbers.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物价值或质量的判断。它与 measurement 的引申义重叠，但不要求有数字。

entries.definition: the figure shown by an instrument at a moment. It is one measurement in the narrowest sense, taken off a dial or a display.
entries.definitionCN: 仪器在某一刻显示的数字。它是最狭义的一次测量，取自表盘或显示屏。

entries.definition: a defined indicator used to judge performance. It is a measurement chosen for a purpose, where measurement is the general obtaining of values.
entries.definitionCN: 用于评判表现的确定指标。它是为某个目的选定的测量，而 measurement 是一般的取值过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -ment gives both faces of the word: the act of measuring and the figure that the act leaves behind.
normal.cn: -ment 给出这个词的两面：测量的动作，以及动作留下的数字。

normal.en: measure is the verb and the general noun; measurement is specifically the act or the result, never the policy.
normal.cn: measure 是动词兼一般名词；measurement 专指动作或结果，从不指政策措施。

normal.en: A measurement without a unit is just a number, which is why the word also names the system of units.
normal.cn: 没有单位的测量只是一个数字，所以这个词也指单位体系。

normal.en: The plural measurements usually means a set: body sizes, or a table of readings from an experiment.
normal.cn: 复数 measurements 通常指一个集合：身体尺寸，或实验读出的一整表数值。

normal.en: Measurement error is not a mistake but the admitted uncertainty that comes with every instrument.
normal.cn: measurement error（测量误差）不是错误，而是每件仪器都带来的、被承认的不确定度。

abstract.en: See a tape stretched, a number written, and a unit agreed: the three parts of every measurement.
abstract.cn: 想象卷尺拉开、数字写下、单位约定：这就是每次测量的三个部分。

abstract.en: The word travels from hand to page to report, and loses nothing but gains a claim to objectivity.
abstract.cn: 这个词从手上走到纸面再走到报告，什么也没丢，却获得了一种客观性的主张。

abstract.en: Whenever someone says 'by measurement', ask which instrument and which unit did the speaking.
abstract.cn: 每当有人说「按测量」，就该问：是哪件仪器、哪个单位在说话。

examples.en: Repeated measurement reduced the effect of random error.
examples.cn: 反复测量减小了随机误差的影响。

examples.en: The engineer sent the measurements to the factory.
examples.cn: 工程师把尺寸数据发给了工厂。

examples.en: Their claim rests on a single measurement taken at noon.
examples.cn: 他们的结论建立在正午所做的一次测量上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「没辙门特」——没辙时也得把门特（门）量一遍 → measurement 测量、尺寸

root: 拉丁语 metiri「测量」→ mensura「尺度」→ 古法语 mesure → 英语 measure；加 -ment（拉丁 -mentum，表示动作或结果）→ measurement。核心是「量这一动作，以及量出来的那个数」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a tape pulled across something. What changes is which part of the event is named — the pulling, the number, the agreed unit, the method, the judgement, the body being fitted, the error, or the whole table of readings.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一条卷尺拉过某物。变化的只是命名了这件事的哪一段——拉尺的动作、数字、约定的单位、方法、判断、被量身的身体、误差，还是整张读数表。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a carpenter's tape stretched across a board, the figure written down.
core.cn: 核心意象：木匠的卷尺拉过木板，数字被写下来。

branches.en: THE ACT: the tape is stretched and a value is sought, which is measuring as an activity.
branches.cn: 动作：卷尺拉开去找一个值，这就是作为活动的测量。

branches.en: THE PRODUCT: one figure, or the whole recorded table of figures left after the act.
branches.cn: 产物：单个数字，或动作结束后留下的整张记录表。

branches.en: THE SHARED SCALE: units and standards make one lab's number comparable with another's.
branches.cn: 共享尺度：单位与标准让一个实验室的数字可与另一个实验室的比较。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENT AND ITS LIMIT: the method produces the value, and every method brings its own uncertainty.
branches.cn: 仪器及其极限：方法产出数值，而每种方法都带来自己的不确定度。

branches.en: THE BODY AND THE JUDGEMENT: sizes taken for a suit, and performance treated as if it could be measured.
branches.cn: 身体与判断：为做衣量出的尺寸，以及被当作可测量的表现。

intro.en: Measurement is measure plus -ment, from Latin -mentum. That suffix names an act (as in movement) or its result (as in document), and measurement uses both faces.
intro.cn: measurement 是 measure 加 -ment，出自拉丁语 -mentum。这个后缀表示动作（如 movement「移动」）或其结果（如 document「文件」），measurement 两面都用上了。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is metiri 'to measure' with its noun mensura. The suffix -mentum also appears in document, monument and argument.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 metiri「测量」及其名词 mensura。后缀 -mentum 也见于 document「文件」、monument「纪念碑」、argument「论点」。

items.meaning: the act of measuring, or the figure obtained
items.example: The measurement was repeated three times.
items.exampleCN: 这次测量重复了三遍。

items.meaning: to find the size of, or a unit, limit or step
items.meaningCN: 测量；亦指单位、限度或措施
items.example: They measured the depth of the well.
items.exampleCN: 他们量了井的深度。

items.meaning: able to be measured
items.example: The gain was measurable within a month.
items.exampleCN: 一个月内就有了可测的增益。

items.meaning: by a measurable amount
items.example: The room grew measurably quieter.
items.exampleCN: 房间明显安静了下来。

items.meaning: the quality of being measurable
items.example: The measurability of pain is limited.
items.exampleCN: 疼痛的可测性是有限的。

items.meaning: having no limits that can be measured
items.meaningCN: 无边无际的；无法计量的
items.example: They crossed a measureless plain.
items.exampleCN: 他们穿过一片无边无际的平原。

items.structure: the same noun used for the technical process
items.meaning: the regulated process of obtaining values with instruments
items.meaningCN: 用仪器取得数值的规范过程
items.example: Measurement standards protect trade.
items.exampleCN: 测量标准保护着贸易。

items.meaning: the formal or geometric measuring of lengths, areas and volumes
items.meaningCN: 测量术；几何中的长度面积体积计算
items.example: Mensuration is taught with areas and volumes.
items.exampleCN: 测量术是随面积与体积一起教的。

items.meaning: a measured extent such as length
items.example: Length is one dimension of the box.

items.meaning: measured by the same standard, and so proportionate

definition_zh: 方法论；一套研究方法；研究设计；操作规程；软件开发方法；教学法；分析框架；论文方法部分
definition_en: the study of methods and the principles behind them, or a particular organised set of methods used in a field of research or work
core_image: 桌上摊开一张画满箭头与步骤的路线图，每个岔口都标着为何这样走
scene: On the desk lies a map of arrows and steps, each fork labelled with the reason for taking it: that map is the methodology.
sceneCN: 这里 methodology 是「一套研究方法」（第 2 个义项：方法体系）；句意：桌上摊着一张画满箭头与步骤的图，每个岔口都标出选择它的理由，这张图就是一套研究方法。图中可辨识物件：路线图、箭头、步骤编号、岔口标注、桌上的笔。

pos.zh: 方法论；一套研究方法；研究设计；操作规程
