senses.title: The study of methods: theory of how inquiry works
senses.titleCN: 方法论：研究「方法如何运作」的学问
senses.definition: the branch of study concerned with the principles, rules and assumptions behind methods of inquiry
senses.definitionCN: 研究探究方法背后的原则、规则与假设的学问分支
senses.example: Her book is about the methodology of social science, not about any single technique.
senses.exampleCN: 她这本书讲的是社会科学的方法论，而不是某一种具体技术。
senses.why: Greek methodos is a 'way of pursuit' and -logia is 'study of'. Methodology therefore names the study of ways, the theory of method, not one way among them.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 methodos 是「追寻的路径」，-logia 是「研究」。因此 methodology 指对路径的研究，即方法的理论，而不是众多路径中的一条。

senses.title: An organised set of methods used in practice
senses.titleCN: 一套方法：实际工作中成体系的方法
senses.definition: a particular organised set of methods and rules used by a research group, a discipline or an industry
senses.definitionCN: 某一研究群体、学科或行业所使用的一整套成体系的方法与规则
senses.example: The team adopted a mixed methodology combining surveys and interviews.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队采用了一套问卷与访谈相结合的混合方法。
senses.why: By transfer, the name of the study of methods came to mean a set of methods. Strict usage still keeps the two apart, but in ordinary writing the concrete set is the common sense.
senses.whyCN: 经过转移，「对方法的研究」这一名称也指一套方法。严格用法仍把两者分开，但在日常写作中，具体的方法组合才是常见义。

senses.title: Research design: the whole plan of a study
senses.titleCN: 研究设计：一项研究的整体安排
senses.definition: the overall plan of a study, covering sampling, instruments, procedure and analysis
senses.definitionCN: 一项研究的整体安排，涵盖取样、工具、流程与分析
senses.example: The methodology explains why the sample was chosen this way.
senses.exampleCN: 研究方法部分解释了为何这样选择样本。
senses.why: A research design is a methodology in the concrete sense: it fixes which methods are used, in what order, on whom. The map image fits exactly, since every fork is a choice.
senses.whyCN: 研究设计就是具体意义上的方法论：它确定用哪些方法、以什么顺序、用在谁身上。路线图的意象正好贴合，因为每个岔口都是一次选择。

senses.title: A documented procedure in industry
senses.titleCN: 操作规程：行业中有文件规定的工作方法
senses.definition: a documented standard procedure adopted by an industry or organisation for carrying out work
senses.definitionCN: 某一行业或组织为开展工作而采用的、有文件规定的标准流程
senses.example: The factory follows a quality methodology laid down by the regulator.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂遵循监管机构规定的质量工作方法。
senses.why: Industry borrows the academic word for any written, repeatable procedure. The emphasis is no longer theory but the fact that the steps are fixed and can be audited.
senses.whyCN: 行业把这个学术词借来指任何成文、可重复的流程。重心不再是理论，而是步骤被固定下来、可以核查这一事实。

senses.title: A software development methodology
senses.titleCN: 开发方法：软件工程的整套做法
senses.definition: a named school of practice for building software, such as agile or waterfall development
senses.definitionCN: 建软件的某一有名做法流派，如敏捷开发或瀑布开发
senses.example: The company switched its development methodology last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司去年更换了开发方法。
senses.why: Software engineering names whole schools of practice methodologies because each school lays down roles, ceremonies, documents and order of work, which is exactly a method system.
senses.whyCN: 软件工程把整套做法流派称作 methodology，因为每个流派都规定了角色、仪式、文档与工作顺序，这正是一套方法体系。

senses.title: Teaching methodology: the systematic study of instruction
senses.titleCN: 教学法：对怎么教做系统研究
senses.definition: the systematic study or a chosen system of teaching methods and their effects on learning
senses.definitionCN: 对教学方式及其学习效果的系统研究，或指所选定的那一套教学方式
senses.example: The course combines language teaching methodology with classroom practice.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把语言教学法与课堂实践结合起来。
senses.why: Teaching methodology is the systematic study of how teaching is done, and by extension the approach itself. The -logia element keeps the claim of a reasoned study rather than a bag of tricks.
senses.whyCN: 教学法是对「怎么教」的系统研究，引申而指这一做法本身。-logia 这一成分保留了「有理由的研究」的主张，而不是一堆窍门。

senses.title: An analytical framework: fixed steps of analysis
senses.titleCN: 分析框架：把分析步骤固定下来
senses.definition: a framework that fixes the steps and categories by which material is analysed
senses.definitionCN: 固定分析材料所依步骤与类别的框架
senses.example: The paper applies a discourse methodology to the interviews.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文对访谈材料运用了一套话语分析框架。
senses.why: An analytical framework is a methodology because it decides in advance what counts as a category and in what order categories are applied. The map is drawn before the walk.
senses.whyCN: 分析框架之所以是方法论，因为它事先决定什么算一个类别、类别按什么顺序使用。地图是在走路之前画好的。

senses.title: The methods section of a paper
senses.titleCN: 论文的「方法」部分
senses.definition: the section of a research paper that describes how the study was carried out, often headed Methodology
senses.definitionCN: 研究论文中描述研究如何进行的部分，常以 Methodology 为标题
senses.example: The methodology section must report how participants were recruited.
senses.exampleCN: 方法部分必须报告参与者是如何招募的。
senses.why: Journals label this part Methodology because it explains the way the work was done. Here the word names a place in the paper, not the theory behind the place.
senses.whyCN: 期刊把这部分标为 Methodology，因为它说明工作是如何做的。此处这个词指的是论文中的一个位置，而不是这个位置背后的理论。

intro.en: Methodology joins Greek methodos 'pursuit of knowledge, way of inquiry' with -logia 'study of'. Methodos is meta- 'after, beyond' plus hodos 'way, road'. The English word is a learned coinage of around 1800, at first naming the philosophy of method; the looser sense 'a set of methods' spread in the 20th century and is often criticised by careful writers. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: methodology 由希腊语 methodos「追寻知识、探究之路」加 -logia「研究」构成。methodos 是 meta-「在后、超出」加 hodos「路、道路」。这个英语词是 1800 年前后的学术新造词，最初指方法哲学；较宽松的「一套方法」义在 20 世纪扩散，常被严谨的作者批评。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Methodology spreads as a synonym for 'method or method set' in social science, business and software, and style guides begin to object.
items.cn: methodology 在社会科学、商业与软件领域扩散为「方法或方法组合」的同义词，文体指南开始提出反对。

items.en: The word settles in philosophy and the sciences as the name for the theory of method, distinct from any single technique.
items.cn: 这个词在哲学与科学中定型，指方法的理论，区别于任何单项技术。

items.en: English methodology is coined from Greek elements, following the pattern of other -logy words in learned writing.
items.cn: 英语 methodology 用希腊语成分造出，沿用了学术写作中其他 -logy 词的构词方式。

items.en: methodos 'way of inquiry' is meta- 'after, beyond' plus hodos 'way'; -logia is 'study, discourse' from logos.
items.cn: methodos「探究之路」由 meta-「在后、超出」与 hodos「路」构成；-logia 出自 logos，意为「研究、论述」。

items.en: Latin methodus carries the Greek word into European learning, and English method arrives through it in the 16th century.
items.cn: 拉丁语 methodus 把这个希腊词带入欧洲学术，英语 method 在 16 世纪经它进入英语。

note.en: The first group separates the true relatives from two -ology words that only rhyme with it; the second compares words that name neighbouring levels of planning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与两个只是押韵的 -ology 词分开；第二组比较处于相邻规划层级的词。

entries.definition: a particular procedure for doing something. It is one way, while methodology is either the study of ways or a whole system of them.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的具体程序。它是一条路，而 methodology 要么是对路的研究，要么是整套的路。

entries.definition: the science of measurement and its units. Its second element is metron 'measure', not hodos 'way', so it belongs with metre and metric rather than with method.
entries.definitionCN: 研究测量及其单位的科学。它的第二成分是 metron「尺度」，不是 hodos「路」，因此它与 metre、metric 同族，而与 method 无关。

entries.definition: the science of weather. It comes from meteōron 'a thing raised up in the air', not from methodos, and shares only the -logia ending.
entries.definitionCN: 研究天气的科学。它出自 meteōron「升到空中的东西」，并非来自 methodos，只共享 -logia 词尾。

entries.definition: a general way of thinking about or dealing with a problem. It is broader and looser than methodology, which implies explicit rules.
entries.definitionCN: 处理问题的总体思路。它比 methodology 更宽更松，后者暗含明确的规则。

entries.definition: an established sequence of steps for a task. It is the practical execution, where methodology is the reasoned system behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 为完成一项任务而定下的步骤顺序。它是实际执行，而 methodology 是背后的有理据体系。

entries.definition: a structure of concepts or categories within which analysis is done. It may be a methodology, but it stresses the arrangement rather than the rules of method.
entries.definitionCN: 进行分析时所依的概念或类别结构。它可能是一套方法论，但强调的排布方式而非方法规则。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: methodos is 'a way of pursuit' and -logia is 'study', so methodology literally means the study of ways.
normal.cn: methodos 是「追寻的路径」，-logia 是「研究」，所以 methodology 字面就是「对路径的研究」。

normal.en: hodos 'way' is the second half of method; the first half is meta- 'after, beyond', which is also the meta- of metaphor and metaphysics.
normal.cn: hodos「路」是 method 的后半；前半 meta-「在后、超出」也是 metaphor 与 metaphysics 里的 meta-。

normal.en: Metrology and meteorology rhyme but do not belong: one is about metron 'measure', the other about things high in the air.
normal.cn: metrology 与 meteorology 只是押韵，并非同族：一个关于 metron「尺度」，一个关于空中的东西。

normal.en: Strictly, methodology is the study of method; a set of methods is a method or a method system, which careful writers prefer.
normal.cn: 严格来说，methodology 是对方法的研究；一套方法就是 method 或方法体系，严谨的作者更愿意这样说。

normal.en: The same -logia ending builds biology, geology, psychology and technology, all naming a field of study.
normal.cn: 同一个 -logia 词尾造出 biology、geology、psychology、technology，都指一个研究领域。

abstract.en: Picture a map drawn before a journey: methodology is the map with reasons written at every fork.
abstract.cn: 想象出发前画好的地图：methodology 就是每个岔口都写着理由的那张图。

abstract.en: A single path is a method; the map of paths and the rules for choosing is the methodology.
abstract.cn: 一条路是 method；所有路的地图以及选择的规则才是 methodology。

abstract.en: The word is always asking who decided the steps, and on what grounds.
abstract.cn: 这个词总在追问：这些步骤是谁定的，凭的是什么。

examples.en: Reviewers rejected the paper because its methodology was unclear.
examples.cn: 评审拒了这篇论文，因为它的方法体系不清楚。

examples.en: The two laboratories use different methodologies for the same test.
examples.cn: 这两个实验室对同一项检测使用不同的方法体系。

examples.en: She teaches methodology to students who already know several methods.
examples.cn: 她给已经掌握若干方法的学生讲授方法论。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「没瑟得乐极」——没辙时把方法排成一条路，谁走谁乐 → methodology 方法论

root: 希腊语 methodos「探究之路」＝meta-「在后、超出」＋hodos「路」，加 -logia「研究、论述」（出自 logos）。核心是「把走路的方式本身拿来研究，并画成一张有理由的路线图」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a map of routes with reasons written at each fork. What changes is who holds the map — a philosopher of science, a research team, an industry, a software house, a teacher, an analyst, or the methods section of a paper.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一张在每条岔口写明理由的路线图。变化的只是谁拿着这张图——科学哲学家、研究团队、行业、软件公司、教师、分析者，还是论文的方法部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a route map spread on a desk, every fork labelled with a reason.
core.cn: 核心意象：摊在桌上的路线图，每个岔口都标着理由。

branches.en: THE THEORY: methodos plus -logia gives the study of ways of inquiry, which is the strict sense.
branches.cn: 理论：methodos 加 -logia 得出对探究之路的研究，这是严格义。

branches.en: THE CONCRETE SET: a research group's methods, and the whole design that orders them, are called a methodology by transfer.
branches.cn: 具体的组合：研究团队所用的一批方法，以及为它们排序的整体设计，经转移也称为一套方法论。

branches.en: THE DOCUMENTED PROCEDURE: industry writes the map down so that the steps can be repeated and audited.
branches.cn: 成文的规程：行业把这张图写下来，使步骤可重复、可核查。

branches.en: THE SCHOOLS: software and teaching each name whole schools of practice, because each fixes roles and order.
branches.cn: 流派：软件与教学各自命名整套做法流派，因为每个流派都固定了角色与顺序。

branches.en: THE FRAMEWORK AND THE SECTION: an analysis fixes categories in advance, and a paper reports the route taken.
branches.cn: 框架与章节：分析事先固定类别，论文则报告所走的路线。

intro.en: Methodology is method plus -ology, the learned suffix from Greek -logia 'study of'. Method itself comes from Greek methodos through Latin methodus, so the whole word is Greek in its pieces and modern in its assembly.
intro.cn: methodology 是 method 加 -ology，这个学术后缀出自希腊语 -logia「对……的研究」。method 本身经拉丁语 methodus 来自希腊语 methodos，因此整词成分是希腊的，组装却是现代的。

latinIntro.en: The Greek pieces are meta- 'after, beyond', hodos 'way', and logos 'word, reason', which gives -logia. Latin methodus is only the carrier that brought method into English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分是 meta-「在后、超出」、hodos「路」以及 logos「言说、理性」——后者给出 -logia。拉丁语 methodus 只是把 method 带进英语的载体。

items.meaning: the study of methods, or a system of methods
items.example: The methodology must match the research question.
items.exampleCN: 方法体系必须与研究问题相匹配。

items.meaning: a way of doing something
items.example: They chose a simple method for sampling.
items.exampleCN: 他们选了一种简单的取样方法。

items.meaning: orderly and systematic in behaviour
items.example: He kept methodical notes of every trial.
items.exampleCN: 他把每次试验都记得很有条理。

items.meaning: in an orderly, step-by-step way
items.example: She methodically checked each sample.
items.exampleCN: 她有步骤地检查了每个样本。

items.meaning: relating to methodology
items.example: The objection is methodological, not factual.
items.exampleCN: 这个反对意见属于方法层面，不是事实层面。

items.meaning: a specialist in methods of inquiry
items.meaningCN: 方法论研究者；方法学家
items.example: A methodologist reviewed the survey design.
items.exampleCN: 一位方法学家审阅了调查设计。

items.meaning: the study of living things
items.example: Biology was her first subject.
items.exampleCN: 生物学是她的第一门学科。

items.meaning: the study of the earth's structure
items.example: Geology explains the layers of the canyon.
items.exampleCN: 地质学解释了峡谷的岩层。

items.meaning: the study of the mind and behaviour
items.example: Psychology studies how people decide.
items.exampleCN: 心理学研究人如何做决定。

items.meaning: the study and application of practical arts
items.meaningCN: 技术；工艺学（technē 表示技艺）
items.example: Technology changed how the survey was done.
items.exampleCN: 技术改变了调查的进行方式。

latinEntries.meaning: a pursuit, a way of inquiry

definition_zh: 方法论的；方法上的；方法论层面的；方法学上的；方法严谨的；学科方法论的；方法论个人主义的；方法多元的
definition_en: relating to methodology, that is, to the principles and rules by which methods of inquiry are chosen and justified
core_image: 一张路线图被放到灯下，人们争论的不是哪条路好走，而是这张图本身画得对不对
scene: The map is placed under a lamp, and the argument is no longer about which road to take but about how the map was drawn: that argument is methodological.
sceneCN: 这里 methodological 是「方法论层面的」（第 3 个义项：方法论层面的争论）；句意：地图被放到灯下，争论的不再是该走哪条路，而是这张图本身是怎么画的，这就是方法论层面的争论。图中可辨识物件：地图、台灯、放大镜、岔口标注、指向图面的两只手。

pos.zh: 方法论的；方法上的；方法论层面的

derivatives.zh: 在方法论上；从方法角度

senses.title: Relating to the theory of methods
senses.titleCN: 方法论的：关于方法理论的
senses.definition: relating to methodology as the study of the principles behind methods of inquiry
senses.definitionCN: 指与作为「研究方法背后原则之研究」的方法论有关的
senses.example: The book's contribution is methodological rather than empirical.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书的贡献在于方法论，而不在于实证。
senses.why: Methodology plus -ical gives a relating adjective. The word points at the theory of method, so a methodological point is about how inquiry should be set up, not about what was found.
senses.whyCN: methodology 加 -ical 构成关系形容词。这个词指向方法的理论，因此「方法论上的观点」说的是探究应如何设置，而不是发现了什么。

senses.title: Of the methods used in a particular study
senses.titleCN: 方法上的：关于某项研究所用的方法
senses.definition: relating to the specific methods and procedures adopted in a study, as opposed to its subject matter
senses.definitionCN: 指与某项研究具体采用的方法和程序有关，而非与其研究对象有关
senses.example: The two papers differ on methodological grounds: one uses interviews, the other surveys.
senses.exampleCN: 这两篇论文的差别在方法上：一篇用访谈，一篇用问卷。
senses.why: Here the adjective descends from theory to practice and simply means 'of the methods used'. The same form covers both the abstract principles and the concrete instruments.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词从理论落到实践，只表示「所用的方法之属」。同一形式既覆盖抽象原则，也覆盖具体工具。

senses.title: A debate about how research is done
senses.titleCN: 方法论层面的：争论的是做法本身
senses.definition: describing a disagreement about how research should be conducted rather than about its results
senses.definitionCN: 指关于研究应如何进行的争论，而不是关于研究结果的争论
senses.example: The quarrel between the two schools is methodological, not political.
senses.exampleCN: 两个学派之间的争执是方法论层面的，不是政治性的。
senses.why: When scholars disagree about whether to count or to interpret, the dispute is not about facts but about the rules for producing facts. English marks that level with this adjective.
senses.whyCN: 当学者争论该计数还是该解释时，争的不是事实，而是产生事实的规则。英语用这个形容词标记这一层级。

senses.title: A methodological flaw: a fault in the design
senses.titleCN: 方法学缺陷：设计本身的毛病
senses.definition: describing a weakness in the design, sampling or analysis that undermines a study's conclusions
senses.definitionCN: 指研究设计、取样或分析中的弱点，足以削弱其结论
senses.example: Reviewers found a methodological flaw in the sampling procedure.
senses.exampleCN: 评审在取样程序中发现了一处方法学缺陷。
senses.why: A flaw is methodological when the results might be right but the route to them was faulty. The word locates the error in the plan, not in the data.
senses.whyCN: 当结果也许没错、但通往结果的路线有问题时，缺陷就是方法学上的。这个词把错误定位在计划里，而不是数据里。

senses.title: Methodological rigour: strictness about procedure
senses.titleCN: 方法严谨：对程序一丝不苟
senses.definition: describing the strictness and consistency with which methods are applied and reported
senses.definitionCN: 指方法被应用与报告时的严格与一致程度
senses.example: The study is praised for its methodological rigour.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究因方法严谨而受到称赞。
senses.why: Rigour here means that every step can be inspected and repeated. The adjective turns methodology into a standard of quality that a reader can check.
senses.whyCN: 这里的严谨指每一步都可被检查、可被重复。形容词把方法论变成一种读者可以核查的质量标准。

senses.title: Of a discipline's characteristic approach
senses.titleCN: 学科方法论的：某学科特有的做法
senses.definition: describing the approach typical of a discipline, such as the methodological outlook of economics or history
senses.definitionCN: 指某学科典型的方法进路，如经济学或历史学的方法论取向
senses.example: Each discipline has its own methodological habits.
senses.exampleCN: 每个学科都有自己的方法论习惯。
senses.why: Disciplines differ less in what they study than in how they argue. The adjective names those shared habits of proof that make a field recognisable to its members.
senses.whyCN: 学科之间的差别，与其说在研究对象，不如说在论证方式。这个形容词指那些共享的论证习惯，正是它们让一个领域对其成员可辨认。

senses.title: Methodological individualism: explain by individuals
senses.titleCN: 方法论个人主义：用个体来解释整体
senses.definition: in social science, the principle that social facts should be explained through the actions of individual people
senses.definitionCN: 社会科学中的原则：社会事实应通过个人的行动来解释
senses.example: Methodological individualism rejects explanations that treat groups as agents.
senses.exampleCN: 方法论个人主义拒绝把群体当作行动者的解释。
senses.why: Here the adjective names a rule about what may count as an explanation. It is methodology applied to the question of which entities are allowed to act in a theory.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词命名的是「什么才算解释」的规则。它是把方法论用在「理论中允许哪些实体行动」这一问题上。

senses.title: Methodological pluralism: several methods accepted
senses.titleCN: 方法多元：承认多种方法并存
senses.definition: the view that a field should accept several methods rather than insist on one
senses.definitionCN: 认为一个领域应接受多种方法、而不强求唯一方法的立场
senses.example: Methodological pluralism lets one question be answered by experiment and by interview.
senses.exampleCN: 方法多元让同一个问题既可用实验、也可用访谈来回答。
senses.why: Pluralism about methods is a claim about the rules of inquiry, not about the world. The adjective keeps it on the level of methodology, where such claims belong.
senses.whyCN: 方法多元是关于探究规则的主张，而不是关于世界的主张。形容词把它保持在方法论层面，这类主张正属于该层面。

intro.en: Methodological is methodology plus -ical, the adjective ending that came into English from Latin -icalis and Greek -ikos. Methodology itself is a learned coinage of around 1800 from Greek methodos 'way of inquiry' plus -logia 'study of'. The adjective is recorded in the 19th century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: methodological 是 methodology 加 -ical，这个形容词词尾经拉丁语 -icalis 与希腊语 -ikos 进入英语。methodology 本身是 1800 年前后用希腊语 methodos「探究之路」加 -logia「研究」造出的学术词。该形容词在 19 世纪见于记载。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Methodological becomes a common label in reviews, where a fault in design is called methodological rather than factual.
items.cn: methodological 在评审语言中成为常用标签，设计上的毛病被称为方法层面的，而不是事实层面的。

items.en: The adjective is recorded alongside the noun, as philosophy of science begins to discuss the rules of method explicitly.
items.cn: 这个形容词与名词一同见于记载，正值科学哲学开始明确讨论方法规则之时。

items.en: Methodology is coined from Greek pieces, at first naming the theory of method rather than a set of methods.
items.cn: methodology 用希腊成分造出，最初指方法的理论，而不是一套方法。

items.en: methodos 'way of inquiry' joins meta- 'after, beyond' with hodos 'way'; -logia names the study of something.
items.cn: methodos「探究之路」由 meta-「在后、超出」与 hodos「路」构成；-logia 意为对某事物的研究。

items.en: The adjective ending -icalis supplies the English -ical, and Latin methodus carries the Greek noun into European learning.
items.cn: 形容词词尾 -icalis 提供英语的 -ical，拉丁语 methodus 则把这个希腊名词带入欧洲学术。

note.en: The first group separates a genuinely different adjective and a mere rhyme from the true family; the second compares neighbouring adjectives of planning and execution.
note.cn: 第一组把一个真正不同的形容词与一个只是押韵的词从同族中分出来；第二组比较规划与执行层面相邻的形容词。

entries.definition: orderly and systematic in one's habits. It describes a person or a way of working, not the theory of method, so a methodical worker is not thereby methodological.
entries.definitionCN: 指习惯上有条理、有系统。它描述人或工作方式，而不是方法的理论，因此一个有条理的人并不因此就是方法论意义上的。

entries.definition: the study of methods, or a system of methods. The adjective merely turns this noun into a modifier.
entries.definitionCN: 对方法的研究，或一套方法体系。形容词只是把这个名词变成修饰语。

entries.definition: relating to weather. It comes from meteōron 'a thing raised in the air', not from methodos, and shares only a similar sound.
entries.definitionCN: 与天气有关的。它出自 meteōron「升到空中的东西」，并非来自 methodos，只是读音相近。

entries.definition: relating to the steps that must be followed. It names the execution of a method, where methodological names the reasoning behind the method.
entries.definitionCN: 与必须遵循的步骤有关。它指方法的执行，而 methodological 指方法背后的理由。

entries.definition: done according to a fixed and orderly plan. It praises the order itself, not the justification of the order.
entries.definitionCN: 按固定而有序的计划进行。它称赞的是秩序本身，而不是秩序的理由。

entries.definition: concerned with ideas rather than practice. Methodology can be theoretical, but theoretical work need not be about method at all.
entries.definitionCN: 关心理念而非实践。方法论工作可以是理论的，但理论工作未必与方法的理论有关。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -logical is the adjective ending that points at a field of study, so methodological points at the study of methods.
normal.cn: -logical 是指向某研究领域的形容词词尾，所以 methodological 指向对方法的研究。

normal.en: Methodical describes a tidy worker; methodological describes an argument about how to work.
normal.cn: methodical 形容人有条理；methodological 形容关于「该怎么做」的论证。

normal.en: The -logia in both words goes back to logos, 'word, reason', so a methodological claim is a claim with reasons.
normal.cn: 两个词里的 -logia 都追溯到 logos「言说、理性」，因此方法论主张是有理由的主张。

normal.en: Greek hodos 'way' is hidden in the middle of the word: methodology is literally the study of roads.
normal.cn: 希腊语 hodos「路」藏在这个词的中段：methodology 字面就是「对路的研究」。

normal.en: A methodological flaw is a flaw in the route, not in the destination.
normal.cn: 方法学缺陷是路线上的缺陷，而不是目的地上的缺陷。

abstract.en: Picture a map being audited: the argument is about the drawing, not the landscape.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图正在被审核：争的是画法，而不是山水本身。

abstract.en: Every methodological question can be rephrased as 'how would we know that?'
abstract.cn: 每个方法论问题都可以改写成：「我们怎么会知道这一点？」

abstract.en: The word marks the level at which a disagreement cannot be settled by more data.
abstract.cn: 这个词标记出那个层级：在那里的分歧无法靠更多数据来解决。

examples.en: The criticism was methodological: the sample was too small to support the claim.
examples.cn: 这个批评是方法层面的：样本太小，支撑不了结论。

examples.en: Their methodological differences made collaboration difficult.
examples.cn: 他们在方法上的分歧让合作变得困难。

examples.en: The paper is methodologically sound but stylistically clumsy.
examples.cn: 这篇论文在方法上站得住，只是文笔笨拙。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「没瑟得逻辑扣」——方法这张图要是逻辑上扣不上，就成方法论问题 → methodological 方法论的

root: 希腊语 methodos「探究之路」＝meta-＋hodos「路」；加 -logia「研究」成 methodology；再加 -ical（拉丁 -icalis、希腊 -ikos）→ methodological。核心是「就路线图本身对不对提出质疑」，而不是讨论路上看到什么。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a map being examined rather than used. What changes is the question asked of it — is it the right theory, which routes were chosen, why the routes differ, where the drawing is faulty, how strict the drawing is, whose habits it shows, or which entities it allows to act.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一张被审视而非被使用的地图。变化的只是对它提出的问题——理论对不对、选了哪些路、为何各选各的、画错在哪里、画得多严格、体现谁的习惯，还是允许哪些实体行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a route map held under a lamp while two people argue about how it was drawn.
core.cn: 核心意象：路线图被举到灯下，两个人争论它是怎么画的。

branches.en: FROM THEORY TO PRACTICE: the adjective covers both the principles of method and the concrete methods a study adopted.
branches.cn: 从理论到实践：这个形容词既覆盖方法的原则，也覆盖某项研究实际采用的方法。

branches.en: THE LEVEL OF DISPUTE: when the quarrel is about how facts are produced, the adjective names that level.
branches.cn: 争论层级：当争执在于事实如何产生时，这个形容词命名了该层级。

branches.en: QUALITY CONTROL: a flaw sits in the design, and rigour is the strictness with which the design is followed and reported.
branches.cn: 质量控制：缺陷在设计里，严谨则是设计与报告被遵循的严格程度。

branches.en: DISCIPLINARY HABITS: each field has shared manners of proof that its members recognise at once.
branches.cn: 学科习惯：每个领域都有共享的论证方式，其成员一眼就能认出。

branches.en: RULES OF EXPLANATION: individualism and pluralism decide which entities may act and which methods may be used.
branches.cn: 解释规则：个人主义与多元主义决定哪些实体可以行动、哪些方法可以使用。

intro.en: Methodological is methodology plus -ical. The ending -ical, from Latin -icalis and Greek -ikos, makes a relating adjective; methodology is method plus -ology from Greek -logia.
intro.cn: methodological 是 methodology 加 -ical。词尾 -ical 出自拉丁语 -icalis 与希腊语 -ikos，构成关系形容词；methodology 则是 method 加出自希腊语 -logia 的 -ology。

latinIntro.en: The Greek pieces are meta- 'after, beyond', hodos 'way' and logos 'reason, word', with -ikos forming the adjective. Latin supplies only the carrier forms methodus and -icalis.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分是 meta-「在后、超出」、hodos「路」与 logos「理性、言说」，-ikos 构成形容词。拉丁语只提供 methodus 与 -icalis 这两个载体形式。

items.meaning: relating to the principles of method
items.meaningCN: 与方法原则有关的；方法论的
items.example: They raised a methodological objection.
items.exampleCN: 他们提出了一个方法论上的反对意见。

items.meaning: the study of methods, or a method system
items.example: The methodology was described in detail.
items.exampleCN: 研究方法被详细描述。

items.meaning: a way of doing or investigating
items.example: They tried a new method of dating the sample.
items.exampleCN: 他们尝试了一种新的样品测年方法。

items.meaning: orderly, acting by settled steps
items.meaningCN: 有条理的；按步骤行事的
items.example: Her methodical approach saved time later.
items.exampleCN: 她有条理的做法在后来省了时间。

items.meaning: in orderly steps
items.example: He methodically recorded every reading.
items.exampleCN: 他有条理地记下每个读数。

items.meaning: from the standpoint of method
items.meaningCN: 在方法论上；从方法角度看
items.example: The study is methodologically innovative.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究在方法上有创新。

items.meaning: one who studies methods of inquiry
items.meaningCN: 方法论研究者；方法学家
items.example: A methodologist joined the review panel.
items.exampleCN: 一位方法学家加入了评审组。

items.structure: meta- (beyond) + analysis (Greek analyein, to break up)
items.meaning: a statistical combining of many study results
items.meaningCN: 元分析；把多项研究结果合并统计（meta- 表示超出）
items.example: The meta-analysis pooled twelve trials.
items.exampleCN: 这项元分析合并了十二项试验。

items.meaning: data that describes other data
items.meaningCN: 元数据；描述数据的数据
items.example: The file's metadata records its author.
items.exampleCN: 这个文件的元数据记录着作者。

items.structure: Greek hodos (way), the second element of method
items.meaning: road, way, journey
items.meaningCN: 路；道路；行程（method 的第二成分）
items.example: The same hodos appears in period, meaning a way around.
items.exampleCN: 同一个 hodos 也出现在 period 中，原意是绕行的一圈路。

latinEntries.meaning: a pursuit, a way of inquiry
relating to, of the nature of

definition_zh: 迁移；移居；迁徙；移民潮；数据迁移；细胞迁移；污染物迁移；劳动力流动；系统间转移
definition_en: the movement of people, animals or other things from one place, region or system to another, especially over a long distance or in large numbers
core_image: 暮色中一群鸟排成人字，从一片湿地飞向另一片湿地
scene: At dusk the birds form a wedge and leave one marsh for another: their movement is migration.
sceneCN: 这里 migration 是「迁徙」（第 2 个义项：动物迁徙）；句意：暮色中鸟群排成人字，离开一片湿地飞向另一片湿地，它们的移动就是迁徙。图中可辨识物件：人字形鸟群、起飞的湿地、远处的湿地、暮色天空、芦苇。

pos.zh: 迁移；移居；迁徙；移民潮；数据迁移

forms.label: 单数（一次迁移或迁移这件事）
复数（多批迁移或多条迁徙路线）

senses.title: People moving to a new place to live
senses.titleCN: 人的迁移：搬到另一处生活
senses.definition: the movement of people from one place or country to another in order to settle there
senses.definitionCN: 人们从一个地方或国家移到另一个地方或国家定居
senses.example: Migration from the countryside to the cities changed the labour market.
senses.exampleCN: 从乡村向城市的迁移改变了劳动力市场。
senses.why: Latin migrare means to move from one place to another, and migratio names that moving. Applied to people, the change of place becomes a change of home.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 migrare 意为从一处移到另一处，migratio 指这一移动。用在人身上，换地方就变成了换家。

senses.title: Animal migration: seasonal movement between regions
senses.titleCN: 动物迁徙：随季节在区域间移动
senses.definition: the seasonal movement of animals, birds or fish from one region to another and often back again
senses.definitionCN: 动物、鸟类或鱼类随季节从一个地区移到另一地区，且常常再返回
senses.example: The migration of the geese follows the river valley every autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 每年秋天雁群的迁徙都沿着河谷走。
senses.why: The same verb fits animals because they also leave one place for another. The word adds nothing about distance; the round trip and the season are supplied by context.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词也适用于动物，因为它们同样离开一处去另一处。词本身不涉及距离；往返与季节是由语境提供的。

senses.title: A wave of movement: numbers on the move
senses.titleCN: 移民潮：成规模的移动
senses.definition: a large-scale movement of people or animals considered as a quantity or a trend
senses.definitionCN: 被当作数量或趋势来看待的大规模人潮或兽群移动
senses.example: The century saw a migration of millions across the border.
senses.exampleCN: 那个世纪有数百万人越过边境迁移。
senses.why: Once many journeys are counted together, migration stops being one person's move and becomes a demographic event, measured and graphed by agencies.
senses.whyCN: 当许多趟行程被一起计数，migration 就不再是一个人的搬家，而成为一个人口事件，被机构测量并绘成图表。

senses.title: Data migration: moving information between systems
senses.titleCN: 数据迁移：把信息搬到另一套系统
senses.definition: the transfer of data from one storage system, format or platform to another
senses.definitionCN: 把数据从一种存储系统、格式或平台转移到另一种
senses.example: The data migration took three nights and two rollbacks.
senses.exampleCN: 这次数据迁移用了三个夜晚和两次回滚。
senses.why: Computing keeps the literal image: records that lived in one place are moved to another. The risk is the same as in any move, that something is lost on the way.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域保留了字面意象：原本住在一处的记录被搬到另一处。风险也跟任何搬家一样：路上可能丢东西。

senses.title: Cell migration: cells moving through tissue
senses.titleCN: 细胞迁移：细胞在组织中移动
senses.definition: in biology, the directed movement of cells through tissue, as in wound healing or development
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中指细胞在组织中定向移动，如伤口愈合或发育过程中的移动
senses.example: Cell migration is central to how wounds close.
senses.exampleCN: 细胞迁移是伤口如何闭合的核心环节。
senses.why: Biology applies the word at a scale invisible to the eye. A cell leaves one position for another, so the same migrare serves, with the 'journey' compressed to micrometres.
senses.whyCN: 生物学把这个词用在肉眼不可见的尺度。细胞离开一个位置去另一个位置，所以同一个 migrare 仍然适用，只是「行程」被压缩到微米级。

senses.title: Pollutant migration: spreading through soil and water
senses.titleCN: 污染物迁移：在土壤与水中扩散
senses.definition: the movement of a substance, especially a pollutant, through soil, water or air
senses.definitionCN: 物质、尤指污染物在土壤、水或空气中的移动
senses.example: The study traced the migration of nitrates into the groundwater.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究追踪了硝酸盐向地下水的迁移。
senses.why: Here the mover is not a creature but a substance. The word still means a change of place, and the scientific use adds the question of how far and how fast.
senses.whyCN: 这里移动的不是生物，而是物质。词仍指换地方，科学用法则再加上「多远、多快」的问题。

senses.title: Labour migration: workers following demand
senses.titleCN: 劳动力迁移：工人跟着需求走
senses.definition: the movement of workers between regions or countries in search of employment
senses.definitionCN: 工人为寻找就业而在地区或国家之间移动
senses.example: Seasonal labour migration fills the harvest with hands.
senses.exampleCN: 季节性劳动力迁移为收割季节补足了人手。
senses.why: When the reason for moving is work, the word becomes an economic term. The same journey is now explained by wages rather than by home.
senses.whyCN: 当移动的原因是工作时，这个词就成了经济术语。同一趟行程，如今用工资来解释，而不是用家。

senses.title: Any transfer between systems
senses.titleCN: 一般迁移：在一个系统与另一个系统之间转移
senses.definition: a general transfer from one system, category or state to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一种系统、类别或状态转移到另一种的统称
senses.example: The migration of files from paper archives to digital ones took a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 把档案从纸质迁到数字形式用了一个年代。
senses.why: The general sense is simply 'a move from one container to another'. It keeps the word usable for archives, accounts, populations and species alike.
senses.whyCN: 一般义就是「从一个容器搬到另一个容器」。这使这个词能用于档案、账户、人口与物种。

intro.en: Migration comes from Latin migratio, the noun of migrare 'to move from one place to another'. English borrowed it in the 17th century, at first for the movement of people, and extended it to animals, cells and data in later centuries. The deeper link to a root meaning 'to change' is generally accepted but not certain. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: migration 出自拉丁语 migratio，即 migrare「从一处移到另一处」的名词。英语在 17 世纪借入，最初指人的迁移，后来几个世纪才扩展到动物、细胞与数据。它与一个意为「改变」的词根有更深联系，这一点一般认为成立，但并非确证。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Data migration and cell migration become standard phrases as computing and cell biology grow.
items.cn: 随着计算技术与细胞生物学的发展，data migration（数据迁移）与 cell migration（细胞迁移）成为固定说法。

items.en: The study of bird migration gives the word its popular natural-history sense.
items.cn: 对鸟类迁徙的研究赋予这个词流行的自然史含义。

items.en: English migration is recorded, naming the movement of people from one country or region to another.
items.cn: 英语 migration 见于记载，指人从一个国家或地区迁往另一个。

items.en: migratio is the noun of migrare; the same verb gives migrate, migrant, immigrate and emigrate.
items.cn: migratio 是 migrare 的名词；同一个动词给出 migrate、migrant、immigrate、emigrate。

items.en: A reconstructed root *mei- 'to change, go' is often proposed behind migrare, though the connection is generally accepted rather than proven.
items.cn: 常有人为 migrare 提出重构词根 *mei-「改变、行走」，但这一联系一般认为成立，而非已证明。

note.en: The first group separates the two prefixed relatives and one false friend; the second compares words for movement that differ in scale or cause.
note.cn: 第一组把两个带前缀的同族词和一个假朋友分开；第二组比较规模或成因不同的移动类词。

entries.definition: the act of leaving one's own country to settle elsewhere. The prefix e- 'out' fixes the point of view at the country of departure.
entries.definitionCN: 离开本国到别处定居的行为。前缀 e-「向外」把视角固定在出发国。

entries.definition: the act of coming into a country to settle. The prefix im- 'in' fixes the point of view at the receiving country, so the same journey is emigration or immigration depending on who is counting.
entries.definitionCN: 进入某国定居的行为。前缀 im-「向内」把视角固定在接收国，因此同一趟行程，看谁在计数，就或叫移出或叫移入。

entries.definition: a severe recurring headache. It comes through French from Greek hēmikrania 'half the skull', and has nothing to do with migrare despite the shared opening.
entries.definitionCN: 反复发作的剧烈头痛。它经法语来自希腊语 hēmikrania「半个头骨」，虽开头相同，却与 migrare 无关。

entries.definition: any change of position. It is the widest word, with no implication of settling, season or distance.
entries.definitionCN: 任何位置变化。它是最宽泛的词，不含定居、季节或距离的意味。

entries.definition: the act of moving a person, company or object to a new place. It is usually a single planned move, where migration suggests many moves or a recurring pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 把个人、公司或物件搬到新地点。它通常指一次有计划的搬迁，而 migration 暗示许多次移动或反复出现的模式。

entries.definition: the forcing of people from their homes by war, disaster or development. It stresses that the move was compelled, not chosen.
entries.definitionCN: 因战争、灾害或开发而被迫离开家园。它强调移动是被迫而非自愿。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: migrare means 'to move from one place to another'; every sense is that verb wearing a different subject.
normal.cn: migrare 意为「从一处移到另一处」；每个义项都是这个动词换了个主语。

normal.en: e- 'out' and im- 'in' split the family: emigration looks from the leaving side, immigration from the arriving side.
normal.cn: e-「向外」与 im-「向内」把这个词族分开：emigration 从离开方看，immigration 从到达方看。

normal.en: Migraine is not a relative: its Greek source means 'half the skull', not 'moving away'.
normal.cn: migraine 不是同族词：它的希腊来源意为「半个头骨」，而不是「迁走」。

normal.en: The -tion ending names the event, while migrant names the person who performs it.
normal.cn: -tion 词尾命名事件，而 migrant 命名实施这一行为的人。

normal.en: Data and cells migrate in the same grammatical way as birds: something leaves one place for another.
normal.cn: 数据与细胞的「迁移」在语法上和鸟一样：某物离开一处去另一处。

abstract.en: Picture a dotted line from one marsh to another, followed each year by a new generation.
abstract.cn: 想象一条从这片湿地连到那片湿地的虚线，每年由新一代沿着它飞。

abstract.en: Any migration has three parts: a place left, a route, and a place arrived at; every sense uses those three.
abstract.cn: 任何迁移都有三部分：离开的地方、路线、抵达的地方；每个义项都用到这三样。

abstract.en: The word never asks whether the move was good, only that it happened and in which direction.
abstract.cn: 这个词从不过问迁移好不好，只问它是否发生、朝哪个方向。

examples.en: Rural migration has emptied many mountain villages.
examples.cn: 乡村人口外迁让许多山村空了。

examples.en: The migration of monarch butterflies covers thousands of kilometres.
examples.cn: 帝王蝶的迁徙要跨越数千公里。

examples.en: The company scheduled the data migration for a weekend.
examples.cn: 公司把数据迁移安排在周末。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「买个雷神」——候鸟一路买个雷神当路标，年年迁往同一处 → migration 迁徙、迁移

root: 拉丁语 migrare「从一处移到另一处」→ migratio → 英语 migration。核心是「离开一处、沿路、抵达另一处」，主语可以是人、鸟、细胞、数据或污染物。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a dotted line from one place to another. What changes is who or what travels along it — settlers, birds, whole populations, records, cells, dissolved chemicals, workers, or any transferable thing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：从一处连到另一处的一条虚线。变化的只是沿这条线走的是什么——定居者、鸟、整批人口、记录、细胞、溶解的化学物质、工人，或任何可转移之物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: at dusk a wedge of birds leaves one marsh for another.
core.cn: 核心意象：暮色中一群鸟排成人字，离开一片湿地飞向另一片。

branches.en: PEOPLE MOVING: settlers change home, and workers change region in search of wages.
branches.cn: 人的移动：定居者换了家，工人为工资换了地区。

branches.en: ANIMALS MOVING: the same route is flown or walked each season, often back and forth.
branches.cn: 动物的移动：同一路线每个季节被飞过或走过，常常来回。

branches.en: THE WAVE: many journeys counted together become a demographic or ecological trend.
branches.cn: 浪潮：许多趟行程合并计数，就成为人口或生态趋势。

branches.en: INVISIBLE MOVERS: records leave one system, cells leave one position, both by the same literal image.
branches.cn: 看不见的移动者：记录离开一套系统，细胞离开一个位置，两者用的是同一个字面意象。

branches.en: SUBSTANCES AND TRANSFERS: pollutants travel through soil and water, and any item can be moved between containers.
branches.cn: 物质与转移：污染物穿过土壤与水，任何东西都可以从一个容器搬到另一个。

intro.en: Migration is Latin migr- plus -ation. The ending -ation names an action; the stem migr- comes from migrare 'to move from one place to another', and the prefixes e- and im- decide the direction of the move.
intro.cn: migration 是拉丁词干 migr- 加 -ation。词尾 -ation 命名动作；词干 migr- 来自 migrare「从一处移到另一处」，而前缀 e- 与 im- 决定移动的方向。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb is migrare 'to move, change place'. Its family splits by prefix: e- 'out' gives emigrate, im- 'in' gives immigrate, and trans- 'across' gives transmigrate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词是 migrare「移动、换地方」。其词族按前缀分流：e-「向外」给出 emigrate，im-「向内」给出 immigrate，trans-「穿过」给出 transmigrate。

items.meaning: the act of moving from one place to another
items.meaningCN: 迁移；迁徙（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The migration lasted four generations.
items.exampleCN: 这次迁徙延续了四代。

items.meaning: to move from one region or system to another
items.example: Many birds migrate along this coast.
items.exampleCN: 许多鸟沿着这条海岸迁徙。

items.meaning: a person or animal that migrates
items.example: The camp houses migrant workers.
items.exampleCN: 这个营地安置着外来务工人员。

items.meaning: given to migrating, or relating to migration
items.example: Salmon are migratory fish.
items.exampleCN: 鲑鱼是洄游性鱼类。

items.meaning: to leave one's country to settle elsewhere
items.meaningCN: 移出本国；迁往外地（e- 表示向外）
items.example: Her family emigrated in the 1980s.
items.exampleCN: 她家在 1980 年代移居国外。

items.meaning: the act of leaving a country
items.example: Emigration drained the island of young workers.
items.exampleCN: 人口外迁让这座岛失去了年轻劳力。

items.meaning: to come into a country to settle
items.meaningCN: 移入；移民入境（im- 表示向内）
items.example: They immigrated with three children.
items.exampleCN: 他们带着三个孩子移居入境。

items.meaning: the act of entering a country to settle
items.example: Immigration policy changed that year.
items.exampleCN: 移民政策那年变了。

items.meaning: a passage across, or the passing of a soul into another body
items.meaningCN: 横越迁移；灵魂转世（trans- 表示穿过）
items.example: The old doctrine taught the transmigration of souls.
items.exampleCN: 这一古老教义讲灵魂的转世。

items.structure: the same adjective used in medicine for pain that moves
items.meaning: of symptoms that shift from one part to another
items.meaningCN: （医学）游走性的：症状从一处移到另一处
items.example: The patient reported migratory joint pain.
items.exampleCN: 病人诉称有关节游走性疼痛。

latinEntries.meaning: forms a noun of action or result
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成表示动作或结果的名词

definition_zh: 迁徙的；迁移的；游牧的；流动的；季节性的；候鸟的；过路的；游走性的（医学）
definition_en: given to migrating, relating to migration, or moving from one place or part to another rather than staying fixed
core_image: 一条看不见的旧航线被一代代鸟沿着山谷飞过
scene: The same invisible route over the valley is followed by a new generation every autumn: the birds are migratory.
sceneCN: 这里 migratory 是「迁徙的」（第 1 个义项：动物迁徙的）；句意：每年秋天新一代鸟沿着山谷上空同一条看不见的路线飞行，这些鸟是迁徙的。图中可辨识物件：山谷、飞行的鸟群、虚线航线、秋季的树、远处的湖。

pos.zh: 迁徙的；迁移的；游牧的；流动的；游走性的

senses.title: Of animals that migrate: moving with the season
senses.titleCN: 动物迁徙的：随季节移动
senses.definition: describing animals that travel from one region to another with the seasons, often returning later
senses.definitionCN: 指随季节从一个地区移到另一地区、且常常之后再返回的动物
senses.example: The wetland is a stopover for migratory birds.
senses.exampleCN: 这片湿地是候鸟的中途停歇地。
senses.why: Latin migratorius is the adjective of migrare 'to move from place to place'. Applied to animals, it marks a habitual traveller rather than a one-time mover.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 migratorius 是 migrare「从一处移到另一处」的形容词。用在动物身上，它标记的是一种习惯性的旅行者，而不是只搬一次家的人。

senses.title: Of peoples who move with pasture or season
senses.titleCN: 游牧的：随牧草或季节移动的族群
senses.definition: describing human groups that move from place to place rather than settling permanently
senses.definitionCN: 指不永久定居、而在各地之间移动的人群
senses.example: Migratory herders follow the grass up the valley each summer.
senses.exampleCN: 游牧的牧人每年夏天沿着山谷跟着草场往上走。
senses.why: The same adjective extends to people whose way of life is movement. Here it is not a journey but a pattern, so migratory describes a condition rather than an event.
senses.whyCN: 同一个形容词也用于以移动为生活方式的人。这里不是一趟行程，而是一种模式，所以 migratory 描述的是一种状态，而不是一个事件。

senses.title: Of workers who move where work is
senses.titleCN: 流动的：工人跟着活走
senses.definition: describing workers who move from place to place or season to season in search of employment
senses.definitionCN: 指为寻找工作而随地点或季节移动的工人
senses.example: Migratory farm workers arrive for the harvest and leave after it.
senses.exampleCN: 流动的农业工人收割前到来，收完就离开。
senses.why: A migratory worker is not a settler. The adjective signals that residence is temporary and tied to demand, which makes it an economic description.
senses.whyCN: 流动工人不是定居者。这个形容词表明居住是暂时的、随需求而定，因此它是一种经济描述。

senses.title: Seasonal: following a yearly cycle
senses.titleCN: 季节性的：跟着一年一轮的周期
senses.definition: describing movement that follows a yearly cycle rather than a single departure
senses.definitionCN: 指按年度周期进行的移动，而不是一次性的离开
senses.example: The species shows a migratory pattern tied to rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个物种表现出与降雨相关的迁徙规律。
senses.why: Because migrare can be repeated, the adjective often carries the idea of a cycle. The pattern, not the single trip, is what the word describes here.
senses.whyCN: 因为 migrare 可以反复发生，这个形容词常带周期性。此处它描述的是模式，而不是单趟旅程。

senses.title: migratory birds: the birds themselves
senses.titleCN: 候鸟：指这类鸟本身
senses.definition: used as a fixed phrase for birds that migrate, especially those protected across borders
senses.definitionCN: 作为固定说法指会迁徙的鸟，尤指受跨境保护的种类
senses.example: Migratory birds are protected by an international treaty.
senses.exampleCN: 候鸟受一项国际条约保护。
senses.why: The phrase migratory birds became a legal and conservation category because such birds cross jurisdictions. The adjective turns a habit into a protected class.
senses.whyCN: migratory birds（候鸟）这一说法成为法律与保育类别，因为这类鸟跨越管辖边界。形容词把一种习性变成了一个受保护的类别。

senses.title: Of behaviour that moves rather than stays
senses.titleCN: 迁移性的：行为本身是移动的
senses.definition: describing behaviour, habits or strategies that involve moving on rather than remaining
senses.definitionCN: 指涉及继续前行而非停留的行为、习性,或策略
senses.example: The study compared migratory and settled strategies among nomads.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究比较了游牧者的迁移策略与定居策略。
senses.why: Here the adjective modifies an abstract noun. It transfers the animal image to behaviour, so a migratory strategy is one that keeps moving when conditions change.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词修饰抽象名词。它把动物的意象转到行为上，因此迁移性策略就是在条件变化时继续移动的策略。

senses.title: Passing through: here for a season only
senses.titleCN: 过路的：只待一季就走
senses.definition: describing people or animals that stay in a place only briefly while travelling
senses.definitionCN: 指在旅途中只在一地短暂停留的人或动物
senses.example: The town's population doubles with migratory visitors each summer.
senses.exampleCN: 每年夏天，过路的访客让这个镇的人口翻倍。
senses.why: On the receiving side, a migratory group is one that has not come to stay. The adjective marks temporary presence, which is why host towns plan for it separately.
senses.whyCN: 从接收地看，迁移群体是并不打算留下来的群体。形容词标记的正是这种临时在场，所以东道城镇要为它单独规划。

senses.title: In medicine: symptoms that move about
senses.titleCN: 医学上的游走性：症状到处跑
senses.definition: describing pain or symptoms that shift from one part of the body to another
senses.definitionCN: 指疼痛或症状从身体一处转移到另一处
senses.example: Migratory joint pain can be an early sign of some infections.
senses.exampleCN: 游走性关节痛可能是某些感染的早期征象。
senses.why: Medicine borrows the word for what moves within the body instead of between places. The core idea of leaving one location for another survives the change of scale.
senses.whyCN: 医学把这个词借来表示在体内移动、而非在地区间移动的东西。「离开一处去另一处」这一核心观念在尺度改变后仍然成立。

intro.en: Migratory comes from Latin migratorius, an adjective of migrare 'to move from one place to another'. English borrowed it in the 18th century, first describing animals and peoples that move with the seasons. The -ory ending marks a tendency or a capacity, like -atory in other Latin adjectives. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: migratory 出自拉丁语 migratorius，是 migrare「从一处移到另一处」的形容词。英语在 18 世纪借入，最初描述随季节移动的动物与人群。-ory 词尾标记倾向或能力，如同其他拉丁形容词中的 -atory。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Migratory becomes a legal and conservation term, as treaties protect migratory birds and migratory species across borders.
items.cn: migratory 成为法律与保育术语，条约开始跨境保护候鸟与迁徙物种。

items.en: The adjective spreads to workers and herders, and medicine adopts it for shifting pain.
items.cn: 这个形容词扩展到工人与牧人，医学也采用它来表示游走性疼痛。

items.en: English migratory is recorded, borrowed from Latin migratorius to describe animals and peoples that move with the season.
items.cn: 英语 migratory 见于记载，借自拉丁语 migratorius，描述随季节移动的动物与人群。

items.en: migratorius is formed on migrare 'to move' with the suffix -torius, which marks what tends to do the action.
items.cn: migratorius 由 migrare「移动」加后缀 -torius 构成，后者标记倾向于做该动作的事物。

items.en: The deeper root behind migrare is often reconstructed as *mei- 'to change, go', though the link is generally accepted and not certain.
items.cn: migrare 背后更深的词根常被重构为 *mei-「改变、行走」，但这一联系一般认为成立，并非确证。

note.en: The first group separates the noun relative and one false friend; the second compares adjectives of movement that differ in permanence and cause.
note.cn: 第一组把名词性同族词与一个假朋友分开；第二组比较在持久性与成因上不同的移动类形容词。

entries.definition: a person or animal that migrates, or a worker who moves for work. The noun names the traveller, while migratory describes the travelling habit.
entries.definitionCN: 会迁移的人或动物，或为工作而流动的人。名词指旅行者本身，而 migratory 描述的是这种旅行的习性。

entries.definition: the movement itself, seen as an event. The adjective adds no idea of destination or direction.
entries.definitionCN: 移动本身，被看成一个事件。形容词不添加目的地或方向的信息。

entries.definition: a severe headache. Its Greek source hēmikrania means 'half the skull', so it is not part of the migrare family.
entries.definitionCN: 剧烈的头痛。其希腊来源 hēmikrania 意为「半个头骨」，因此不属于 migrare 词族。

entries.definition: belonging to a way of life with no permanent settlement. It stresses the absence of a home base, while migratory stresses repeated movement.
entries.definitionCN: 属于没有永久定居点的生活方式。它强调没有大本营，而 migratory 强调反复移动。

entries.definition: lasting only a short time, or staying briefly. It focuses on shortness of stay, not on the habit of travelling.
entries.definitionCN: 只持续很短时间，或指短暂停留。它关注停留之短，而非旅行的习性。

entries.definition: happening at a particular season of the year. It names the timing, while migratory names the movement itself.
entries.definitionCN: 在某一年中特定季节发生。它说的是时间，而 migratory 说的是移动本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The -ory ending, as in obligatory or preparatory, marks a tendency, so migratory marks a tendency to move.
normal.cn: -ory 词尾如 obligatory、preparatory 那样标记倾向，所以 migratory 标记「倾向于移动」。

normal.en: migration is the journey, migrant is the traveller, migratory is the habit: one stem, three jobs.
normal.cn: migration 是行程，migrant 是行者，migratory 是习性：一个词干，三个岗位。

normal.en: -atory in Latin adjectives usually points back to a verb, and migrare is that verb.
normal.cn: 拉丁形容词里的 -atory 通常回指某一个动词，而 migrare 就是那个动词。

normal.en: Migraine means 'half the skull' in Greek and only looks like a relative.
normal.cn: migraine 在希腊语里意为「半个头骨」，只是看起来像同族词。

normal.en: The same word covers birds, herders, harvest workers and shifting pain: all of them refuse to stay put.
normal.cn: 同一个词覆盖鸟、牧人、收割工和游走性疼痛：它们都不肯待在一处。

abstract.en: Picture a dotted route worn into the sky by generations; the route, not the bird, is what repeats.
abstract.cn: 想象一条被一代代鸟磨出的空中虚线；重复的是这条路线，而不是哪一只鸟。

abstract.en: Anything described as migratory treats place as temporary and movement as normal.
abstract.cn: 凡被称作 migratory 的东西，都把地点视为暂时，把移动视为常态。

abstract.en: The word always answers the question: does this stay, or does it come and go?
abstract.cn: 这个词总在回答一个问题：这东西是留下的，还是来来去去的？

examples.en: The delta is critical habitat for migratory waterfowl.
examples.cn: 这片三角洲是迁徙水禽的关键栖息地。

examples.en: Migratory workers follow the strawberry harvest north.
examples.cn: 流动工人跟着草莓收获季一路向北。

examples.en: Some fevers produce a migratory rash.
examples.cn: 有些发热会出现游走性的皮疹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「买个雷神托瑞」——买个雷神当向导，一季一迁，从不长住 → migratory 迁徙的、流动的

root: 拉丁语 migrare「从一处移到另一处」＋-torius（表示倾向的形容词后缀）→ migratorius → 英语 migratory。核心是「不肯长住，按季节或按活计反复移动」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a route flown again each season. What changes is who follows it — birds, herders, harvest workers, a yearly pattern, a protected class of birds, a strategy, temporary visitors, or pain moving inside a body.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：每季又被飞过一次的路线。变化的只是谁沿着它走——鸟、牧人、收割工、年度规律、受保护的一类鸟、一种策略、临时访客，还是体内游走的疼痛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one invisible route over a valley, flown by a new generation each autumn.
core.cn: 核心意象：山谷上空一条看不见的路线，每年秋天由新一代飞过。

branches.en: THE CYCLE: the tendency to move shows up as seasonal travel that repeats rather than as a single departure.
branches.cn: 周期：移动的倾向表现为反复的季节旅行，而不是一次性的离开。

branches.en: PEOPLE ON THE MOVE: herders follow pasture and workers follow wages; both treat home as temporary.
branches.cn: 流动的人：牧人跟着草场，工人跟着工资；两者都把家当作临时的。

branches.en: THE PROTECTED CLASS: the phrase migratory birds turns a habit into a legal category.
branches.cn: 受保护的类别：migratory birds（候鸟）这一说法把一种习性变成法律类别。

branches.en: THE STRATEGY: behaviour itself can be migratory, moving on when conditions change.
branches.cn: 策略：行为本身也可以是迁移性的，条件一变就继续前行。

branches.en: PASSING THROUGH: visitors stay a season, and in medicine the same word marks pain that shifts place.
branches.cn: 过路：访客只待一季；医学里同一个词标记会换地方的疼痛。

intro.en: Migratory is Latin migrat- plus -ory. The ending -ory, from Latin -torius, marks what tends to do something; the stem is the participle of migrare 'to move from place to place'.
intro.cn: migratory 是拉丁词干 migrat- 加 -ory。词尾 -ory 出自拉丁语 -torius，标记倾向于做某事的事物；词干是 migrare「从一处移到另一处」的分词形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb is migrare with its participle migrat-, and the suffix -torius. Its prefixed relatives e- and im- mark direction of movement.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词是 migrare，其分词词干为 migrat-，后缀是 -torius。带前缀的同族词 e- 与 im- 标记移动方向。

items.meaning: given to migrating
items.example: The marsh attracts migratory geese.
items.exampleCN: 这片湿地吸引迁徙的雁群。

items.meaning: to move from one place to another
items.example: Whales migrate between feeding and breeding grounds.
items.exampleCN: 鲸在觅食地与繁殖地之间洄游。

items.meaning: the act or event of moving
items.example: The migration crosses three countries.
items.exampleCN: 这次迁徙跨越三个国家。

items.meaning: one that migrates
items.example: Migrants send money home each month.
items.exampleCN: 外出务工者每月往家里寄钱。

items.meaning: to leave one's country
items.example: The family emigrated in search of work.
items.exampleCN: 这家人为找工作移居国外。

items.meaning: to enter a country to settle
items.example: Her grandparents immigrated from the north.
items.exampleCN: 她的祖父母从北方移居入境。

items.meaning: the act of leaving a country
items.example: Emigration reduced the village to half its size.
items.exampleCN: 人口外迁使这个村子只剩一半人。

items.meaning: the act of entering a country to settle
items.example: Immigration rules were tightened.
items.exampleCN: 移民规定被收紧了。

items.meaning: a crossing move, or the passing of a soul to another body
items.example: The doctrine of transmigration appears in several traditions.
items.exampleCN: 转世之说出现在若干传统中。

items.structure: the same form in medical use
items.meaning: describing symptoms that move between parts
items.example: Migratory pain shifted from knee to wrist.
items.exampleCN: 游走性疼痛从膝盖移到手腕。

latinEntries.meaning: to move from one place to another
tending to do, serving to do

definition_zh: 修改；改动；改装；改造；语言学上的修饰；行为调整；修正；改良；化学改性
definition_en: a change made to something in order to improve it, adapt it or limit it, usually a partial change that leaves the main thing recognisable
core_image: 一件外套被拆开，两只袖子换了位置，整体还认得出原来的样子
scene: The tailor takes the coat apart and moves the sleeves, yet the coat is still recognisably itself: this change is a modification.
sceneCN: 这里 modification 是「修改」（第 1 个义项：修改、改动）；句意：裁缝把外套拆开、挪动了两只袖子，但外套仍认得出是原来那件，这种改动就是修改。图中可辨识物件：外套、拆开的袖子、针线、裁剪台、原来的版型纸样。

pos.zh: 修改；改动；改装；修饰；改良

derivatives.zh: 方式；模式（同出拉丁 modus）

senses.title: A partial change: altering without replacing
senses.titleCN: 局部改动：改而不换
senses.definition: a change made to part of something, so that the whole remains identifiable
senses.definitionCN: 对某物的部分所作的改动，使整体仍然可辨认
senses.example: A few modifications turned the shed into a workshop.
senses.exampleCN: 几处改动就把这间棚屋变成了工坊。
senses.why: Latin modificare is modus 'measure, manner' plus facere 'to make': to make something to a certain measure. A modification therefore adjusts the measure of a thing rather than making a new one.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 modificare 是 modus「尺度、方式」加 facere「做」：按某种尺度做出某物。因此 modification 是调整某物的尺度，而不是另造一件。

senses.title: Adapting equipment or structure
senses.titleCN: 改装：让设备适应新用途
senses.definition: an alteration made to equipment, a vehicle or a building so that it suits a new use
senses.definitionCN: 为适应新用途而对设备、车辆或建筑所作的改动
senses.example: The car underwent modifications for desert driving.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车为沙漠行驶做了改装。
senses.why: Here the measure being adjusted is a machine's design. The change is practical and bounded: the car is still the same car, only fitted to new conditions.
senses.whyCN: 这里被调整的尺度是机器的设计。改动务实且有边界：车还是那辆车，只是适配了新条件。

senses.title: Modification in grammar: one word qualifying another
senses.titleCN: 语法上的修饰：一个词限定另一个词
senses.definition: in grammar, the relation in which one word or phrase qualifies or limits another
senses.definitionCN: 语法中一个词或短语限定、修饰另一个词的关系
senses.example: In the phrase 'a small room', the adjective is a modification of the noun.
senses.exampleCN: 在 a small room（一个小房间）这一短语中，形容词是对名词的修饰。
senses.why: Grammar reuses the idea of limiting: a modifier sets the measure of what it modifies, narrowing 'room' to a small one. The same Latin root gives the grammatical term.
senses.whyCN: 语法沿用了「限定」这一观念：修饰语为被修饰者设定尺度，把 room（房间）缩小为小的那一类。同一拉丁词根给出了这个语法术语。

senses.title: Genetic modification: rewriting the instructions
senses.titleCN: 基因改造：改写生命的说明书
senses.definition: a deliberate change to the genetic material of an organism
senses.definitionCN: 对生物体遗传物质所作的有意改动
senses.example: Genetic modification of the crop made it resist drought.
senses.exampleCN: 对这项作物的基因改造使它耐旱。
senses.why: The material being adjusted is now a sequence. The word stays technical and neutral; the controversy around it belongs to the consequences, not to the word.
senses.whyCN: 此时被调整的材料是一段序列。词仍保持技术性与中性；围绕它的争议属于后果，而不属于这个词。

senses.title: Modification of behaviour: changing habits
senses.titleCN: 行为调整：改掉旧习惯
senses.definition: the deliberate changing of a person's or animal's behaviour through training or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 通过训练或治疗有意改变人或动物行为的过程
senses.example: Behaviour modification helped the child sleep through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 行为调整帮这个孩子一觉睡到天亮。
senses.why: A pattern of behaviour has a shape, and that shape can be measured and adjusted. The phrase borrows the technical word to avoid the moral tone of 'correction'.
senses.whyCN: 行为模式有一种形状，而这种形状可以被衡量、被调整。这一说法借用了技术词，以避免「纠正」二字的道德语调。

senses.title: A formal amendment to a document
senses.titleCN: 文件的正式修正
senses.definition: a formal change to a contract, law or official document
senses.definitionCN: 对合同、法律或正式文件的正式改动
senses.example: The parties agreed to one modification of the payment terms.
senses.exampleCN: 双方同意对付款条件作一处修改。
senses.why: Legal language needs a word for a change that is written down and agreed. Modification names that bounded, recorded alteration rather than a fresh agreement.
senses.whyCN: 法律语言需要一个词，指被写下并获同意的改动。modification 命名的正是这种有边界、有记录的改动，而不是重新达成协议。

senses.title: Improvement by adjustment
senses.titleCN: 改良：靠调整变好
senses.definition: an adjustment made to improve performance, quality or appearance
senses.definitionCN: 为改善性能、质量或外观所作的调整
senses.example: A simple modification to the engine raised fuel efficiency.
senses.exampleCN: 对发动机的一处简单改良提高了燃油效率。
senses.why: Since modus also means the right measure, modification carries a hint of fitting something better. The change is not random; it aims at a better proportion.
senses.whyCN: 因为 modus 也有「恰当尺度」之义，modification 带有「调得更合适」的意味。这种改动不是随机的，它指向更好的比例。

senses.title: Chemical modification: attaching new groups
senses.titleCN: 化学改性：给分子挂上新基团
senses.definition: in chemistry, a change made to a molecule by adding, removing or replacing chemical groups
senses.definitionCN: 化学中通过添加、移除或替换化学基团而对分子所作的改动
senses.example: Chemical modification of the starch improved its solubility.
senses.exampleCN: 对淀粉的化学改性改善了它的溶解性。
senses.why: The molecule keeps its backbone while its surface is altered, which is exactly the image of a partial change. The word's older sense of adjusting a measure fits a measured structure.
senses.whyCN: 分子保留主链，只改动表面，这正是「局部改动」的意象。这个词较早的「调整尺度」义，恰好贴合一种有尺度的结构。

intro.en: Modification comes from Latin modificatio, the noun of modificare 'to measure off, regulate, arrange'. Modificare joins modus 'measure, manner' with facere 'to make'. English borrowed the noun in the 17th century. Modus goes back to the reconstructed root *med- 'to measure', the same root as measure and medicine. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: modification 出自拉丁语 modificatio，即 modificare「量定、调节、安排」的名词。modificare 由 modus「尺度、方式」与 facere「做」组成。英语在 17 世纪借入这个名词。modus 可追溯到重构词根 *med-「测量」，与 measure、medicine 同源。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Genetic modification and chemical modification become standard phrases in biology and industry.
items.cn: genetic modification（基因改造）与 chemical modification（化学修饰）在生物学与工业中成为固定说法。

items.en: Behaviour modification and design modification spread as technical phrases in psychology and engineering.
items.cn: behaviour modification（行为矫正）与 design modification（设计修改）作为技术说法在心理学与工程领域扩散。

items.en: English modification is recorded, borrowed from Latin modificatio, at first meaning the act of regulating or limiting.
items.cn: 英语 modification 见于记载，借自拉丁语 modificatio，最初指调节或限定的行为。

items.en: modificare is modus 'measure' plus facere 'make', so the verb means to give something a due measure.
items.cn: modificare 是 modus「尺度」加 facere「做」，因此动词意为给某物一个恰当的尺度。

items.en: modus goes back to the reconstructed root *med- 'to measure, take the right size', which also gives measure, modest and medicine.
items.cn: modus 可追溯到重构词根 *med-「测量、取恰当尺寸」，该词根也给出 measure、modest、medicine。

note.en: The first group separates real relatives from a modern-looking neighbour; the second compares three words for change that differ in scale and formality.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与一个看似现代的邻词分开；第二组比较三个表示改变的词，它们在幅度与正式程度上不同。

entries.definition: to change something partially, or in grammar to qualify it. It is the verb behind modification and carries the same sense of adjusting rather than replacing.
entries.definitionCN: 部分地改动某物，语法上指修饰。它是 modification 背后的动词，同样含「调整而非替换」之义。

entries.definition: a way of doing something, or a fashion. It is Latin modus itself: the measure or manner that modification adjusts.
entries.definitionCN: 做事的方式，或时尚。它就是拉丁语 modus 本身：modification 所调整的那个尺度或方式。

entries.definition: the process of making something modern. It rests on modernus 'just now', built on modo 'just now', not on modus 'measure', so the two are not relatives.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物现代化的过程。它建立在 modernus「刚刚」上，后者出自 modo「刚才」，而非 modus「尺度」，因此两词并非同族。

entries.definition: a change in the form or nature of something. It can be large or complete, while modification usually implies a bounded adjustment.
entries.definitionCN: 某物形式或性质上的改变。它可大可彻底，而 modification 通常暗示有边界的调整。

entries.definition: a small change made to fit a condition better. It is close to modification but stresses fitting, not redesigning.
entries.definitionCN: 为更好适应某一条件所作的小改动。它接近 modification，但强调「使之合」，而非重新设计。

entries.definition: a formal change to a law or document. It is the legal and political word, where modification may also be a technical change.
entries.definitionCN: 对法律或文件的正式改动。它是法律与政治用语，而 modification 也可以是技术性改动。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: modus 'measure' plus facere 'make': modification is making something to a new measure.
normal.cn: modus「尺度」加 facere「做」：modification 就是按新的尺度把某物做一遍。

normal.en: The -ification ending marks the act of making, as in simplification and classification.
normal.cn: -ification 词尾标记「使……化」的动作，如 simplification、classification。

normal.en: mode, modest, moderate and modify all come from modus, the idea of due measure.
normal.cn: mode、modest、moderate、modify 都出自 modus，即「恰当尺度」这一观念。

normal.en: Modernization looks modern but comes from modo 'just now', not from modus 'measure'.
normal.cn: modernization 看着像 modern，却出自 modo「刚才」，不是 modus「尺度」。

normal.en: A modification leaves the thing recognisable; a replacement leaves nothing of the original.
normal.cn: modification 让原物仍可辨认；替换则不留原物的痕迹。

abstract.en: Think of a coat with the sleeves moved: the outline changed, the coat did not.
abstract.cn: 想象一件挪了袖子的外套：轮廓变了，外套没变。

abstract.en: Every sense asks how far a change may go before the thing becomes something else.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：改动可以走多远，才不至于让原物变成另一样东西。

abstract.en: The word is about proportion: a good modification is a better fit, not a bigger change.
abstract.cn: 这个词关乎比例：好的改动是更合身，而不是改得更多。

examples.en: The plan needs only minor modification before approval.
examples.cn: 这个方案只需小幅修改就能获批。

examples.en: Modification of the river channel changed the flood pattern.
examples.cn: 对河道的改造改变了洪水规律。

examples.en: The software allows modification of the template by users.
examples.cn: 这款软件允许用户修改模板。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摩的飞客神」——摩的飞驰而过，客人衣裳被改短一截，人还是那个人 → modification 修改、改动

root: 拉丁语 modus「尺度、方式」＋facere「做」→ modificare「量定、调整」→ modificatio → 英语 modification。核心是「把某物调到更合适的尺度」，改的是局部，不是整件重造。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a thing adjusted to a new measure while keeping its identity. What changes is what is adjusted — an object, a machine, a word, a gene, a habit, a contract, a design, or a molecule.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：某物被调到新的尺度，同时保持自身同一性。变化的只是被调整的是什么——物件、机器、词语、基因、习惯、合同、设计，还是一个分子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coat taken apart, sleeves moved, still the same coat.
core.cn: 核心意象：外套被拆开、袖子挪了位置，仍是同一件外套。

branches.en: ADJUSTING: modus supplies the measure, so a modification is a change toward a better fit, not a replacement.
branches.cn: 调整：modus 提供尺度，因此 modification 是朝更合身的方向改，而不是替换。

branches.en: REFITTING: equipment and buildings are altered so that they suit a new use while staying themselves.
branches.cn: 改装：设备与建筑被改动以适合新用途，同时仍是原来的东西。

branches.en: GRAMMATICAL LIMITING: a modifier sets the measure of the word it qualifies, narrowing its range.
branches.cn: 语法限定：修饰语为被修饰的词设定尺度，收窄它的范围。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND CODE: genes and molecules are altered at specific sites, leaving the backbone intact.
branches.cn: 物质与编码：基因与分子在特定位点被改动，主链保持完整。

branches.en: HABIT AND PAPER: behaviour is retrained, and documents are amended in writing.
branches.cn: 习惯与文书：行为被重新训练，文件则以书面形式修改。

intro.en: Modification is Latin modific- plus -ation. The stem is modificare, from modus 'measure' and facere 'make'; the ending -ation names the action or its result.
intro.cn: modification 是拉丁词干 modific- 加 -ation。词干来自 modificare，由 modus「尺度」与 facere「做」构成；词尾 -ation 表示动作或其结果。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are modus 'measure, manner' and facere 'to make'. facere also gives -ficare verbs such as simplify and classify, and modus gives mode, moderate and modest.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁成分是 modus「尺度、方式」与 facere「做」。facere 还构成 simplify、classify 一类 -ficare 动词，modus 则给出 mode、moderate、modest。

items.meaning: a partial change made to something
items.meaningCN: 对某物所作的局部改动
items.example: One modification doubled the machine's output.
items.exampleCN: 一处改动让这台机器的产量翻倍。

items.meaning: to change partially, or to qualify in grammar
items.example: They modified the design to cut costs.
items.exampleCN: 他们改了设计以降低成本。

items.meaning: a word that qualifies another, or a person who modifies
items.example: The adjective is a modifier of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是名词的修饰语。

items.meaning: able to be changed
items.example: The settings are easily modifiable.
items.exampleCN: 这些设置很容易修改。

items.meaning: having been changed
items.example: The modified engine runs cooler.
items.exampleCN: 改过的发动机运行温度更低。

items.meaning: a manner or way, or a prevailing fashion
items.example: Switch the phone to silent mode.
items.exampleCN: 把手机切换到静音模式。

items.meaning: kept within due limits
items.meaningCN: 适度的；温和的（字面「有尺度的」）
items.example: They expect moderate growth this year.
items.exampleCN: 他们预计今年会有适度增长。

items.meaning: not boastful, or not large
items.meaningCN: 谦虚的；不大的（字面「守着尺度的」）
items.example: She asked for a modest sum.
items.exampleCN: 她要的数目不大。

items.meaning: to adjust in measure, especially a voice or a signal
items.example: He modulated his voice to sound calm.
items.exampleCN: 他调节嗓音，让自己听起来平静。

items.meaning: a good that suits a common measure, hence something traded
items.meaningCN: 商品；日用品（字面「合乎共同尺度的东西」）
items.example: Coffee became a global commodity.
items.exampleCN: 咖啡成了全球性的商品。

latinEntries.meaning: to set a measure, regulate, arrange
forms a noun of action or result

definition_zh: 分子的；分子层面的；分子结构的；分子生物学的；分子量或分子式的；分子尺度的；分子遗传学的；分子医学的
definition_en: relating to molecules, to the level of molecules, or to the branch of science that studies them
core_image: 一粒糖被无限放大，最后看见两个小球被一根弹簧连着
scene: Zoom into a grain of sugar until two small spheres hang from a spring: at that scale the structure is molecular.
sceneCN: 这里 molecular 是「分子的」（第 1 个义项：与分子有关的）；句意：把一粒糖不断放大，直到看见两个小球用一根弹簧相连，在那个尺度上，这种结构就是分子的。图中可辨识物件：放大的糖粒、两个相连的小球、弹簧式化学键、显微镜、比例标尺。

pos.zh: 分子的；分子层面的；分子结构的

forms.label: 名词（分子性；反应分子数）
