senses.title: Relating to molecules
senses.titleCN: 分子的：与分子这一实体有关
senses.definition: relating to molecules as the smallest units of a substance that keep its chemical identity
senses.definitionCN: 指与分子有关的；分子是保持物质化学性质的最小单元
senses.example: The two samples differ only at the molecular level.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个样本只在分子层面有所不同。
senses.why: Molecule plus -ar makes a relating adjective, as in similar or regular: molecular means 'of a molecule'. The suffix points at the entity, not at the science.
senses.whyCN: molecule 加 -ar 构成关系形容词，如同 similar、regular：molecular 意为「分子的」。词尾指向这个实体，而不是这门学科。

senses.title: At the molecular level: a scale of description
senses.titleCN: 分子层面的：一种描述尺度
senses.definition: describing a level of explanation that deals with molecules rather than with visible objects or with atoms
senses.definitionCN: 指在分子这一尺度上解释，而不是在可见物体或原子的尺度上解释
senses.example: The disease has a molecular explanation.
senses.exampleCN: 这种病有一个分子层面的解释。
senses.why: Once a level of description is named, the adjective can mark it. Between the atom and the cell sits the molecule, and molecular names everything that happens there.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某一描述层级被命名，这个形容词就能标记它。原子与细胞之间是分子，凡发生在这一层的事都叫 molecular。

senses.title: Of molecular structure: how atoms are arranged
senses.titleCN: 分子结构的：原子如何排布
senses.definition: relating to the arrangement of atoms within a molecule and the bonds between them
senses.definitionCN: 指分子内部原子的排布以及它们之间的化学键
senses.example: The drug's molecular structure was mapped in detail.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药的分子结构被详细绘制出来。
senses.why: Structure is what the molecule has instead of a shape you can see. The adjective marks the internal architecture that determines how the substance behaves.
senses.whyCN: 分子拥有的是结构，而不是看得见的形状。这个形容词标记决定物质行为的内部构造。

senses.title: Of molecular biology: the field that works at this level
senses.titleCN: 分子生物学的：在这一层面工作的学科
senses.definition: relating to the branch of biology that studies the molecules that carry and express genetic information
senses.definitionCN: 指研究承载与表达遗传信息的分子的生物学分支
senses.example: Molecular biology transformed how cells are understood.
senses.exampleCN: 分子生物学改变了人们对细胞的理解。
senses.why: A field is named by the level it works at. Molecular biology studies life through its molecules, and the adjective simply attaches the field's name to its noun.
senses.whyCN: 一门学科以它工作的层级来命名。分子生物学通过分子研究生命，而这个形容词只是把学科名称接到名词上。

senses.title: Of molecular weight and formula
senses.titleCN: 分子量与分子式的
senses.definition: relating to values calculated from a molecule's composition, such as its formula and its weight
senses.definitionCN: 指由分子的组成计算出的数值，如分子式与分子量
senses.example: Molecular weight is expressed in daltons.
senses.exampleCN: 分子量用道尔顿表示。
senses.why: A molecule has a countable composition: so many atoms of each kind. The adjective therefore also covers the numbers derived from that composition.
senses.whyCN: 分子的组成是可数的：每类原子各有多少个。因此这个形容词也覆盖由该组成推导出的数值。

senses.title: Molecular scale: extremely small
senses.titleCN: 分子尺度：极其微小
senses.definition: describing sizes, devices or effects on the scale of molecules, far below the visible
senses.definitionCN: 指在分子尺度上的尺寸、器件或效应，远小于肉眼可见
senses.example: Molecular machines move a few nanometres at a time.
senses.exampleCN: 分子机器每次只移动几纳米。
senses.why: Here the adjective works like a unit of size. It says that the thing operates at the scale where molecules, not millimetres, are the natural measure.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个形容词相当于一种尺寸单位。它说明该事物运作的尺度上，天然的单位是分子，而不是毫米。

senses.title: Of molecular genetics: inheritance at this level
senses.titleCN: 分子遗传学的：在这一层面研究遗传
senses.definition: relating to the study of inheritance through the structure and activity of DNA and related molecules
senses.definitionCN: 指通过 DNA（脱氧核糖核酸）及相关分子的结构与活动来研究遗传
senses.example: Molecular genetics identified the mutation.
senses.exampleCN: 分子遗传学定位到了这个突变。
senses.why: Genetics used to be about breeding ratios; molecular genetics is about the material. The adjective marks the shift from pattern to mechanism.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学过去关心繁育比例，分子遗传学关心物质本身。这个形容词标记了从模式到机制的转变。

senses.title: Of molecular medicine: treatment aimed at molecules
senses.titleCN: 分子医学的：把治疗对准分子
senses.definition: relating to medicine that diagnoses or treats disease by acting on specific molecules
senses.definitionCN: 指通过作用于特定分子来诊断或治疗疾病的医学
senses.example: Molecular medicine targets the faulty protein directly.
senses.exampleCN: 分子医学直接针对那个出错的蛋白。
senses.why: Medicine adds the adjective when the target of treatment is a molecule rather than an organ. The word marks precision at the smallest working scale.
senses.whyCN: 当治疗针对的是分子而非器官时，医学就在前面加上这个形容词。这个词标记的是最小工作尺度上的精确性。

intro.en: Molecular is molecule plus -ar, the relating suffix seen in similar and regular. Molecule goes back through French molécule to Latin molecula, a diminutive of moles 'mass, heap, massive structure'. The adjective is recorded in the 19th century, once chemistry had fixed what a molecule is. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: molecular 是 molecule 加 -ar，这个关系后缀也见于 similar 与 regular。molecule 经法语 molécule 追溯到拉丁语 molecula，后者是 moles「块体、堆、庞大结构」的指小形式。该形容词在 19 世纪见于记载，当时化学已确定分子的含义。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Molecular biology, molecular genetics and molecular medicine become names of whole fields.
items.cn: 分子生物学、分子遗传学与分子医学成为整门学科的名称。

items.en: English molecular is recorded, formed on molecule with -ar once the chemical concept was established.
items.cn: 英语 molecular 见于记载，在化学概念确立后由 molecule 加 -ar 构成。

items.en: French molécule supplies the immediate source, a learned coinage from the Latin diminutive molecula.
items.cn: 法语 molécule 是直接来源，它是从拉丁指小形式 molecula 造出的学术词。

items.en: molecula is a diminutive of moles 'mass, heap', so a molecule was first a small mass rather than a bonded group of atoms.
items.cn: molecula 是 moles「块体、堆」的指小形式，因此 molecule 最初指一小团物质，而不是成键的原子团。

items.en: The further origin of moles is of uncertain origin; it is not securely traced to a single reconstructed root.
items.cn: moles 的更早来源不确定，未能可靠地追溯到某一个重构词根。

note.en: The first group separates two homographs and one false neighbour from the family; the second compares adjectives of very small scale.
note.cn: 第一组把两个同形异义词与一个假邻居从词族中分出来；第二组比较表示极小尺度的形容词。

entries.definition: a grinding tooth, or a concentration per mole. The tooth sense comes from Latin mola 'millstone', and the chemistry sense from mole, so neither is a relative of molecule.
entries.definitionCN: 磨牙，或指每摩尔的浓度。牙齿义出自拉丁语 mola「磨石」，化学义出自 mole，两者都不是 molecule 的同族词。

entries.definition: The animal comes from Germanic roots and the unit of chemical amount is shortened from molecule. The two spell the same but share no history.
entries.definitionCN: 指动物时出自日耳曼词根；指化学物质的量单位时则是 molecule 的缩略。两者拼写相同，却没有共同的历史。

entries.definition: the smallest unit of a substance that keeps its chemical identity. The adjective molecular adds only the relating suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 保持物质化学性质的最小单元。形容词 molecular 只加了一个关系后缀。

entries.definition: relating to atoms, the units below molecules. Atomic work goes one level deeper than molecular work.
entries.definitionCN: 与原子有关的，原子在分子之下。原子层面的工作比分子层面的工作再深一层。

entries.definition: consisting of small separate particles, especially in air or water. It names bits of matter, not chemically bonded units.
entries.definitionCN: 由细小颗粒构成的，尤指空气或水中的颗粒。它指物质的碎粒，而不是化学成键的单元。

entries.definition: too small to be seen with an ordinary microscope. It describes size alone, with no claim about chemical structure.
entries.definitionCN: 小到普通显微镜看不见。它只描述大小，不对化学结构作任何主张。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: molecule plus -ar gives molecular, exactly as similar comes from simil- plus -ar.
normal.cn: molecule 加 -ar 得到 molecular，正如 similar 由 simil- 加 -ar 而来。

normal.en: The -cule in molecule is a Latin diminutive, so the word began as 'a little mass'.
normal.cn: molecule 里的 -cule 是拉丁指小成分，所以这个词最初是「一小团物质」。

normal.en: Molar the tooth comes from mola 'millstone' and is not a relative; molar the concentration comes from mole.
normal.cn: 指牙齿的 molar 出自 mola「磨石」，并非同族；指浓度的 molar 则出自 mole。

normal.en: Every molecular phrase names a level: structure, weight, biology, genetics, medicine.
normal.cn: 每个 molecular 短语都命名一个层级：结构、重量、生物学、遗传学、医学。

normal.en: macromolecule and bimolecular show how the family grows: macro- for large, bi- for two.
normal.cn: macromolecule 与 bimolecular 显示这个词族如何生长：macro- 表大，bi- 表二。

abstract.en: Picture zooming into sugar until the crystal becomes a crowd of small joined shapes.
abstract.cn: 想象不断放大糖粒，直到晶体变成一大群相连的小形状。

abstract.en: The molecular level is the workshop where chemistry explains what the eye cannot see.
abstract.cn: 分子层面就是化学解释肉眼所不见之物的那间作坊。

abstract.en: The word always lowers the scale of the question rather than changing the question.
abstract.cn: 这个词总是把问题的尺度放低，而不改变问题本身。

examples.en: Molecular evidence placed the species in a different family.
examples.cn: 分子层面的证据把这个物种归入了另一个科。

examples.en: The lab studies molecular changes during freezing.
examples.cn: 这个实验室研究冷冻过程中的分子变化。

examples.en: Molecular weight affects how fast the substance diffuses.
examples.cn: 分子量影响这种物质扩散的快慢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「莫乐扣了」——莫要乐得把扣子扣错，先看清分子怎么连的 → molecular 分子的

root: 拉丁语 moles「块体、堆」→ 指小形式 molecula「一小团物质」→ 法语 molécule → 英语 molecule；加 -ar（关系形容词后缀）→ molecular。核心是「把尺度降到分子这一层去看」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a scale small enough that atoms appear as joined shapes. What changes is the question asked at that scale — what a molecule is, at which level we explain, how it is built, which field studies it, what numbers describe it, how small it is, how inheritance works there, or how medicine acts there.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一个尺度，小到原子显现为相连的形状。变化的只是在该尺度上问什么——分子是什么、我们在哪一层解释、它怎么搭建、哪门学科研究它、用哪些数字描述它、它有多小、遗传在此如何运作，还是医学如何在此起作用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grain of sugar magnified until two spheres hang from a spring.
core.cn: 核心意象：一粒糖被放大，直到看见两个小球被一根弹簧连着。

branches.en: THE ENTITY AND ITS LEVEL: molecular names the molecule and also the layer of explanation where it sits.
branches.cn: 实体及其层级：molecular 既指分子，也指分子所处的解释层级。

branches.en: ARRANGEMENT AND NUMBER: structure says how atoms are joined, formula and weight say how many of each.
branches.cn: 排布与数字：结构说明原子如何相连，分子式与分子量说明各有几个。

branches.en: THE FIELDS: biology and genetics work at this level, and their names carry the adjective.
branches.cn: 学科：生物学与遗传学在这一层面工作，其名称带着这个形容词。

branches.en: THE SCALE ITSELF: devices and effects measured in nanometres are molecular in size.
branches.cn: 尺度本身：以纳米计的器件与效应，在大小上是分子级的。

branches.en: MEDICINE AT THE TARGET: treatment aims at a specific molecule instead of an organ.
branches.cn: 对准靶点的医学：治疗针对特定分子，而不是器官。

intro.en: Molecular is molecule plus -ar. The suffix -ar, from Latin -aris, makes a relating adjective; molecule itself is a diminutive in -cule from Latin moles.
intro.cn: molecular 是 molecule 加 -ar。后缀 -ar 出自拉丁语 -aris，构成关系形容词；molecule 本身则是拉丁语 moles 加 -cule 的指小形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is moles 'mass, heap, massive structure'. Its diminutive molecula gives molecule, and moles also underlies demolish and mole as a breakwater.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 moles「块体、堆、庞大结构」。其指小形式 molecula 给出 molecule，moles 还支撑 demolish 与作防波堤解的 mole。

items.meaning: relating to molecules
items.example: Molecular structure decides the drug's effect.
items.exampleCN: 分子结构决定药效。

items.meaning: the smallest chemically distinct unit
items.meaningCN: 保持化学性质的最小单元
items.example: A water molecule has three atoms.
items.exampleCN: 一个水分子有三个原子。

items.meaning: at the molecular level
items.example: The two oils are molecularly similar.
items.exampleCN: 这两种油在分子层面相似。

items.meaning: the state of being molecular; in chemistry, the number of molecules reacting
items.meaningCN: 分子性；（化学）反应分子数
items.example: The reaction's molecularity is two.
items.exampleCN: 这个反应的分子数是二。

items.meaning: a very large molecule such as a protein
items.example: Proteins are macromolecules built from amino acids.
items.exampleCN: 蛋白质是由氨基酸构成的大分子。

items.meaning: involving two molecules in a reaction step
items.meaningCN: 双分子的（一步反应涉及两个分子）
items.example: The step is bimolecular.
items.exampleCN: 这一步是双分子反应。

items.meaning: a unit of chemical amount
items.meaningCN: 摩尔（物质的量单位，由 molecule 缩略而来）
items.example: One mole contains Avogadro's number of particles.
items.exampleCN: 一摩尔含有阿伏伽德罗常数个粒子。

items.meaning: measured per mole of substance
items.example: Molar concentration is written in mol per litre.
items.exampleCN: 摩尔浓度以每升摩尔数表示。

items.meaning: to pull a structure down
items.meaningCN: 拆除；推倒（de- 表示向下，moliri 出自 moles）
items.example: They demolished the old mill.
items.exampleCN: 他们拆掉了那座旧磨坊。

items.structure: Latin moles used for a massive barrier
items.meaning: a stone breakwater built out into the sea
items.meaningCN: 防波堤（原义为庞大的堆体）
items.example: The harbour mole protects the boats.
items.exampleCN: 港口的防波堤保护着船只。

latinEntries.meaning: a mass, a heap, a massive structure

definition_zh: 分子；微粒；生物大分子；单分子；气体或液体中的独立单元；极少量；聚合物的重复单元；微小成分
definition_en: the smallest unit of a substance that keeps its chemical identity, consisting of two or more atoms held together by chemical bonds
core_image: 两个氧原子被一条看不见的弹簧拉住，独自成团地飘在空气里
scene: Two oxygen atoms held together by an invisible bond drift as one group: that group is a molecule.
sceneCN: 这里 molecule 是「分子」（第 1 个义项：化学中的最小独立单元）；句意：两个氧原子被一条看不见的键拉在一起，作为一个整体在空气中漂移，这个整体就是分子。图中可辨识物件：两个相连的氧原子模型、代表化学键的虚线、空气背景中的其它分子、比例标尺。

forms.label: 名词（分子性；反应分子数）

senses.title: The chemical unit: atoms bonded into one group
senses.titleCN: 化学分子：原子成键组成的整体
senses.definition: the smallest unit of a substance that keeps its chemical identity, made of atoms held together by chemical bonds
senses.definitionCN: 保持物质化学性质的最小单元，由化学键连接的原子组成
senses.example: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
senses.exampleCN: 一个水分子含两个氢原子和一个氧原子。
senses.why: Molecule began as Latin molecula, 'a little mass'. Chemistry narrowed it to the smallest group of bonded atoms that still behaves as the substance, so the word moved from 'small lump' to 'bonded unit'.
senses.whyCN: molecule 最初是拉丁语 molecula「一小团物质」。化学把它收窄为仍然表现为该物质的最小成键原子团，于是词义从「小团块」转成「成键单元」。

senses.title: A tiny particle of matter
senses.titleCN: 微粒：极小的物质颗粒
senses.definition: a very small particle of a substance, considered without regard to its internal bonds
senses.definitionCN: 物质中极小的颗粒，不考虑其内部成键情况
senses.example: Dust molecules coated the mirror.
senses.exampleCN: 灰尘微粒覆盖了镜面。
senses.why: The older, looser sense survives in ordinary speech, where any very small piece of matter may be called a molecule. Here the word means size, not chemistry.
senses.whyCN: 较旧、较松的义项在日常语言中留存，任何极小的物质碎屑都可能被称为 molecule。此处词义指的是大小，而不是化学。

senses.title: Biological macromolecule: proteins, DNA, starch
senses.titleCN: 生物大分子：蛋白质、DNA、淀粉
senses.definition: a very large molecule built from many repeating units, especially one found in living things
senses.definitionCN: 由许多重复单元构成的极大分子，尤指存在于生物体中的
senses.example: Each cell contains thousands of protein molecules.
senses.exampleCN: 每个细胞含有数千个蛋白质分子。
senses.why: Biology called its long chains molecules because they are bonded units, then added macro- when the size became the point. The base word keeps its chemical sense throughout.
senses.whyCN: 生物学把长链称为 molecule，因为它们就是成键单元；当大小成为重点时，又加上 macro-。词基本身始终保留化学义。

senses.title: Single-molecule work: studying one at a time
senses.titleCN: 单分子：一次只研究一个
senses.definition: in research, one individual molecule examined or manipulated on its own rather than in bulk
senses.definitionCN: 研究中指被单独观测或操作的那一个分子，而不是整批
senses.example: Single-molecule imaging revealed the folding steps.
senses.exampleCN: 单分子成像揭示了折叠的各个步骤。
senses.why: When instruments became sharp enough, the word needed a countable singular. Single-molecule marks the shift from averaging a crowd to watching one individual.
senses.whyCN: 当仪器足够精细时，这个词需要一个可数的单数形式。single-molecule 标记了从对一群分子取平均，转为观察单个分子的转变。

senses.title: The independent unit in a gas or liquid
senses.titleCN: 气体或液体中的独立单元
senses.definition: the separate unit that moves independently in a gas or solution, as opposed to a continuous network
senses.definitionCN: 在气体或溶液中独立运动的单元，与连续网络相对
senses.example: Gas molecules collide millions of times each second.
senses.exampleCN: 气体分子每秒碰撞数百万次。
senses.why: Kinetic theory needs a unit that travels freely. A molecule is exactly that: a bonded group small enough to move as one body through a fluid.
senses.whyCN: 动理论需要一个能自由行进的单元。分子正合适：那是一个小到能作为一个整体在流体中运动的成键原子团。

senses.title: A trace: a molecule of something
senses.titleCN: 极少量：一丝一毫
senses.definition: an extremely small amount of something, used in phrases such as not a molecule of truth
senses.definitionCN: 极少的量，用在 not a molecule of truth（一点真相也没有）一类的说法中
senses.example: There is not a molecule of evidence for that claim.
senses.exampleCN: 那个主张连一丝证据都没有。
senses.why: Because a molecule is invisibly small, the word can mean 'the least possible amount'. The metaphor borrows the chemist's smallest unit for the smallest imaginable trace.
senses.whyCN: 因为分子小到不可见，这个词可以表示「可能的最少量」。这一比喻借化学家的最小单位，指想象所及的最微小痕迹。

senses.title: The repeating unit of a polymer
senses.titleCN: 聚合物的重复单元
senses.definition: in polymer chemistry, the repeating structural unit from which a long chain is built
senses.definitionCN: 高分子化学中指构成长链的重复结构单元
senses.example: Each molecule in the chain repeats the same pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 链中的每个单元重复着同一模式。
senses.why: Here the word names the brick rather than the wall. Polymer science counts how many molecule units are joined, so molecule marks the unit of repetition.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词指的是砖，而不是墙。高分子科学要数有多少个分子单元被连起来，因此 molecule 标记的是重复单位。

senses.title: A minute element of a larger thing
senses.titleCN: 微小成分：大事物里的一小点
senses.definition: a very small element or ingredient within a larger whole, used figuratively
senses.definitionCN: 较大整体中极小的成分或要素，用于比喻
senses.example: A molecule of doubt remained in his mind.
senses.exampleCN: 他心里还留着一丝疑虑。
senses.why: The figurative sense treats an idea as a substance with parts. One molecule of doubt is the smallest part that still counts as doubt, exactly as a molecule is the smallest part that still counts as the substance.
senses.whyCN: 比喻义把念头当作有组成部分的物质。一丝疑虑就是还算得上疑虑的最小部分，正如一个分子是还算得上该物质的最小部分。

intro.en: Molecule comes through French molécule from Latin molecula, a diminutive of moles 'mass, heap, massive structure'. The early sense was simply 'a small mass'. Modern chemistry fixed the meaning as a bonded group of atoms in the early 19th century, after Avogadro distinguished molecules from atoms. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: molecule 经法语 molécule 来自拉丁语 molecula，即 moles「块体、堆、庞大结构」的指小形式。早期义只是「一小团物质」。现代化学在 19 世纪初把词义固定为成键的原子团，此前阿伏伽德罗已区分分子与原子。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Chemistry fixes molecule as a bonded group of atoms, and single-molecule work appears much later with sharper instruments.
items.cn: 化学把 molecule 固定为成键的原子团；单分子研究则要晚得多，随着更精细的仪器才出现。

items.en: English molecule is borrowed in the general sense of a small mass or particle, before any chemical definition.
items.cn: 英语 molecule 在尚无化学定义时借入，泛指一小团物质或微粒。

items.en: French molécule is coined from the Latin diminutive as part of early corpuscular theory.
items.cn: 法语 molécule 由拉丁指小形式造出，属于早期微粒说的一部分。

items.en: molecula is moles 'mass' plus the diminutive -cula; it means a small mass, not a bonded group.
items.cn: molecula 是 moles「块体」加指小成分 -cula，意为小团物质，不是成键的原子团。

items.en: The origin of moles beyond Latin is of uncertain origin and is not securely tied to a reconstructed root.
items.cn: moles 在拉丁语之前的来源不确定，未能可靠地系于某个重构词根。

note.en: The first group separates three words that look related but are not, or are related only in one sense; the second compares units of matter at different levels.
note.cn: 第一组把三个看似相关、实则无关或只在某一义上相关的词分开；第二组比较不同层级上的物质单元。

entries.definition: a small burrowing animal. This word comes from Germanic roots and has no connection with molecula, despite the identical spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 一种小型穴居动物。这个词出自日耳曼词根，尽管拼写相同，却与 molecula 无关。

entries.definition: the unit of chemical amount. This one is shortened from molecule, so it is a relative, unlike the animal.
entries.definitionCN: 化学中物质的量的单位。这个词由 molecule 缩略而来，因此与动物义的 mole 不同，它是同族词。

entries.definition: a grinding tooth, from Latin mola 'millstone'. The chemistry adjective molar comes from mole instead, so the two meanings have different histories.
entries.definitionCN: 磨牙，出自拉丁语 mola「磨石」。化学形容词 molar 则出自 mole，两个含义历史不同。

entries.definition: the smallest unit of an element. Atoms are the parts that molecules are built from, so the two words mark different levels.
entries.definitionCN: 元素的最小单元。原子是构成分子的部件，因此两词标记不同层级。

entries.definition: a very small piece of matter. It says nothing about bonds, and may even be larger than a molecule.
entries.definitionCN: 极小的物质碎块。它不涉及成键，甚至可能比分子还大。

entries.definition: a substance made of two or more elements chemically joined. It names a material, while molecule names one unit of it.
entries.definitionCN: 由两种或以上元素化学结合而成的物质。它命名一种材料，而 molecule 命名该材料的一个单元。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The -cule is a diminutive, so molecule literally begins as 'a small mass'.
normal.cn: -cule 是指小成分，所以 molecule 字面上起于「一小团物质」。

normal.en: Moles also gives demolish, 'to take the mass down', and mole as a breakwater, 'a mass built out'.
normal.cn: moles 还给出 demolish「把块体拆下」以及作防波堤解的 mole「向外筑起的块体」。

normal.en: The chemical unit and the unit of amount are linked: mole is simply molecule shortened.
normal.cn: 化学分子与物质的量单位是相连的：mole 就是 molecule 的缩略。

normal.en: The animal mole shares spelling but not history, so it never appears in chemistry.
normal.cn: 动物义的 mole 只是拼写相同，历史不同，因此从不进入化学语境。

normal.en: A molecule is the smallest piece that still behaves like the substance: split it and the substance is gone.
normal.cn: 分子是仍然表现得像该物质的最小部分：再切开，该物质就不存在了。

abstract.en: See two balls joined by a spring drifting as one body through empty space.
abstract.cn: 想象两个小球被一根弹簧连着，作为一个整体在空处漂移。

abstract.en: Every sense treats the molecule as a smallest whole: smallest unit, smallest particle, smallest trace, smallest ingredient.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都把分子当作一个最小的整体：最小单元、最小颗粒、最少痕迹、最小成分。

abstract.en: The word sits one floor above the atom and one floor below the material.
abstract.cn: 这个词位于原子之上、材料之下的一层。

examples.en: Ozone is a molecule of three oxygen atoms.
examples.cn: 臭氧是由三个氧原子构成的分子。

examples.en: The enzyme breaks each starch molecule into sugars.
examples.cn: 这种酶把每个淀粉分子分解成糖。

examples.en: Not a molecule of the original text survives.
examples.cn: 原文一丝一毫都没有留存下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「莫利Q」——莫利把Q弹的两个小球连成一小团，飘着走 → molecule 分子

root: 拉丁语 moles「块体、堆」＋指小成分 -cula → molecula「一小团物质」→ 法语 molécule → 英语 molecule。核心是「小到仍是该物质的最小一团」，化学把它定为成键的原子团。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: the smallest group that still counts as the thing. What changes is the frame — a chemical unit, a dust particle, a long biological chain, one observed individual, a free-flying gas unit, a trace, a repeating brick in a polymer, or a small ingredient of an idea.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：仍然算得上「该物」的最小一团。变化的只是框架——化学单元、尘埃颗粒、生物长链、被观测的单个个体、自由飞行的气体单元、一丝痕迹、聚合物中的重复砖块，还是一个念头里的小成分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two oxygen atoms held by an invisible bond, drifting as one group.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个氧原子被看不见的键拉着，作为一个整体漂移。

branches.en: THE CHEMICAL UNIT: Latin 'small mass' becomes a bonded group, and long biological chains are still such groups.
branches.cn: 化学单元：拉丁语「小团」变成成键原子团，生物长链也仍是这样的原子团。

branches.en: MERE SIZE: in everyday use any very small particle may be called a molecule, with no chemistry implied.
branches.cn: 仅指大小：日常用法中任何极小的颗粒都可叫 molecule，不含化学意味。

branches.en: ONE UNIT VERSUS MANY: single-molecule work watches one, while kinetic theory treats each as a free traveller.
branches.cn: 一个与许多：单分子研究观察一个，动理论则把每个都当作自由行者。

branches.en: THE TRACE: the smallest imaginable amount borrows the chemist's smallest unit.
branches.cn: 痕迹：想象所及的最少量，借用了化学家的最小单位。

branches.en: THE BRICK AND THE INGREDIENT: polymers repeat one unit, and ideas are said to contain molecules of doubt.
branches.cn: 砖块与成分：聚合物重复同一单元，念头里则被说成含有「一丝」疑虑。

intro.en: Molecule is Latin molecula, a diminutive in -cula built on moles 'mass'. Its English relatives attach the suffixes -ar, -ity and the prefixes macro- and bi-.
intro.cn: molecule 是拉丁语 molecula，由 moles「块体」加指小成分 -cula 构成。它的英语同族词接上 -ar、-ity 后缀以及 macro-、bi- 前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are moles 'mass, heap' and the diminutive -cula. moles also gives demolish and mole in the sense of a breakwater.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁成分是 moles「块体、堆」与指小成分 -cula。moles 还给出 demolish 以及作防波堤解的 mole。

items.meaning: the smallest chemically distinct unit
items.meaningCN: 保持化学性质的最小单元
items.example: Each molecule of water is bent, not straight.
items.exampleCN: 每个水分子都是弯的，不是直的。

items.meaning: relating to molecules
items.example: Molecular bonds store chemical energy.
items.exampleCN: 分子键储存化学能。

items.meaning: at the molecular level
items.example: The two forms are molecularly identical.
items.exampleCN: 这两种形式在分子层面完全相同。

items.meaning: the number of molecules taking part in a reaction step
items.meaningCN: 一步反应中参与反应的分子数
items.example: A unimolecular step has molecularity one.
items.exampleCN: 单分子步骤的分子数为一。

items.meaning: a very large molecule
items.example: Cellulose is a macromolecule of glucose units.
items.exampleCN: 纤维素是由葡萄糖单元构成的大分子。

items.meaning: involving two molecules
items.example: The reaction is bimolecular.
items.exampleCN: 这个反应是双分子的。

items.meaning: a unit of chemical amount
items.example: Two moles of gas fill the flask.
items.exampleCN: 两摩尔气体充满这个烧瓶。

items.meaning: per mole of substance
items.example: Molar mass is grams per mole.
items.exampleCN: 摩尔质量是每摩尔多少克。

items.meaning: to pull a structure down
items.example: The crew demolished the chimney.
items.exampleCN: 工人拆掉了烟囱。

items.structure: Latin moles for a great mass
items.meaning: a massive breakwater built into the sea
items.example: Waves break against the mole.
items.exampleCN: 浪拍在防波堤上。

latinEntries.meaning: a mass, a heap, a massive structure

definition_zh: 监测；监控；监听；病情监测；环境监测；系统监控；项目进度跟踪；设备状态监测；监测体系
definition_en: the continuous watching, checking or recording of something over time in order to detect change, problems or progress
core_image: 一个人坐在一排屏幕前，眼睛在数值之间来回扫，一有异常就记下来
scene: A technician sits before a wall of screens, scanning the numbers for anything unusual: this watching is monitoring.
sceneCN: 这里 monitoring 是「监测」（第 1 个义项：持续观察并记录）；句意：一名技术员坐在一整面屏幕前，在数值间来回扫视，寻找任何异常，这种持续看护就是监测。图中可辨识物件：成排屏幕、跳动的曲线、值班员、记录本、警示灯。

forms.label: 名词（监测这一活动，不可数）
名词（监视器；监测者；班长）

senses.title: Continuous watching and recording
senses.titleCN: 持续观察并记录：一直盯着看
senses.definition: the continuous watching and recording of a process over time in order to detect change
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内持续观察并记录某一过程，以便察觉变化
senses.example: Continuous monitoring of the river showed a slow rise in nitrates.
senses.exampleCN: 对河流的持续监测显示硝酸盐在缓慢上升。
senses.why: Latin monitor meant 'one who reminds or warns', from monere 'to warn'. Monitoring is the work of that warner: it keeps watch so that a change can be announced before it becomes damage.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 monitor 意为「提醒者、警告者」，出自 monere「警告」。monitoring 就是这位警告者的工作：它一直看着，好让变化在造成损害之前被报出来。

senses.title: Security surveillance: watching a place or person
senses.titleCN: 安防监控：看住一个场所或一个人
senses.definition: the watching of a place, building or person by cameras or guards for security
senses.definitionCN: 为安全目的用摄像头或人员看守某场所、建筑或某个人
senses.example: The station is under constant camera monitoring.
senses.exampleCN: 这个车站处于持续的摄像头监控之下。
senses.why: Here the warner is a camera rather than a voice. The word keeps its neutral sense of keeping watch, though the purpose shifts from warning to policing.
senses.whyCN: 这里的警告者是一台摄像头，而不是一个声音。词仍保持「看守」的中性义，只是目的从预警转向治安。

senses.title: Patient monitoring: tracking vital signs
senses.titleCN: 病情监测：盯住生命体征
senses.definition: the regular or continuous checking of a patient's condition, such as heart rate, blood pressure or oxygen
senses.definitionCN: 定期或持续检查病人状况，如心率、血压或血氧
senses.example: The nurses kept the patient under close monitoring overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 护士整夜对这名病人密切监护。
senses.why: Medicine uses the word for watching that can save a life. The monitor is the instrument and the nurse together, both standing between the patient and a sudden change.
senses.whyCN: 医学用这个词指能够救命的看护。监测者既是仪器也是护士，两者都守在病人与突变之间。

senses.title: Environmental monitoring: checking air, water and soil
senses.titleCN: 环境监测：定期检查空气水土
senses.definition: the systematic measurement and recording of environmental conditions such as air quality, water chemistry or noise
senses.definitionCN: 对空气质量、水体化学成分或噪声等环境状况的系统测量与记录
senses.example: Environmental monitoring detected the leak within hours.
senses.exampleCN: 环境监测在数小时内就查出了泄漏。
senses.why: Pollution is invisible until it is measured. Monitoring turns the environment into a record that can be compared across seasons and used as evidence.
senses.whyCN: 污染在被测量之前是看不见的。监测把环境变成一份可跨季节比较、并可作为证据的记录。

senses.title: System monitoring: checking servers and networks
senses.titleCN: 系统监控：盯住服务器与网络
senses.definition: the automated checking of computer systems, networks or applications for faults and performance problems
senses.definitionCN: 对计算机系统、网络或应用自动进行检查，以发现故障与性能问题
senses.example: System monitoring alerted the team before the disk filled.
senses.exampleCN: 系统监控在磁盘写满之前就向团队发出警报。
senses.why: Software fails quietly, so something must watch it continuously. The old warner becomes a script that checks, alerts and records, with no human eye in the loop.
senses.whyCN: 软件会悄无声息地坏掉，因此必须有东西持续盯着。古老的「警告者」变成了检查、报警并记录的脚本，人眼不再需要一直在场。

senses.title: Tracking progress in education or a project
senses.titleCN: 进度跟踪：看学生或项目走到哪一步
senses.definition: the regular checking of a learner's or a project's progress against a plan
senses.definitionCN: 对照计划定期检查学习者或项目的进展
senses.example: Progress monitoring helps teachers adjust the pace.
senses.exampleCN: 进度跟踪帮助教师调整节奏。
senses.why: Here what is watched is movement through a plan rather than a machine's state. Monitoring makes progress visible early enough to change it.
senses.whyCN: 这里被盯住的是在计划中走了多远，而不是机器的状态。监测让进展早到足以被改变的时候被看见。

senses.title: Condition monitoring of equipment
senses.titleCN: 设备状态监测：听机器的异常征兆
senses.definition: the checking of machine condition, such as vibration, temperature or wear, in order to predict failure
senses.definitionCN: 检查机器的状况，如振动、温度或磨损，以预测故障
senses.example: Condition monitoring caught the bearing wear early.
senses.exampleCN: 状态监测很早就发现了轴承磨损。
senses.why: Engineering watches symptoms rather than outcomes. A bearing that runs hot is already speaking, and monitoring is the practice of listening in time.
senses.whyCN: 工程盯的是征兆而不是结果。发热的轴承已经在说话，而监测就是及时去听的那门功夫。

senses.title: A monitoring programme: the organised system
senses.titleCN: 监测体系：成体系的安排
senses.definition: an organised, long-term arrangement of instruments, schedules and reports for watching something
senses.definitionCN: 由仪器、时间表与报告组成的、长期有组织的观察安排
senses.example: The forest monitoring programme has run for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这项森林监测计划已经运行了三十年。
senses.why: When monitoring lasts decades, it becomes an institution with staff, stations and archives. The activity noun then names the whole arrangement that keeps watch.
senses.whyCN: 当监测持续数十年，它就成了有人员、站点与档案的制度。这个活动名词于是指整套维持观察的安排。

intro.en: Monitoring is the English noun from monitor plus -ing. Monitor comes from Latin monitor 'one who reminds or warns', from monere 'to warn, advise'. English borrowed monitor in the 16th century for a person who advises or corrects, and extended it to instruments and then to continuous electronic watching in the 20th century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: monitoring 是英语名词 monitor 加 -ing。monitor 出自拉丁语 monitor「提醒者、警告者」，源自 monere「警告、告诫」。英语在 16 世纪借入 monitor，指提出劝告或纠正的人，后扩展到仪器，20 世纪又扩展到持续的电子监视。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Electronic monitoring, patient monitoring and system monitoring become standard phrases as sensors spread.
items.cn: 随着传感器普及，electronic monitoring（电子监控）、patient monitoring（病人监护）、system monitoring（系统监控）成为固定说法。

items.en: Monitor extends from the person who warns to the instrument that displays or checks, such as a ship's monitor.
items.cn: monitor 从发出警告的人扩展到显示或检查的仪器，如船上的监测装置。

items.en: English monitor names a person who admonishes or keeps order, including the school monitor.
items.cn: 英语 monitor 指提出告诫或维持秩序的人，包括学校里的班长。

items.en: monitor is 'the one who reminds', built on monere 'to warn, advise', whose participle is monitus.
items.cn: monitor 是「提醒者」，建立在 monere「警告、告诫」上，其分词为 monitus。

items.en: monere is often traced to a reconstructed root *men- 'to think', which also gives mental and comment, though the link is generally accepted.
items.cn: monere 常被追溯到重构词根 *men-「思考」，该词根也给出 mental 与 comment，但这一联系一般认为成立。

note.en: The first group separates two genuine relatives and one false friend; the second compares words for watching that differ in purpose and openness.
note.cn: 第一组把两个真正的同族词与一个假朋友分开；第二组比较在目的与公开程度上不同的「看」类词。

entries.definition: to watch and check something, or a screen or person that does so. Monitoring is simply the ongoing activity of this verb.
entries.definitionCN: 监测、检查某物，或指做这事的屏幕或人。monitoring 只是这个动词的持续活动形式。

entries.definition: to warn or reprimand someone firmly. It is ad- 'to' plus monere, the same warning verb behind monitor, but it names the speech act rather than the watching.
entries.definitionCN: 严厉警告或责备某人。它是 ad-「向」加 monere，与 monitor 同出一个「警告」动词，但指言语行为而非观察。

entries.definition: relating to money. It comes from Latin moneta 'mint, coinage', not from monere, and only shares the opening letters.
entries.definitionCN: 与货币有关的。它出自拉丁语 moneta「铸币厂、钱币」，并非来自 monere，只是开头字母相同。

entries.definition: close watching of a person or place, often by authorities and often without consent. It carries suspicion that monitoring does not always imply.
entries.definitionCN: 对人或场所的密切注视，常由当局进行且常未经同意。它带有怀疑色彩，而 monitoring 未必有此含义。

entries.definition: the act of noticing something carefully. It may be a single act, where monitoring implies a sustained series of checks.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细注意某事的行为。它可以是一次性的，而 monitoring 暗示持续的一系列检查。

entries.definition: following the position or progress of something over time. It stresses the path, where monitoring stresses the state and the alert.
entries.definitionCN: 随时间跟踪某物的位置或进展。它强调轨迹，而 monitoring 强调状态与警报。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: monere means 'to warn', so a monitor is a warner and monitoring is the act of staying awake on someone's behalf.
normal.cn: monere 意为「警告」，所以 monitor 是警告者，monitoring 则是替别人保持清醒的行为。

normal.en: admonish, admonition, summon and premonition all contain monere, the same warning verb.
normal.cn: admonish、admonition、summon、premonition 都含 monere，即同一个「警告」动词。

normal.en: monetary looks similar but comes from moneta 'mint'; money is not the same root as warning.
normal.cn: monetary 看着相似，却出自 moneta「铸币厂」；钱与警告不是同一个词根。

normal.en: The -ing form makes the verb into an activity, so monitoring names the ongoing watch rather than one check.
normal.cn: -ing 形式把动词变成活动，因此 monitoring 指持续的看守，而不是一次检查。

normal.en: Each field adds its object to the same activity: patient, environment, system, progress, condition.
normal.cn: 每个领域都是把各自的对象接到同一个活动上：病人、环境、系统、进度、状态。

abstract.en: Picture a night watchman who never sleeps because a script now does the rounds.
abstract.cn: 想象一个从不睡觉的更夫，因为如今是一段脚本在巡夜。

abstract.en: Monitoring is attention turned into a record: what is not written down cannot be compared later.
abstract.cn: 监测是把注意力变成记录：没被写下的东西，事后无法比较。

abstract.en: The word always implies that something could go wrong, and that someone wants to know first.
abstract.cn: 这个词总暗示：某事可能出错，而有人想先知道。

examples.en: Monitoring of the volcano began weeks before the eruption.
examples.cn: 对这座火山的监测在喷发前数周就开始了。

examples.en: The hospital uses remote monitoring for recovering patients.
examples.cn: 这家医院对康复期病人使用远程监护。

examples.en: Without monitoring, the restoration work could fail silently.
examples.cn: 没有监测，这项修复工作可能无声无息地失败。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摸你特宁」——夜里摸一遍设备，特别宁静才算过关 → monitoring 监测、监控

root: 拉丁语 monere「警告、告诫」→ monitor「提醒者、警告者」→ 英语 monitor；加 -ing → monitoring。核心是「替别人一直盯着，一有不对就先说出来」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: someone or something keeping watch over time. What changes is what is watched — a process, a place, a patient, the environment, a system, a learner, a machine, or a whole long-term programme.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：某人或某物在时间中持续看守。变化的只是看守的对象——一个过程、一处场所、一名病人、环境、一套系统、一名学习者、一台机器，还是整个长期计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a technician before a wall of screens, scanning for anything unusual.
core.cn: 核心意象：技术员坐在一整面屏幕前，扫视任何异常。

branches.en: THE WARNER: monere 'to warn' supplies the purpose, which is to notice change early enough to act.
branches.cn: 警告者：monere「警告」提供了目的，即早到足以采取行动地察觉变化。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND PLACES: cameras watch a station, instruments and nurses watch a patient.
branches.cn: 人与场所：摄像头看守车站，仪器与护士看守病人。

branches.en: ENVIRONMENT AND MACHINES: air, water and bearings all give signs before they fail.
branches.cn: 环境与机器：空气、水和轴承在失效之前都会给出征兆。

branches.en: SOFTWARE: the watch is automated, and the alert arrives before the disk is full.
branches.cn: 软件：看守被自动化，警报在磁盘写满之前到达。

branches.en: PROGRESS AND PROGRAMMES: learners are checked against a plan, and decades of checking become an institution.
branches.cn: 进度与计划：学习者对照计划被检查，数十年的检查则成为一个制度。

intro.en: Monitoring is monitor plus -ing. The ending -ing turns the verb into a noun of activity; monitor is Latin monitor 'one who reminds', from monere 'to warn'.
intro.cn: monitoring 是 monitor 加 -ing。词尾 -ing 把动词变成活动名词；monitor 是拉丁语 monitor「提醒者」，出自 monere「警告」。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb is monere 'to warn, advise', with participle monitus. It also gives admonish, admonition, summon, premonition and monument.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词是 monere「警告、告诫」，分词为 monitus。它还给出 admonish、admonition、summon、premonition、monument。

items.meaning: the ongoing act of watching and checking
items.meaningCN: 持续观察与检查的活动
items.example: Monitoring revealed the first signs of change.
items.exampleCN: 监测揭示了变化的最初迹象。

items.meaning: to watch and check, or the device that does so
items.meaningCN: 监测；亦指监视器或监测者
items.example: Sensors monitor the temperature hourly.
items.exampleCN: 传感器每小时监测一次温度。

items.meaning: being watched or checked
items.example: The monitored area is fenced off.
items.exampleCN: 受监测的区域被围了起来。

items.meaning: not watched or checked
items.example: Unmonitored wells can run dry unnoticed.
items.exampleCN: 无人监测的水井可能干涸而无人察觉。

items.meaning: to warn or scold gently but firmly
items.example: The teacher admonished the class for lateness.
items.exampleCN: 老师因迟到告诫了全班。

items.meaning: a warning or reprimand
items.example: He ignored the doctor's admonition.
items.exampleCN: 他没听医生的告诫。

items.meaning: a structure that reminds later generations
items.meaningCN: 纪念碑；纪念物（字面「提醒之物」）
items.example: The monument marks the old border.
items.exampleCN: 这座纪念碑标出旧边界。

items.meaning: to show clearly, and so to prove
items.meaningCN: 演示；证明（de- 表示彻底，monstrare 出自 monere）
items.example: The test demonstrates the effect clearly.
items.exampleCN: 这项测试清楚地展示了该效应。

items.meaning: to call someone to come
items.meaningCN: 召唤；传唤（sub- 表示私下提醒）
items.example: The court summoned two witnesses.
items.exampleCN: 法庭传唤了两名证人。

items.meaning: a warning felt in advance
items.example: She had a premonition of trouble.
items.exampleCN: 她预感到会有麻烦。

latinEntries.meaning: to warn, to advise, to remind
forms the name of an ongoing activity
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成表示持续活动的名词

definition_zh: 动机；内在动力；积极性；动因；激励；目的；学习动机；动机陈述
definition_en: the reason or reasons why a person acts in a certain way, or the inner drive and enthusiasm that keeps a person acting
core_image: 一个人看着山顶的小旗，脚下一级一级往上踩，没有人在背后推他
scene: No one pushes him; he keeps climbing toward a small flag on the summit because the flag is his own: that inner push is motivation.
sceneCN: 这里 motivation 是「动机」（第 1 个义项：内在动力）；句意：没有人推他，他仍一级一级朝山顶的小旗往上走，因为那面旗是他自己的，这股内在的推力就是动机。图中可辨识物件：登山者、石阶、山顶小旗、远处的云、没有第二个人。

derivatives.zh: 有积极性的；有明确动机的

senses.title: The inner drive: wanting to act
senses.titleCN: 内在动力：自己想去做
senses.definition: the inner drive or desire that makes a person want to act or keep acting
senses.definitionCN: 使人愿意开始行动、并持续行动的内在推力或愿望
senses.example: Her motivation came from curiosity rather than from money.
senses.exampleCN: 她的动力来自好奇，而不是金钱。
senses.why: Latin motivus means 'moving', from movere 'to move'. Motivation is therefore the moving force inside a person: what sets an action going when nobody pushes from outside.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 motivus 意为「使动的」，出自 movere「移动」。因此 motivation 就是人内部的推动力：在无人从外面推时让行动启动的东西。

senses.title: Enthusiasm and drive that keep going
senses.titleCN: 积极性、干劲：还能继续做下去
senses.definition: the enthusiasm, energy or willingness that sustains effort over time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内维持努力的干劲、精力或意愿
senses.example: The team lost motivation after the third delay.
senses.exampleCN: 第三次延期之后，团队失去了干劲。
senses.why: A single reason starts an action; sustained enthusiasm keeps it running. English uses motivation for both the spark and the fuel, which is why one can lose motivation without having lost a reason.
senses.whyCN: 单个理由能启动行动，持续的干劲则让它继续运转。英语用 motivation 兼指火花与燃料，所以人可能并未失去理由，却失去了动力。

senses.title: A reason or cause for behaviour
senses.titleCN: 动因：行为背后的理由
senses.definition: the reason or reasons behind a particular action, often examined by others
senses.definitionCN: 某一具体行为背后的理由，常由他人加以审视
senses.example: Investigators questioned the motivation behind the payment.
senses.exampleCN: 调查人员质疑这笔付款背后的动机。
senses.why: From 'the mover' the word shifts to 'the reason moved'. When others ask about motivation, they are asking what cause could produce such an act.
senses.whyCN: 从「推动者」转为「被推动的理由」。当他人追问 motivation 时，问的是什么样的原因会产生这样的行为。

senses.title: Drive in psychology: a directed force
senses.titleCN: 心理学中的驱力：有方向的力量
senses.definition: in psychology, the internal state that directs behaviour toward a goal, studied as a measurable construct
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中指引导行为指向目标的内在状态，被当作可测量的构念来研究
senses.example: The experiment manipulated motivation by varying the reward.
senses.exampleCN: 实验通过改变奖励来操纵动机水平。
senses.why: Psychology turned the everyday word into a variable. Here motivation is not a compliment but something that can be raised, lowered and measured across groups.
senses.whyCN: 心理学把这个日常词变成了一个变量。这里的 motivation 不是称赞，而是可以升高、降低并在组间测量比较的东西。

senses.title: Incentive in management: getting people to perform
senses.titleCN: 管理中的激励：让人愿意干
senses.definition: the practice of encouraging employees or members to work harder, as in employee motivation
senses.definitionCN: 鼓励员工或成员更努力工作的做法，如「员工激励」
senses.example: The bonus scheme was designed to improve motivation.
senses.exampleCN: 奖金方案的设计目的是提升积极性。
senses.why: Management speaks of motivation as something an organisation can supply or damage. The inner drive is treated as a resource that leadership can influence.
senses.whyCN: 管理学把 motivation 说成组织可以提供或损害的东西。内在动力被当作一种领导层能够影响的资源。

senses.title: Purpose: the aim behind an act
senses.titleCN: 目的：行为所指向的靶
senses.definition: the purpose or goal that an action is intended to serve
senses.definitionCN: 某一行为意图服务的目的或目标
senses.example: The motivation for the reform was to cut waiting times.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革的目的是缩短等候时间。
senses.why: A motive can be a future state that pulls rather than a past cause that pushes. English lets motivation cover both, which is why it can mean 'reason' and 'goal' at once.
senses.whyCN: 动机既可以是向前拉的未来状态，也可以是向后推的过去原因。英语让 motivation 两者都覆盖，所以它同时能指「理由」与「目的」。

senses.title: Learning motivation: why students engage
senses.titleCN: 学习动机：学生为何投入
senses.definition: in education, the willingness of a learner to engage with and persist at learning tasks
senses.definitionCN: 教育中指学习者愿意投入学习任务并坚持下去的意愿
senses.example: Task choice strongly affects learning motivation.
senses.exampleCN: 任务的选择对学习动机影响很大。
senses.why: Education studies motivation because engagement cannot be commanded. The word names the learner's own side of the bargain, which the teacher can only influence.
senses.whyCN: 教育学之所以研究动机，因为投入无法被命令。这个词命名的是学习者自己那一半的交易，教师只能施加影响。

senses.title: A motivation letter: the statement of intent
senses.titleCN: 动机陈述：写下来的「我为何而来」
senses.definition: a written statement explaining why one is applying for a course, job or grant, often called a motivation letter
senses.definitionCN: 说明为何申请某项课程、职位或资助的书面陈述，常称动机信
senses.example: Her motivation letter explained the gap in her studies.
senses.exampleCN: 她的动机信解释了她学业上的那段空白。
senses.why: Institutions cannot see inner drive, so they ask for it in writing. The word then names a document, and the abstract noun becomes a page in an application.
senses.whyCN: 机构看不见内在动力，于是要求把它写出来。这个词于是指一份文件，抽象名词变成申请表里的一页。

intro.en: Motivation is motive plus -ation. Motive comes from Latin motivus 'serving to move', from movere 'to move' with its participle motus. English uses motive from the 15th century for a reason for acting, and motivation is a 19th-century noun that psychology made technical in the 20th. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: motivation 是 motive 加 -ation。motive 出自拉丁语 motivus「使动的」，源自 movere「移动」，其分词为 motus。英语自 15 世纪用 motive 指行为的理由，motivation 则是 19 世纪的名词，20 世纪被心理学专业化。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Motivation becomes a technical term in psychology and management, and intrinsic and extrinsic are fixed as its two poles.
items.cn: motivation 在心理学与管理学中成为技术术语，intrinsic（内在的）与 extrinsic（外在的）被固定为它的两极。

items.en: English motivation is recorded, naming the act of providing a motive or the state of having one.
items.cn: 英语 motivation 见于记载，指提供动机的行为或具有动机的状态。

items.en: Motive enters English from Old French, meaning a reason that prompts an action.
items.cn: motive 经古法语进入英语，指促使行动的理由。

items.en: motivus is 'serving to move', built on movere 'to move', whose participle motus also gives motion and emotion.
items.cn: motivus 意为「使动的」，建立在 movere「移动」上，其分词 motus 还给出 motion 与 emotion。

items.en: movere goes back to a reconstructed root *meue- 'to push away', which also underlies move and remove.
items.cn: movere 可追溯到重构词根 *meue-「推开」，该词根也支撑 move 与 remove。

note.en: The first group separates real relatives from a look-alike; the second compares words that each name part of what motivation covers.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与一个形近词分开；第二组比较分别覆盖 motivation 一部分的近义词。

entries.definition: a reason for acting, often in a criminal or hidden sense. It is the concrete reason, while motivation can also mean the general drive.
entries.definitionCN: 行为的理由，常带犯罪或隐秘色彩。它指具体理由，而 motivation 也可指总体动力。

entries.definition: the act of moving, or a formal proposal. It shares motus with motivation but names physical movement or a parliamentary step.
entries.definitionCN: 移动的动作，或正式提案。它与 motivation 共享 motus，但指物理移动或议会程序。

entries.definition: a partial change. It comes from modus 'measure', not movere 'move', and shares only the -ification shape of the ending.
entries.definitionCN: 局部改动。它出自 modus「尺度」，而非 movere「移动」，只在词尾形状上相似。

entries.definition: something offered to make people act, such as a bonus. It is the external object, while motivation can be internal.
entries.definitionCN: 为促使人们行动而提供的东西，如奖金。它是外部之物，而 motivation 可以是内部的。

entries.definition: a strong inner urge to act or achieve. It is close to motivation but stresses force and energy rather than reasons.
entries.definitionCN: 行动或成就的强烈内在冲动。它接近 motivation，但强调力量与能量，而非理由。

entries.definition: strong liking and eagerness. It describes the feeling, while motivation also covers the reason behind the feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈的喜爱与热切。它描述感觉，而 motivation 还包含感觉背后的理由。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: movere 'to move' gives motive, motion, emotion, promote and remove: all involve setting something in motion.
normal.cn: movere「移动」给出 motive、motion、emotion、promote、remove，全都涉及让某物动起来。

normal.en: -ation makes an action noun, so motivation is the business of having or giving a motive.
normal.cn: -ation 构成动作名词，因此 motivation 就是「有动机或给动机」这件事。

normal.en: intrinsic motivation is the motive inside the task; extrinsic motivation is the motive outside it.
normal.cn: intrinsic motivation（内在动机）是任务内部的动机；extrinsic motivation（外在动机）是任务外部的动机。

normal.en: A motive is usually the specific reason; motivation can be that reason or the general drive.
normal.cn: motive 通常是具体理由；motivation 既可以是那个理由，也可以是总体动力。

normal.en: A motivation letter writes down what an institution cannot see.
normal.cn: 动机信写下的，正是机构看不见的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a climber with no one behind him, only a flag ahead that he chose himself.
abstract.cn: 想象一名登山者，身后无人，前方只有他自己选定的那面旗。

abstract.en: Motivation is both the push and the pull: a cause already past, and a goal still ahead.
abstract.cn: 动机既是推也是拉：既是已经过去的原因，也是尚在前方的目标。

abstract.en: The word always asks why anyone bothered, and whether they will bother again tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 这个词总在问：为什么有人愿意费这个劲，以及明天还愿不愿意。

examples.en: Curiosity was the strongest motivation behind her research.
examples.cn: 好奇心是她研究背后最强的动机。

examples.en: Poor pay can destroy motivation faster than long hours.
examples.cn: 低薪比长时间工作更快地摧毁积极性。

examples.en: The course asks for a short motivation letter in English.
examples.cn: 这门课程要求提交一份简短的英文动机信。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摩托为神」——心里有台摩托在推，人自己就往前冲 → motivation 动机、动力

root: 拉丁语 movere「移动」→ motivus「使动的」→ 古法语 motif → 英语 motive；加 -ation → motivation。核心是「让人动起来的那股力」，既可以是背后的理由，也可以是前方的目标。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: an inner push that starts and sustains action. What changes is the frame — a personal drive, lasting enthusiasm, a reason others investigate, a psychological variable, a management task, a goal, a learner's engagement, or a written statement.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一股启动并维持行动的内在推力。变化的只是框架——个人动力、持久干劲、他人追查的理由、心理学变量、管理任务、一个目标、学习者的投入，还是一份书面陈述。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a climber ascending toward a flag he chose, with nobody pushing.
core.cn: 核心意象：登山者朝他选定的旗子往上走，背后没有人推。

branches.en: THE INNER PUSH: movere supplies the force, which both starts an action and keeps it running.
branches.cn: 内在推力：movere 提供力量，既启动行动，也维持行动。

branches.en: REASON AND PURPOSE: the mover can be a past cause or a future goal, and others may examine either.
branches.cn: 理由与目的：推动者可以是过去的原因，也可以是未来的目标，他人都可能审视其中之一。

branches.en: THE VARIABLE: psychology treats the inner push as something that can be raised, lowered and measured.
branches.cn: 变量：心理学把内在推力当作可升高、可降低、可测量的东西。

branches.en: THE MANAGED AND THE TAUGHT: organisations try to supply it, and education studies how learners bring their own.
branches.cn: 被管理与被教导的：组织试图提供它，教育则研究学习者如何自带它。

branches.en: THE DOCUMENT: when inner drive must be shown, it is written down as a motivation letter.
branches.cn: 文件：当内在动力需要被展示时，它被写成一份动机信。

intro.en: Motivation is motive plus -ation. The ending -ation names an action or state; motive is Latin motivus, from movere 'to move'.
intro.cn: motivation 是 motive 加 -ation。词尾 -ation 表示动作或状态；motive 是拉丁语 motivus，出自 movere「移动」。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb is movere 'to move', with participle motus and adjective motivus. The same verb gives motion, emotion, promote, remote and remove.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词是 movere「移动」，分词 motus，形容词 motivus。同一个动词还给出 motion、emotion、promote、remote、remove。

items.meaning: the drive or reason for acting
items.example: Her motivation was to help her village.
items.exampleCN: 她的动机是帮助自己的村子。

items.meaning: to give someone a reason to act
items.example: Good teachers motivate students.
items.exampleCN: 好老师能激励学生。

items.meaning: having a reason or drive to act
items.meaningCN: 有积极性的；动机明确的
items.example: The team was highly motivated.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队积极性很高。

items.meaning: relating to motivation, or able to inspire it
items.example: He gave a short motivational talk.
items.exampleCN: 他做了一段简短的激励讲话。

items.meaning: something or someone that motivates
items.example: Praise is a weak motivator over time.
items.exampleCN: 长期来看，表扬是很弱的激励因素。

items.structure: Latin motivus through Old French motif
items.meaning: a reason for acting
items.example: The police looked for a motive.
items.exampleCN: 警方在寻找动机。

items.meaning: movement, or a formal proposal
items.example: The motion was carried by a vote.
items.exampleCN: 这项动议经表决通过。

items.meaning: a feeling that moves a person outward
items.meaningCN: 情绪（字面「把人向外推动的东西」）
items.example: The speech stirred strong emotion.
items.exampleCN: 这番讲话激起了强烈的情绪。

items.meaning: to move someone or something forward
items.meaningCN: 促进；提升；推广（pro- 表示向前）
items.example: The campaign promoted healthy eating.
items.exampleCN: 这项运动推广健康饮食。

items.meaning: to move something away
items.example: They removed the damaged beam.
items.exampleCN: 他们拆掉了受损的横梁。

latinEntries.meaning: to move, to set in motion
forms a noun of action or state

definition_zh: 动机的；激励性的；励志的；激发动力的；动机心理学的；动机研究的；动机式访谈的；驱动行为的
definition_en: relating to motivation, or intended to increase a person's drive and willingness to act
core_image: 一块写着「你能做到」的牌子挂在山路拐角，正好在腿酸的时候出现
scene: A sign reading 'you can do it' hangs at the bend where the legs begin to ache: its purpose is motivational.
sceneCN: 这里 motivational 是「激励性的」（第 2 个义项：激励性的）；句意：一块写着「你能做到」的牌子挂在正好腿开始发酸的拐角处，它的作用就是激励性的。图中可辨识物件：拐角处的标语牌、山路、喘气的登山者、水壶、远处的山顶。

pos.zh: 动机的；激励性的；励志的

collocations.zh: 动机式访谈（心理咨询方法）

forms.label: 副词（在动机上；起激励作用地）

senses.title: Relating to motivation as a concept
senses.titleCN: 动机的：作为一个概念而言
senses.definition: relating to motivation, the drive or reason behind behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 与动机这一概念，即行为背后的动力或理由，有关的
senses.example: The study measured motivational differences between groups.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究测量了各组之间的动机差异。
senses.why: Motivation plus -al gives a relating adjective, as with educational and environmental. This first sense simply says 'of motivation', without claiming to inspire anyone.
senses.whyCN: motivation 加 -al 构成关系形容词，如同 educational、environmental。这个基本义只说「与动机有关」，并不主张能激励谁。

senses.title: Inspiring: intended to raise someone's drive
senses.titleCN: 激励性的：意在把人的劲头提起来
senses.definition: intended to increase enthusiasm or willingness to act, as in a motivational speech
senses.definitionCN: 意在提升热情或行动意愿的，如一场激励演讲
senses.example: The coach gave a motivational talk at half-time.
senses.exampleCN: 教练在中场休息时做了一段激励讲话。
senses.why: The adjective turns a noun of state into a noun of purpose. Something motivational is not merely about motivation; it is designed to produce it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词把状态名词变成目的名词。motivational 的东西不只是关于动机，它是被设计来生产动机的。

senses.title: A motivational factor: a condition that raises effort
senses.titleCN: 激励因素：能提高努力的条件
senses.definition: describing a condition, reward or feature that increases effort or persistence
senses.definitionCN: 指能提高努力程度或坚持度的条件、奖励或特性
senses.example: Autonomy is a strong motivational factor at work.
senses.exampleCN: 自主性在工作中是很强的激励因素。
senses.why: Here the adjective modifies the cause rather than the person. A factor is motivational when removing it lowers effort, which is the practical test used in research.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词修饰的是原因，而不是人。一个因素是否属于激励性的，可用一个实际标准检验：拿掉它，努力是否下降。

senses.title: Of the self-help kind: designed to encourage
senses.titleCN: 励志的：为鼓舞人而写或做的
senses.definition: describing books, videos or content whose main purpose is to encourage people
senses.definitionCN: 指以鼓舞人为主要目的的书、视频或内容
senses.example: The shelf was full of motivational books.
senses.exampleCN: 架子上摆满了励志书。
senses.why: The commercial self-help industry adopted the word as a genre label. Here it describes a product category, and a careful writer may use it with some irony.
senses.whyCN: 商业自助行业把这个词采纳为一个门类标签。此处它描述的是一个产品类别，谨慎的作者使用时可能带一点讽刺。

senses.title: Of motivational psychology: the research field
senses.titleCN: 动机心理学的：研究动机的心理学分支
senses.definition: relating to the branch of psychology that studies why people act and how drive works
senses.definitionCN: 指研究人为何行动、动力如何运作的心理学分支
senses.example: Motivational psychology distinguishes intrinsic from extrinsic rewards.
senses.exampleCN: 动机心理学区分内在奖励与外在奖励。
senses.why: A field is named by its object. Motivational psychology studies motivation as its subject matter, so the adjective points at the research area, not at encouragement.
senses.whyCN: 学科以研究对象命名。动机心理学以动机为研究对象，因此这个形容词指向研究领域，而不是鼓舞行为。

senses.title: Use in research design: measuring the motive
senses.titleCN: 研究设计中的用法：测量动机
senses.definition: describing research that takes motivation as the variable to be measured or manipulated
senses.definitionCN: 指把动机当作要测量或操纵的变量的研究
senses.example: They used a motivational measure before and after the task.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在任务前后各做了一次动机测量。
senses.why: Once a concept becomes a variable, its adjective marks the instruments and measures built for it. This sense is technical and has no persuasive aim.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某个概念成为变量，其形容词就标记为此建立的工具与量表。这个义项是技术性的，没有说服的目的。

senses.title: motivational interviewing: a counselling method
senses.titleCN: 动机式访谈：一种咨询方法
senses.definition: in counselling, describing a client-centred method that helps people find their own reasons for change
senses.definitionCN: 咨询中指一种以当事人为中心、帮助其找到自身改变理由的方法
senses.example: Motivational interviewing is used in addiction treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 动机式访谈被用于成瘾治疗。
senses.why: The method is named for what it works on rather than what it does to the client. It draws out the person's own motivation instead of supplying it from outside.
senses.whyCN: 这种方法按它作用的对象命名，而不是按它对当事人做了什么。它引出当事人自己的动机，而不是从外部供给。

senses.title: A motivational force: something that drives behaviour
senses.titleCN: 驱动力量：推动行为的东西
senses.definition: describing a force, need or pressure that drives behaviour, whether pleasant or not
senses.definitionCN: 指推动行为的力量、需求或压力，无论其是否令人愉快
senses.example: Fear of failure can be a powerful motivational force.
senses.exampleCN: 对失败的恐惧可以成为强大的驱动力量。
senses.why: Not everything that drives people is inspiring. The adjective covers any force that moves behaviour, which is why fear and hunger can be motivational too.
senses.whyCN: 并非推动人的东西都令人振奋。这个形容词覆盖任何推动行为的力量，因此恐惧与饥饿也可以是动机性的。

intro.en: Motivational is motivation plus -al, the same relating suffix as in educational and environmental. Motivation is motive plus -ation, and motive comes from Latin motivus 'serving to move', from movere 'to move'. The adjective is a 20th-century formation, growing with psychology and the self-help industry. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: motivational 是 motivation 加 -al，与 educational、environmental 用的是同一个关系后缀。motivation 是 motive 加 -ation，而 motive 出自拉丁语 motivus「使动的」，源自 movere「移动」。这个形容词是 20 世纪的形式，随心理学与自助行业而生长。年代为大致估计。

items.en: Motivational speech, motivational interviewing and motivational psychology become established phrases in the century's middle decades.
items.cn: motivational speech（励志演讲）、motivational interviewing（动机式访谈）、motivational psychology（动机心理学）在该世纪中叶前后成为固定说法。

items.en: Motivation is recorded as a noun, giving the base for the later adjective.
items.cn: motivation 作为名词见于记载，为后来的形容词提供了词基。

items.en: Motive enters English through Old French, naming a reason that prompts action.
items.cn: motive 经古法语进入英语，指促使人行动的理由。

items.en: motivus 'serving to move' rests on movere 'to move', whose participle motus gives motion.
items.cn: motivus「使动的」建立在 movere「移动」上，其分词 motus 给出 motion。

items.en: movere is traced to a reconstructed root *meue- 'to push away', which also underlies move and remove.
items.cn: movere 被追溯到重构词根 *meue-「推开」，该词根也支撑 move 与 remove。

note.en: The first group separates the state adjective from the concept adjective and the base noun; the second compares words that describe encouragement from different angles.
note.cn: 第一组把状态形容词、概念形容词与词基名词分开；第二组比较从不同角度描述「鼓励」的词。

entries.definition: having a reason or drive to act, said of a person. It describes the person's state, while motivational describes what is meant to produce that state.
entries.definitionCN: 指人具有行动理由或动力。它描述人的状态，而 motivational 描述意在产生该状态的东西。

entries.definition: the drive or reason itself. The adjective adds only the relating suffix, so a motivational talk is a talk about or for motivation.
entries.definitionCN: 动力或理由本身。形容词只加了一个关系后缀，因此 motivational talk（励志谈话）是关于动机或为了动机的讲话。

entries.definition: relating to motion, especially in physics or grammar. It is built on motion, not motivation, and is rare outside technical use.
entries.definitionCN: 与运动有关的，尤用于物理或语法。它建立在 motion 上，而非 motivation，在技术用法之外很少见。

entries.definition: producing a feeling of enthusiasm or new ideas. It describes the effect on the listener, while motivational can describe the purpose alone.
entries.definitionCN: 引发热情或新想法的。它描述对听众的效果，而 motivational 可以只描述目的。

entries.definition: giving hope or confidence to someone. It is gentler and more supportive than motivational, which often implies a push.
entries.definitionCN: 给某人希望或信心。它比 motivational 更温和、更具支持性，后者常含推力。

entries.definition: making someone feel happier or more hopeful. It concerns mood rather than willingness to act.
entries.definitionCN: 使人更快乐或更有希望的。它关乎心情，而不是行动意愿。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real pieces of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -al is the same relating suffix as in educational and environmental: motivational simply means 'of motivation'.
normal.cn: -al 与 educational、environmental 中的关系后缀相同：motivational 就是「与动机有关的」。

normal.en: Motivated describes the person; motivational describes the speech, factor or force.
normal.cn: motivated 描述人；motivational 描述讲话、因素或力量。

normal.en: The root movere 'to move' explains why the whole family is about setting something in motion.
normal.cn: 词根 movere「移动」解释了为何整个词族都在讲让某物动起来。

normal.en: motivational interviewing draws out a person's own reasons instead of pushing new ones in.
normal.cn: 动机式访谈引出当事人自己的理由，而不是把新理由塞进去。

normal.en: Fear and hunger are motivational too: the adjective is about force, not about cheerfulness.
normal.cn: 恐惧与饥饿也可以是动机性的：这个形容词关乎力量，而非愉快。

abstract.en: Picture a sign at the exact bend where legs begin to ache, placed there by someone who knew.
abstract.cn: 想象一块牌子正好立在腿开始发酸的拐角，是懂行的人放在那里的。

abstract.en: The word always points at a purpose: something was made to move a person, or it describes what does.
abstract.cn: 这个词总指向一个目的：某物是为推动人而做的，或者它描述推动人的东西。

abstract.en: Strictly, motivational is not the same as motivating in effect; purpose and result can come apart.
abstract.cn: 严格说，motivational 并不等于实际产生了激励作用；目的与结果可能分开。

examples.en: The workshop ended with a motivational session.
examples.cn: 这场工作坊以一场激励环节收尾。

examples.en: Motivational factors matter more than salary for some workers.
examples.cn: 对某些员工来说，激励因素比薪水更重要。

examples.en: The counsellor used motivational interviewing to discuss drinking.
examples.cn: 咨询师用动机式访谈来讨论饮酒问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摩托为神能」——心里那台摩托为神一响，人就能再爬一段 → motivational 激励性的

root: 拉丁语 movere「移动」→ motivus「使动的」→ motive → 加 -ation 成 motivation → 加 -al（关系形容词后缀）成 motivational。核心是「意在把人推动起来」，或「与这股推力有关」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a sign placed where effort begins to fail. What changes is the frame — the concept itself, a talk meant to lift a team, a factor in a job, a genre of books, a research field, an instrument, a counselling method, or any force that drives behaviour.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一块立在「快要使不上劲」之处的牌子。变化的只是框架——概念本身、为提振团队而做的讲话、工作中的某个因素、一类书、一个研究领域、一件测量工具、一种咨询方法，还是任何推动行为的力量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sign reading 'you can do it' at the bend where the legs begin to ache.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块写着「你能做到」的牌子，立在腿开始发酸的拐角。

branches.en: THE CONCEPT: the adjective simply marks relation to motivation, with no claim about effect.
branches.cn: 概念：这个形容词只标记与动机的关系，不对效果作任何主张。

branches.en: PURPOSE AND GENRE: a speech or a book is motivational because it is made to raise willingness.
branches.cn: 目的与门类：讲话或书之所以是 motivational，因为它是为提升意愿而做的。

branches.en: FACTORS AND MEASURES: research asks which conditions raise effort and how to measure the change.
branches.cn: 因素与测量：研究追问哪些条件提高努力，以及如何测量这一变化。

branches.en: FIELDS AND METHODS: psychology studies the drive, and counselling draws out the client's own reasons.
branches.cn: 领域与方法：心理学研究这股动力，咨询则引出当事人自己的理由。

branches.en: ANY FORCE: fear and hunger drive behaviour too, so the word is not limited to cheerfulness.
branches.cn: 任何力量：恐惧与饥饿也推动行为，因此这个词并不限于愉快的东西。

intro.en: Motivational is motivation plus -al, the relating suffix from Latin -alis. Motivation is motive plus -ation, and motive is Latin motivus from movere 'to move'.
intro.cn: motivational 是 motivation 加 -al，这个关系后缀出自拉丁语 -alis。motivation 是 motive 加 -ation，而 motive 是出自 movere「移动」的拉丁语 motivus。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are movere 'to move', its participle motus and the adjective motivus. The English suffixes -ation and -al build the rest.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁成分是 movere「移动」、其分词 motus 与形容词 motivus。其余部分由英语后缀 -ation 与 -al 构成。

items.meaning: relating to motivation, or meant to inspire it
items.example: The poster had a motivational message.
items.exampleCN: 这张海报上有一句激励的话。

items.meaning: the drive or reason behind action
items.example: Her motivation faded after months of delay.
items.exampleCN: 拖了几个月后，她的动力消退了。

items.meaning: to provide a reason or drive
items.example: The results motivated the team to continue.
items.exampleCN: 这些结果激励团队继续做下去。

items.meaning: having drive or a reason
items.example: She is a highly motivated student.
items.exampleCN: 她是一名积极性很高的学生。

items.meaning: that which motivates
items.example: Recognition is a strong motivator.
items.exampleCN: 认可是一种很强的激励因素。

items.meaning: a reason for acting
items.example: Profit was the clear motive.
items.exampleCN: 获利是明显的动机。

items.meaning: movement or a proposal
items.example: The motion passed without objection.
items.exampleCN: 这项动议无异议通过。

items.meaning: a feeling that moves a person
items.example: The film stirred deep emotion.
items.exampleCN: 这部影片激起了深沉的情绪。

items.meaning: to move forward, hence to advance
items.example: The scheme promotes local crafts.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划促进本地手工艺。

items.structure: the same adjective used as a fixed genre label
items.meaning: of the self-help kind, made to encourage
items.meaningCN: 励志类的；为鼓舞人而作的
items.example: The genre is called motivational writing.
items.exampleCN: 这一门类被称为励志写作。

latinEntries.meaning: to move, to set in motion
